script:
# SSL Bus Comp
# How it sounds: SSL G-series bus: VCA glue. Panel attack 0.1/0.3/1/3/10/30 ms (engine floor 1 ms). Release 0.1–1.0 s (Auto ≈ 0.3). Ratio 2/4/10. Default 4:1, 3 ms, 0.3 s.
# a Thresh: -22 to -6, default -12
# b Ratio: 2 to 10, default 4
# c Attack: 0.001 to 0.03, default 0.003
# d Release: 0.1 to 1, default 0.3
# e Makeup: 0.85 to 1.8, default 1.15

param a = Thresh [-22.0, -6.0]
param b = Ratio [2.0, 10.0]
param c = Attack [0.001, 0.03]
param d = Release [0.1, 1.0]
param e = Makeup [0.85, 1.8]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 30; resonance = 0.2  # highpass
comp1: threshold = a; ratio = b; attack = c; release = d; knee = 3; makeup = 2; hpf = 90  # compressor
stage1: y = softclip(x * e, 1.06)  # soft clip

name: Fairchild Mu
description: Fairchild 670-ish variable-mu: Time Constant 1–2 (0.2 ms / 0.3–0.8 s → 1 ms / 0.45 s). Ratio ~2.5, thickens with GR. Lateral/vertical via mild MS side HPF.
script:
# Fairchild Mu
# How it sounds: Fairchild 670-ish variable-mu: Time Constant 1–2 (0.2 ms / 0.3–0.8 s → 1 ms / 0.45 s). Ratio ~2.5, thickens with GR. Lateral/vertical via mild MS side HPF.
# a Input: -24 to -8, default -15
# b Release: 0.25 to 1, default 0.45
# c SideHPF: 40 to 220, default 90
# d Makeup: 0.85 to 1.6, default 1.12

param a = Input [-24.0, -8.0]
param b = Release [0.25, 1.0]
param c = SideHPF [40, 220]
param d = Makeup [0.85, 1.6]
ms1: mode = encode  # mid/side encode
stage1: channel = mid; y = x  # waveshape / mix
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.22; channel = side  # highpass
comp1: threshold = a; ratio = 2.5; attack = 0.001; release = b  # compressor
ms2: mode = decode  # mid/side decode
stage2: y = tube(x * d, 1.08)  # tube saturation
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 14000; resonance = 0.22  # lowpass

name: dbx 160 VCA
description: dbx 160: RMS / Over Easy. Attack 15 ms, release 120 ms. Clean VCA, almost no color. Ratio 4–inf (we stop at 20). Threshold + Output.
script:
# dbx 160 VCA
# How it sounds: dbx 160: RMS / Over Easy. Attack 15 ms, release 120 ms. Clean VCA, almost no color. Ratio 4–inf (we stop at 20). Threshold + Output.
# a Thresh: -28 to -6, default -16
# b Ratio: 4 to 20, default 6
# c Output: 0.7 to 1.6, default 1.1

param a = Thresh [-28.0, -6.0]
param b = Ratio [4.0, 20.0]
param c = Output [0.7, 1.6]
comp1: threshold = a; ratio = b; attack = 0.015; release = 0.12  # compressor
stage1: y = softclip(x * c, 1.04)  # soft clip

name: CL-1B Vocal
description: Tube-Tech CL 1B: optical tube, vocal default. Attack 1 ms (fixed-ish), release 50 ms–1 s (panel to 10 s). Ratio 2–10. Interconnect-style smoothness.
script:
# CL-1B Vocal
# How it sounds: Tube-Tech CL 1B: optical tube, vocal default. Attack 1 ms (fixed-ish), release 50 ms–1 s (panel to 10 s). Ratio 2–10. Interconnect-style smoothness.
# a Thresh: -26 to -8, default -13
# b Ratio: 2 to 10, default 3.2
# c Release: 0.05 to 1, default 0.32
# d Makeup: 0.8 to 1.7, default 1.2

param a = Thresh [-26.0, -8.0]
param b = Ratio [2.0, 10.0]
param c = Release [0.05, 1.0]
param d = Makeup [0.8, 1.7]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 70; resonance = 0.22  # highpass
comp1: threshold = a; ratio = b; attack = 0.001; release = c  # compressor
stage1: y = tube(x * d, 1.1)  # tube saturation

name: Neve Diode Bus
description: Neve 33609-ish diode-bridge: attack 3–5 ms, recovery 100 ms–1 s (panel to 6 s). Ratio ~2–6. Thick, slow grab. 30 Hz HPF, mild tube.
script:
# Neve Diode Bus
# How it sounds: Neve 33609-ish diode-bridge: attack 3–5 ms, recovery 100 ms–1 s (panel to 6 s). Ratio ~2–6. Thick, slow grab. 30 Hz HPF, mild tube.
# a Thresh: -22 to -8, default -14
# b Ratio: 2 to 6, default 3.5
# c Recovery: 0.1 to 1, default 0.35
# d Makeup: 0.85 to 1.55, default 1.12

param a = Thresh [-22.0, -8.0]
param b = Ratio [2.0, 6.0]
param c = Recovery [0.1, 1.0]
param d = Makeup [0.85, 1.55]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 30; resonance = 0.2  # highpass
comp1: threshold = a; ratio = b; attack = 0.004; release = c  # compressor
stage1: y = tube(x * d, 1.14)  # tube saturation
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 14000; resonance = 0.22  # lowpass

name: Distressor Punch
description: EL8-ish: fast FET-like grab, detector HPF ~6 kHz habit as a 90 Hz HPF on the audio (compromise). Ratio 6, attack 1 ms, release 80–400 ms. British-mode grit.
script:
# Distressor Punch
# How it sounds: EL8-ish: fast FET-like grab, detector HPF ~6 kHz habit as a 90 Hz HPF on the audio (compromise). Ratio 6, attack 1 ms, release 80–400 ms. British-mode grit.
# a Input: 1.4 to 6, default 3.1
# b Ratio: 4 to 20, default 6
# c Release: 0.06 to 0.45, default 0.14
# d Output: 0.5 to 1.25, default 0.9

param a = Input [1.4, 6.0]
param b = Ratio [4.0, 20.0]
param c = Release [0.06, 0.45]
param d = Output [0.5, 1.25]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 90; resonance = 0.28  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a)  # tube saturation
comp1: threshold = -15; ratio = b; attack = 0.001; release = c  # compressor
stage2: y = diode(y, 1.22) * d  # diode clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 13000; resonance = 0.24  # lowpass

name: Space Echo RE-201
description: Roland RE-201: tape preamp, heads ~1.0x and 0.52x in parallel (mode 7-ish), Repeat Rate 140–620 ms, Intensity to the edge of runaway, wow ±8 ms @ 0.65 Hz, spring send.
script:
# Space Echo RE-201
# How it sounds: Roland RE-201: tape preamp, heads ~1.0x and 0.52x in parallel (mode 7-ish), Repeat Rate 140–620 ms, Intensity to the edge of runaway, wow ±8 ms @ 0.65 Hz, spring send.
# a Rate: 140 to 620, default 310
# b Intensity: 0.18 to 0.78, default 0.46
# c Mix: 0.18 to 0.7, default 0.4
# d Tone: 1400 to 4800, default 2600
# e Wow: 0 to 1, default 0.35
# f Spring: 0 to 0.32, default 0.12

param a = Rate [140, 620]
param b = Intensity [0.18, 0.78]
param c = Mix [0.18, 0.7]
param d = Tone [1400, 4800]
param e = Wow [0.0, 1.0]
param f = Spring [0.0, 0.32]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = 0.65; depth = 1.0  # LFO
stage1: y = tube(x, 1.58)  # tube saturation
bus h1:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  delay1: time = a + osc1 * e * 8; feedback = b; mix = 1; damp = d  # delay line
  stage2: y = softclip(x, 1.08)  # soft clip
bus h2:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  delay2: time = a * 0.52 + osc1 * e * 5; feedback = b * 0.55; mix = 1; damp = d  # delay line
bus tank:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  reverb1: size = 0.26; decay = 0.32; damp = 0.52; mix = 1; width = 0.55  # reverb
out: main = 1-c; h1 = c * 0.58; h2 = c * 0.42; tank = f  # mix buses back to the output

name: Memory Man BBD
description: EHX Deluxe Memory Man: bucket-brigade 80–550 ms, dark 1.4–3.2 kHz damp, chorus 0.6 Hz on the delay time (±6 ms), Blend + Feedback. Analog preamp.
script:
# Memory Man BBD
# How it sounds: EHX Deluxe Memory Man: bucket-brigade 80–550 ms, dark 1.4–3.2 kHz damp, chorus 0.6 Hz on the delay time (±6 ms), Blend + Feedback. Analog preamp.
# a Time: 80 to 550, default 320
# b Feedback: 0.12 to 0.68, default 0.4
# c Blend: 0.18 to 0.62, default 0.38
# d Age: 1200 to 3200, default 2100
# e Chorus: 0 to 1, default 0.4

param a = Time [80, 550]
param b = Feedback [0.12, 0.68]
param c = Blend [0.18, 0.62]
param d = Age [1200, 3200]
param e = Chorus [0.0, 1.0]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = 0.6; depth = 1.0  # LFO
stage1: y = tube(x, 1.45)  # tube saturation
delay1: time = a + osc1 * e * 6; feedback = b; mix = c; damp = d  # delay line
stage2: y = softclip(y, 1.08)  # soft clip
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 9000; resonance = 0.24  # lowpass

name: Echoplex EP-3
description: Maestro EP-3: tube record amp, 70–400 ms tape path, Sustain = feedback, Echo = mix, Record = drive. Darker than Space Echo, less wow.
script:
# Echoplex EP-3
# How it sounds: Maestro EP-3: tube record amp, 70–400 ms tape path, Sustain = feedback, Echo = mix, Record = drive. Darker than Space Echo, less wow.
# a Time: 70 to 400, default 190
# b Sustain: 0.12 to 0.7, default 0.38
# c Echo: 0.16 to 0.58, default 0.34
# d Record: 1.1 to 3.4, default 1.85
# e Age: 1600 to 4200, default 2800

param a = Time [70, 400]
param b = Sustain [0.12, 0.7]
param c = Echo [0.16, 0.58]
param d = Record [1.1, 3.4]
param e = Age [1600, 4200]
stage1: y = tube(x, d)  # tube saturation
delay1: time = a; feedback = b; mix = c; damp = e  # delay line
stage2: y = softclip(y, 1.1)  # soft clip
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 10000; resonance = 0.24  # lowpass

name: TC 2290 Grid
description: TC 2290-style digital: note-grid time 1/4…1/16, clean 12 kHz damp, 0.35 Hz mod ±3 ms, no tape grit. Dynamic-ish by leaving dry on main.
script:
# TC 2290 Grid
# How it sounds: TC 2290-style digital: note-grid time 1/4…1/16, clean 12 kHz damp, 0.35 Hz mod ±3 ms, no tape grit. Dynamic-ish by leaving dry on main.
# a Time: 0 to 1, default 0.45
# b Feedback: 0.12 to 0.62, default 0.34
# c Mix: 0.16 to 0.55, default 0.32
# d Mod: 0 to 1, default 0.28
# e Damp: 7000 to 14000, default 11000

param a = Time [1/4, 1/16]
param b = Feedback [0.12, 0.62]
param c = Mix [0.16, 0.55]
param d = Mod [0.0, 1.0]
param e = Damp [7000, 14000]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = 0.35; depth = 1.0  # LFO
delay1: time = a + osc1 * d * 3; feedback = b; mix = c; damp = e  # delay line
stage1: y = softclip(x, 1.03)  # soft clip

name: EMT 140 Plate
description: EMT 140: foil plate, not a hall. Size 0.42–0.58, decay 0.42–0.72 (~1.5–4 s habit), damp 0.18–0.34 (bright), predelay 0–18 ms, width 0.92.
script:
# EMT 140 Plate
# How it sounds: EMT 140: foil plate, not a hall. Size 0.42–0.58, decay 0.42–0.72 (~1.5–4 s habit), damp 0.18–0.34 (bright), predelay 0–18 ms, width 0.92.
# a Decay: 0.42 to 0.72, default 0.56
# b Predelay: 0 to 18, default 6
# c Damp: 0.18 to 0.34, default 0.24
# d Mix: 0.12 to 0.55, default 0.32
# e Size: 0.42 to 0.58, default 0.5

param a = Decay [0.42, 0.72]
param b = Predelay [0, 18]
param c = Damp [0.18, 0.34]
param d = Mix [0.12, 0.55]
param e = Size [0.42, 0.58]
delay1: time = b; feedback = 0.02; mix = 0.28; damp = 9000  # delay line
reverb1: size = e; decay = a; damp = c; mix = d; width = 0.92  # reverb
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 90; resonance = 0.22  # highpass
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 6500; q = 0.7; gain = 1.8  # high shelf
stage1: y = softclip(x, 1.04)  # soft clip

name: Lexicon 480 Hall
description: Lexicon 480L hall habit: size 0.76–0.94, decay 0.62–0.88, damp 0.38–0.56, predelay 20–80 ms, full width. Even, long, not a plate.
script:
# Lexicon 480 Hall
# How it sounds: Lexicon 480L hall habit: size 0.76–0.94, decay 0.62–0.88, damp 0.38–0.56, predelay 20–80 ms, full width. Even, long, not a plate.
# a Size: 0.76 to 0.94, default 0.84
# b Decay: 0.62 to 0.88, default 0.74
# c Predelay: 20 to 80, default 36
# d Damp: 0.38 to 0.56, default 0.46
# e Mix: 0.12 to 0.5, default 0.3

param a = Size [0.76, 0.94]
param b = Decay [0.62, 0.88]
param c = Predelay [20, 80]
param d = Damp [0.38, 0.56]
param e = Mix [0.12, 0.5]
delay1: time = c; feedback = 0.04; mix = 0.3; damp = 8500  # delay line
reverb1: size = a; decay = b; damp = d; mix = e; width = 1.0  # reverb
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 55; resonance = 0.2  # highpass
stage1: y = softclip(x, 1.04)  # soft clip

name: AMS RMX Nonlin
description: AMS RMX16 NonLin2 habit: 150–350 ms dense burst. Fixed room (no live size jumps), darker damp, short slap, recovery LPF. 80s snare room, not a hall.
script:
# AMS RMX Nonlin
# How it sounds: AMS RMX16 NonLin2 habit: 150–350 ms dense burst. Fixed room (no live size jumps), darker damp, short slap, recovery LPF. 80s snare room, not a hall.
# a Burst: 0.18 to 0.34, default 0.24
# b Predelay: 10 to 26, default 16
# c Damp: 0.32 to 0.55, default 0.42
# d Mix: 0.18 to 0.62, default 0.4

param a = Burst [0.18, 0.34]
param b = Predelay [10, 26]
param c = Damp [0.32, 0.55]
param d = Mix [0.18, 0.62]
delay1: time = b; feedback = 0.02; mix = 0.12; damp = 5500  # delay line
reverb1: size = 0.36; decay = a; damp = c; mix = d; width = 0.68  # reverb
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 3800; q = 0.65; gain = 1.1  # high shelf
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 160; resonance = 0.22  # highpass
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 9500; resonance = 0.22  # lowpass
stage1: y = softclip(x, 1.04)  # soft clip

name: Spring Tank
description: Guitar-amp / AKG-ish spring: small tank, splashy top, 22–40 ms drip delay, decay 0.26–0.48, damp 0.16–0.3. Not a plate and not a hall.
script:
# Spring Tank
# How it sounds: Guitar-amp / AKG-ish spring: small tank, splashy top, 22–40 ms drip delay, decay 0.26–0.48, damp 0.16–0.3. Not a plate and not a hall.
# a Decay: 0.26 to 0.48, default 0.36
# b Drip: 22 to 40, default 30
# c Splash: 0.16 to 0.3, default 0.22
# d Mix: 0.12 to 0.55, default 0.3
# e Drive: 0.9 to 2.2, default 1.25

param a = Decay [0.26, 0.48]
param b = Drip [22, 40]
param c = Splash [0.16, 0.3]
param d = Mix [0.12, 0.55]
param e = Drive [0.9, 2.2]
stage1: y = tube(x, e)  # tube saturation
delay1: time = b; feedback = 0.08; mix = 0.22; damp = 7000  # delay line
reverb1: size = 0.24; decay = a; damp = c; mix = d; width = 0.45  # reverb
eq1: type = peak; freq = 2100; q = 1.4; gain = 2.6  # peak EQ
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 120; resonance = 0.28  # highpass
stage2: y = softclip(x, 1.08)  # soft clip

name: FET Peak Catch
description: Insert on a lead vocal. Fast FET catches peaks. Mix 100.
script:
# FET Peak Catch
# How it sounds: Insert on a lead vocal. Fast FET catches peaks. Mix 100.
# a Drive: 2 to 10, default 5.5
# b Attack: 0.0002 to 0.008, default 0.001
# c Release: 0.04 to 0.28, default 0.09

param a = Drive [2, 10]
param b = Attack [0.0002, 0.008]
param c = Release [0.04, 0.28]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 80; resonance = 0.25  # highpass
comp1: threshold = -a; ratio = 8; attack = b; release = c; knee = 2; makeup = 3  # compressor
eq1: type = peak; freq = 3200; q = 1.1; gain = 1.8  # peak EQ

name: Opto Leveler
description: Insert after a peak catcher. Slow opto rides the level. Mix 100.
script:
# Opto Leveler
# How it sounds: Insert after a peak catcher. Slow opto rides the level. Mix 100.
# a Pull: 4 to 14, default 8
# b Makeup: 0 to 8, default 2.5
# c Air: 0 to 5, default 2.2

param a = Pull [4, 14]
param b = Makeup [0, 8]
param c = Air [0, 5]
stage1: y = tube(x, 0.85)  # tube saturation
comp1: threshold = -a; ratio = 3; attack = 0.012; release = 0.22; knee = 8; makeup = b  # compressor
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 9000; q = 0.6; gain = c  # high shelf

name: Serial Vocal Stack
description: Classic FET into opto on one insert. Lead vocal, Mix 100.
script:
# Serial Vocal Stack
# How it sounds: Classic FET into opto on one insert. Lead vocal, Mix 100.
# a Peak: 3 to 12, default 6
# b Ride: 4 to 12, default 7
# c Air: 0 to 4, default 1.6

param a = Peak [3, 12]
param b = Ride [4, 12]
param c = Air [0, 4]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 90; resonance = 0.22  # highpass
comp1: threshold = -a; ratio = 8; attack = 0.0008; release = 0.07; knee = 1; makeup = 2  # compressor
comp2: threshold = -b; ratio = 3; attack = 0.015; release = 0.25; knee = 10; makeup = 2  # compressor
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 10000; q = 0.55; gain = c  # high shelf

name: Rap Punch Chain
description: Rap vocal insert: 80 Hz cut, fast FET, de-ess on the air band. Mix 100.
script:
# Rap Punch Chain
# How it sounds: Rap vocal insert: 80 Hz cut, fast FET, de-ess on the air band. Mix 100.
# a Punch: 3 to 12, default 7
# b Ess: 2 to 10, default 5
# c Presence: 0 to 5, default 2

param a = Punch [3, 12]
param b = Ess [2, 10]
param c = Presence [0, 5]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 80; resonance = 0.3  # highpass
comp1: threshold = -a; ratio = 12; attack = 0.0004; release = 0.05; knee = 1; makeup = 3  # compressor
eq1: type = peak; freq = 2800; q = 1.2; gain = c  # peak EQ
xover1: f1 = 4200; f2 = 9000  # crossover
bus high:
  comp2: threshold = -b; ratio = 6; attack = 0.001; release = 0.04; makeup = 0  # compressor
out: low = 1; mid = 1; high = 1  # mix buses back to the output

name: De-Ess Shelf
description: Insert de-ess: only the top band is compressed. Mix 100.
script:
# De-Ess Shelf
# How it sounds: Insert de-ess: only the top band is compressed. Mix 100.
# a Ess: 3 to 14, default 7
# b BandHz: 3500 to 8000, default 5200
# c Air: 0 to 3, default 0.8

param a = Ess [3, 14]
param b = BandHz [3500, 8000]
param c = Air [0, 3]
xover1: f1 = b; f2 = 11000  # crossover
bus high:
  comp1: threshold = -a; ratio = 8; attack = 0.0006; release = 0.035; makeup = 0  # compressor
  eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 12000; q = 0.5; gain = c  # high shelf
out: low = 1; mid = 1; high = 1  # mix buses back to the output

name: Slap And Booth
description: Vocal send: 95 ms slap plus a small booth. Blend is wet. Mix 25–40 on a send.
script:
# Slap And Booth
# How it sounds: Vocal send: 95 ms slap plus a small booth. Blend is wet. Mix 25–40 on a send.
# a Slap: 70 to 140, default 95
# b Room: 0.12 to 0.42, default 0.22
# c Blend: 0.15 to 0.7, default 0.32

param a = Slap [70, 140]
param b = Room [0.12, 0.42]
param c = Blend [0.15, 0.7]
stage1: y = x  # waveshape / mix
bus wet:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  delay1: time = a; feedback = 0.08; mix = 1; damp = 4500  # delay line
  reverb1: size = b; decay = 0.22; damp = 0.55; mix = 1; width = 0.45  # reverb
out: main = 1-c; wet = c  # mix buses back to the output

name: Dotted Eighth Throw
description: Pop vocal throw. Dotted 1/8, dark. Use as a send, Mix 20–35.
script:
# Dotted Eighth Throw
# How it sounds: Pop vocal throw. Dotted 1/8, dark. Use as a send, Mix 20–35.
# a Feedback: 0.12 to 0.48, default 0.26
# b Tone: 1800 to 6500, default 3800
# c Blend: 0.12 to 0.55, default 0.28

param a = Feedback [0.12, 0.48]
param b = Tone [1800, 6500]
param c = Blend [0.12, 0.55]
stage1: y = x  # waveshape / mix
bus throw:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 180; resonance = 0.25  # highpass
  delay1: time = 1/8.; feedback = a; mix = 1; damp = b  # delay line
out: main = 1-c; throw = c  # mix buses back to the output

name: Quarter Note Halo
description: Ballad vocal send. Straight 1/4, wider and wetter than the dotted throw.
script:
# Quarter Note Halo
# How it sounds: Ballad vocal send. Straight 1/4, wider and wetter than the dotted throw.
# a Feedback: 0.18 to 0.52, default 0.3
# b Size: 0.2 to 0.55, default 0.34
# c Blend: 0.15 to 0.6, default 0.3

param a = Feedback [0.18, 0.52]
param b = Size [0.2, 0.55]
param c = Blend [0.15, 0.6]
stage1: y = x  # waveshape / mix
bus halo:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  delay1: time = 1/4; feedback = a; mix = 1; damp = 4200  # delay line
  reverb1: size = b; decay = 0.45; damp = 0.5; mix = 0.35; width = 0.7  # reverb
out: main = 1-c; halo = c  # mix buses back to the output

name: Dual Throw Lattice
description: Two throws: dotted 1/8 left-ish and 1/4. Pop chorus send.
script:
# Dual Throw Lattice
# How it sounds: Two throws: dotted 1/8 left-ish and 1/4. Pop chorus send.
# a Short: 0.1 to 0.4, default 0.2
# b Long: 0.12 to 0.45, default 0.24
# c Blend: 0.15 to 0.55, default 0.3

param a = Short [0.1, 0.4]
param b = Long [0.12, 0.45]
param c = Blend [0.15, 0.55]
stage1: y = x  # waveshape / mix
bus short:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  delay1: time = 1/8.; feedback = a; mix = 1; damp = 5000  # delay line
bus long:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  delay2: time = 1/4; feedback = b; mix = 1; damp = 3600  # delay line
out: main = 1-c; short = c*0.55; long = c*0.45  # mix buses back to the output

name: Radio Band Vocal
description: AM radio vocal. Tight band, light crush, then LPF. Insert or send.
script:
# Radio Band Vocal
# How it sounds: AM radio vocal. Tight band, light crush, then LPF. Insert or send.
# a Bits: 5 to 11, default 8
# b Center: 800 to 2200, default 1400
# c Width: 400 to 1400, default 800

param a = Bits [5, 11]
param b = Center [800, 2200]
param c = Width [400, 1400]
filter1: type = bandpass; center = b; width = c  # bandpass
stage1: y = bitcrush(softclip(x, 1.4), a)  # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 4500; resonance = 0.3  # lowpass

name: Telephone Cup
description: Narrower than Radio Band. 400–3 kHz cup, diode grit.
script:
# Telephone Cup
# How it sounds: Narrower than Radio Band. 400–3 kHz cup, diode grit.
# a Grit: 0.8 to 3.5, default 1.6
# b Low: 280 to 700, default 400
# c High: 2200 to 4200, default 3000

param a = Grit [0.8, 3.5]
param b = Low [280, 700]
param c = High [2200, 4200]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.45  # highpass
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.4  # lowpass
stage1: y = diode(x, a)  # diode clip

name: Haas Vocal Double
description: Mono vocal to a tight double. Mid stays the dry word. Insert, Mix 100.
script:
# Haas Vocal Double
# How it sounds: Mono vocal to a tight double. Mid stays the dry word. Insert, Mix 100.
# a Offset: 8 to 28, default 16
# b Width: 0.3 to 1, default 0.62
# c High: 4000 to 10000, default 7500

param a = Offset [8, 28]
param b = Width [0.3, 1]
param c = High [4000, 10000]
widen1: width = b; delay = a; bass = 140  # mono to stereo
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = c; q = 0.55; gain = 1.4  # high shelf

name: Air Only Vocal
description: Add air without more compression. High shelf + tiny tube. Insert.
script:
# Air Only Vocal
# How it sounds: Add air without more compression. High shelf + tiny tube. Insert.
# a Air: 1 to 8, default 3.4
# b Warm: 0.4 to 1.6, default 0.75
# c LowCut: 40 to 140, default 70

param a = Air [1, 8]
param b = Warm [0.4, 1.6]
param c = LowCut [40, 140]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.2  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, b)  # tube saturation
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 11000; q = 0.5; gain = a  # high shelf

name: Presence Pocket
description: 3 kHz pocket so the lyric cuts a dense mix. Light glue after.
script:
# Presence Pocket
# How it sounds: 3 kHz pocket so the lyric cuts a dense mix. Light glue after.
# a Cut: 0 to 6, default 2.8
# b Glue: 2 to 8, default 4.5
# c Dip: 200 to 500, default 320

param a = Cut [0, 6]
param b = Glue [2, 8]
param c = Dip [200, 500]
eq1: type = peak; freq = 3100; q = 1.35; gain = a  # peak EQ
eq2: type = peak; freq = c; q = 1.1; gain = -2.2  # peak EQ
comp1: threshold = -b; ratio = 3; attack = 0.006; release = 0.12; makeup = 1.5  # compressor

name: Breath Gate
description: Close-mic vocal. Gate the breaths, keep the line. Mix 100.
script:
# Breath Gate
# How it sounds: Close-mic vocal. Gate the breaths, keep the line. Mix 100.
# a Open: -56 to -28, default -42
# b Hold: 0.02 to 0.16, default 0.06
# c Range: -70 to -20, default -48

param a = Open [-56, -28]
param b = Hold [0.02, 0.16]
param c = Range [-70, -20]
gate1: threshold = a; hyst = 5; hold = b; range = c  # noise gate
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 70; resonance = 0.22  # highpass
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 8000; q = 0.55; gain = 1.2  # high shelf

name: Choir Widen Hall
description: Stack or choir. Width then a long hall on a send blend.
script:
# Choir Widen Hall
# How it sounds: Stack or choir. Width then a long hall on a send blend.
# a Width: 0.25 to 1, default 0.55
# b Hall: 0.35 to 0.75, default 0.55
# c Blend: 0.12 to 0.5, default 0.24

param a = Width [0.25, 1]
param b = Hall [0.35, 0.75]
param c = Blend [0.12, 0.5]
widen1: delay = 14; mix = a  # mono to stereo
bus hall:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  reverb1: size = b; decay = 1.6; damp = 0.42; mix = 1; width = 0.85  # reverb
out: main = 1-c; hall = c  # mix buses back to the output

name: Shout Clip Vocal
description: Screamed / shouted vocal. HPF, soft-pre hard ceiling, dark recovery.
script:
# Shout Clip Vocal
# How it sounds: Screamed / shouted vocal. HPF, soft-pre hard ceiling, dark recovery.
# a Drive: 1.4 to 6, default 2.8
# b Ceiling: 0.35 to 0.85, default 0.58
# c Tone: 2500 to 7000, default 4800

param a = Drive [1.4, 6]
param b = Ceiling [0.35, 0.85]
param c = Tone [2500, 7000]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 140; resonance = 0.35  # highpass
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x, a), b)  # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.32  # lowpass

name: Narration Seat
description: Spoken word / VO. Gentle EQ, slow leveler, peak limit. Mix 100.
script:
# Narration Seat
# How it sounds: Spoken word / VO. Gentle EQ, slow leveler, peak limit. Mix 100.
# a Body: 0 to 4, default 1.6
# b Ride: 3 to 10, default 6
# c Ceiling: -3 to -0.2, default -0.8

param a = Body [0, 4]
param b = Ride [3, 10]
param c = Ceiling [-3, -0.2]
eq1: type = peak; freq = 180; q = 0.8; gain = a  # peak EQ
eq2: type = peak; freq = 4500; q = 0.9; gain = 1.2  # peak EQ
comp1: threshold = -b; ratio = 2.5; attack = 0.02; release = 0.3; knee = 10; makeup = 1  # compressor
limit1: ceiling = c; release = 0.12  # limiter

name: Mid Word Side Bloom
description: MS vocal: mid stays dry words, sides get a short bloom.
script:
# Mid Word Side Bloom
# How it sounds: MS vocal: mid stays dry words, sides get a short bloom.
# a Bloom: 0.15 to 0.5, default 0.28
# b Size: 0.18 to 0.45, default 0.28
# c Width: 0.4 to 1, default 0.7

param a = Bloom [0.15, 0.5]
param b = Size [0.18, 0.45]
param c = Width [0.4, 1]
ms1: mode = encode  # mid/side encode
stage1: channel = mid; y = x  # waveshape / mix
stage2: channel = side; y = x  # waveshape / mix
reverb1: channel = side; size = b; decay = a; damp = 0.5; mix = 0.55; width = c  # reverb
ms2: mode = decode  # mid/side decode

name: Vocal Plate Throw
description: Short bright plate on a send. Not a hall.
script:
# Vocal Plate Throw
# How it sounds: Short bright plate on a send. Not a hall.
# a Size: 0.12 to 0.38, default 0.22
# b Decay: 0.18 to 0.55, default 0.32
# c Blend: 0.12 to 0.5, default 0.26

param a = Size [0.12, 0.38]
param b = Decay [0.18, 0.55]
param c = Blend [0.12, 0.5]
stage1: y = x  # waveshape / mix
bus plate:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 220; resonance = 0.25  # highpass
  reverb1: size = a; decay = b; damp = 0.35; mix = 1; width = 0.72  # reverb
out: main = 1-c; plate = c  # mix buses back to the output

name: Side Air Only
description: MS: lift air on the sides only. Center stays put.
script:
# Side Air Only
# How it sounds: MS: lift air on the sides only. Center stays put.
# a Air: 1 to 7, default 3.2
# b AirHz: 5000 to 12000, default 8500
# c SideGain: 0.7 to 1.3, default 1

param a = Air [1, 7]
param b = AirHz [5000, 12000]
param c = SideGain [0.7, 1.3]
ms1: mode = encode  # mid/side encode
stage1: channel = mid; y = x  # waveshape / mix
eq1: channel = side; type = highshelf; freq = b; q = 0.5; gain = a  # high shelf
stage2: channel = side; y = x * c  # waveshape / mix
ms2: mode = decode  # mid/side decode

name: Parallel Vocal Smash
description: NY vocal: dry word plus a smashed bus. Blend is the smash.
script:
# Parallel Vocal Smash
# How it sounds: NY vocal: dry word plus a smashed bus. Blend is the smash.
# a Smash: 4 to 14, default 8
# b Tone: 2000 to 7000, default 4500
# c Blend: 0.12 to 0.55, default 0.28

param a = Smash [4, 14]
param b = Tone [2000, 7000]
param c = Blend [0.12, 0.55]
stage1: y = x  # waveshape / mix
bus smash:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 160; resonance = 0.3  # highpass
  stage2: y = tube(x, 2.2)  # tube saturation
  comp1: threshold = -a; ratio = 12; attack = 0.0005; release = 0.08; makeup = 6  # compressor
  filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.28  # lowpass
out: main = 1-c; smash = c  # mix buses back to the output

name: Track Then Slap
description: Insert EQ/comp plus a dedicated slap send in one preset.
script:
# Track Then Slap
# How it sounds: Insert EQ/comp plus a dedicated slap send in one preset.
# a Glue: 3 to 10, default 5.5
# b Slap: 70 to 130, default 98
# c Send: 0.08 to 0.4, default 0.18

param a = Glue [3, 10]
param b = Slap [70, 130]
param c = Send [0.08, 0.4]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 85; resonance = 0.22  # highpass
eq1: type = peak; freq = 3500; q = 1.05; gain = 1.6  # peak EQ
comp1: threshold = -a; ratio = 4; attack = 0.003; release = 0.1; makeup = 2  # compressor
bus slap:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  delay1: time = b; feedback = 0.06; mix = 1; damp = 5000  # delay line
out: main = 1; slap = c  # mix buses back to the output

name: Talk Formant
description: Envelope moves a bandpass so the mouth shape talks. Creative insert.
script:
# Talk Formant
# How it sounds: Envelope moves a bandpass so the mouth shape talks. Creative insert.
# a Depth: 200 to 1600, default 700
# b Center: 700 to 1800, default 1100
# c Mix: 0.2 to 1, default 0.55

param a = Depth [200, 1600]
param b = Center [700, 1800]
param c = Mix [0.2, 1]
env1: attack = 0.008; release = 0.09  # envelope follower
stage1: y = x  # waveshape / mix
bus mouth:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  filter1: type = bandpass; center = b + env1 * a; width = 650; resonance = 1.4  # bandpass
out: main = 1-c; mouth = c  # mix buses back to the output

name: Widen Then Slap
description: Double first, then a short slap on the wide image.
script:
# Widen Then Slap
# How it sounds: Double first, then a short slap on the wide image.
# a Width: 0.25 to 0.9, default 0.5
# b Slap: 60 to 120, default 88
# c Mix: 0.15 to 0.55, default 0.22

param a = Width [0.25, 0.9]
param b = Slap [60, 120]
param c = Mix [0.15, 0.55]
widen1: delay = 12; mix = a  # mono to stereo
delay1: time = b; feedback = 0.1; mix = c; damp = 4800  # delay line

name: Air Band Polish
description: Crossover: compress the air band and add a silk shelf there only.
script:
# Air Band Polish
# How it sounds: Crossover: compress the air band and add a silk shelf there only.
# a Silk: 0 to 5, default 2.2
# b Pull: 2 to 10, default 5
# c AirHz: 6000 to 11000, default 8000

param a = Silk [0, 5]
param b = Pull [2, 10]
param c = AirHz [6000, 11000]
xover1: f1 = 250; f2 = c  # crossover
bus mid:
  eq2: type = peak; freq = 1800; q = 0.8; gain = 0.6  # peak EQ
bus high:
  comp1: threshold = -b; ratio = 3; attack = 0.004; release = 0.08; makeup = 1  # compressor
  eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 12000; q = 0.45; gain = a  # high shelf
out: low = 1; mid = 1; high = 1  # mix buses back to the output

name: Pop Lead Desk
description: Full pop insert: HPF, FET, de-ess, slap send. Mix 100, send is built in.
script:
# Pop Lead Desk
# How it sounds: Full pop insert: HPF, FET, de-ess, slap send. Mix 100, send is built in.
# a Peak: 3 to 11, default 6
# b Ess: 3 to 12, default 6.5
# c Throw: 0.08 to 0.35, default 0.16

param a = Peak [3, 11]
param b = Ess [3, 12]
param c = Throw [0.08, 0.35]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 90; resonance = 0.24  # highpass
comp1: threshold = -a; ratio = 6; attack = 0.001; release = 0.08; makeup = 2.5  # compressor
xover1: f1 = 4800; f2 = 9500  # crossover
bus high:
  comp2: threshold = -b; ratio = 6; attack = 0.0008; release = 0.04  # compressor
bus throw:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  delay1: time = 1/8.; feedback = 0.22; mix = 1; damp = 4200  # delay line
out: low = 1; mid = 1; high = 1; throw = c  # mix buses back to the output

name: Intimate Whisper
description: Close whisper: high HPF, gentle gate, warm tube, no slap.
script:
# Intimate Whisper
# How it sounds: Close whisper: high HPF, gentle gate, warm tube, no slap.
# a Warm: 0.5 to 2.2, default 1.1
# b Open: -60 to -32, default -46
# c Air: 0 to 4, default 1.8

param a = Warm [0.5, 2.2]
param b = Open [-60, -32]
param c = Air [0, 4]
gate1: threshold = b; hyst = 4; hold = 0.04; range = -36  # noise gate
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 160; resonance = 0.2  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a)  # tube saturation
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 7500; q = 0.55; gain = c  # high shelf

name: Green Mid Into Amp
description: TS mid-hump into a soft tube stage and vintage cab. Rhythm DI.
script:
# Green Mid Into Amp
# How it sounds: TS mid-hump into a soft tube stage and vintage cab. Rhythm DI.
# a Drive: 1.5 to 10, default 5
# b Amp: 0.8 to 4.5, default 2.1
# c Tone: 1200 to 5500, default 2800

param a = Drive [1.5, 10]
param b = Amp [0.8, 4.5]
param c = Tone [1200, 5500]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 720; resonance = 0.28  # highpass
stage1: y = softclip(x, a)  # soft clip
eq1: type = peak; freq = 720; q = 1.6; gain = 5.5  # peak EQ
stage2: y = tube(y, b)  # tube saturation
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.4  # lowpass
ir1: mix = 0.5; gain = 2  # impulse response

name: Filter Dist Pedal
description: RAT-style: clip first, steep tone after, British cab. Not the stock RAT.
script:
# Filter Dist Pedal
# How it sounds: RAT-style: clip first, steep tone after, British cab. Not the stock RAT.
# a Dist: 2.5 to 12, default 7
# b Filter: 400 to 4200, default 1600
# c Cab: 0.2 to 0.7, default 0.42

param a = Dist [2.5, 12]
param b = Filter [400, 4200]
param c = Cab [0.2, 0.7]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 85; resonance = 0.32  # highpass
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x, a * 0.5), 0.5)  # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.62  # lowpass
ir1: mix = c; gain = 3  # impulse response

name: Tall Stack Fuzz
description: Muff-like stacked filters around a fold, then a dark cab.
script:
# Tall Stack Fuzz
# How it sounds: Muff-like stacked filters around a fold, then a dark cab.
# a Fuzz: 2 to 10, default 5.5
# b Scoop: 400 to 1400, default 800
# c Top: 1800 to 5000, default 3200

param a = Fuzz [2, 10]
param b = Scoop [400, 1400]
param c = Top [1800, 5000]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 70; resonance = 0.35  # highpass
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.45  # lowpass
stage1: y = fold(x, -0.35, 0.35)  # wavefold
stage2: y = softclip(y, a)  # soft clip
eq1: type = peak; freq = b; q = 0.9; gain = -5  # peak EQ
ir1: mix = 0.4; gain = 4  # impulse response

name: Clean Spring Send
description: Clean DI: light tube, then a spring send. Surf / country.
script:
# Clean Spring Send
# How it sounds: Clean DI: light tube, then a spring send. Surf / country.
# a Clean: 0.4 to 2, default 0.9
# b Spring: 0.18 to 0.5, default 0.3
# c Send: 0.12 to 0.55, default 0.28

param a = Clean [0.4, 2]
param b = Spring [0.18, 0.5]
param c = Send [0.12, 0.55]
stage1: y = tube(x, a)  # tube saturation
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 4500; q = 0.6; gain = 2  # high shelf
bus spring:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  reverb1: size = b; decay = 0.35; damp = 0.28; mix = 1; width = 0.4  # reverb
out: main = 1-c; spring = c  # mix buses back to the output

name: Chime Top End
description: AC-style chime without the stock AC30 graph: 2.2 kHz bell + open cab.
script:
# Chime Top End
# How it sounds: AC-style chime without the stock AC30 graph: 2.2 kHz bell + open cab.
# a Drive: 0.8 to 4, default 1.8
# b Bell: 1 to 7, default 3.6
# c Air: 5000 to 10000, default 8200

param a = Drive [0.8, 4]
param b = Bell [1, 7]
param c = Air [5000, 10000]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 480; resonance = 0.42  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a)  # tube saturation
eq1: type = peak; freq = 2200; q = 1.3; gain = b  # peak EQ
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.28  # lowpass
ir1: mix = 0.35; gain = 1  # impulse response

name: Scooped Rhythm Wall
description: High-gain rhythm: tight HPF, 400 Hz scoop, gate, American cab.
script:
# Scooped Rhythm Wall
# How it sounds: High-gain rhythm: tight HPF, 400 Hz scoop, gate, American cab.
# a Gain: 4 to 12, default 8
# b Tight: 55 to 160, default 90
# c Scoop: -8 to -2, default -4.5

param a = Gain [4, 12]
param b = Tight [55, 160]
param c = Scoop [-8, -2]
gate1: threshold = -44; hyst = 6; hold = 0.025; range = -78  # noise gate
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.55  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a * 0.55)  # tube saturation
stage2: y = tube(y, a * 0.4)  # tube saturation
eq1: type = peak; freq = 400; q = 1.05; gain = c  # peak EQ
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 4800; resonance = 0.5  # lowpass
ir1: mix = 0.48; gain = 0  # impulse response

name: Tight Gate Lead
description: Single-note lead: faster gate, 3.5 kHz presence, British cab.
script:
# Tight Gate Lead
# How it sounds: Single-note lead: faster gate, 3.5 kHz presence, British cab.
# a Gain: 3 to 11, default 6.5
# b Presence: 2 to 7, default 3.8
# c Gate: -50 to -28, default -38

param a = Gain [3, 11]
param b = Presence [2, 7]
param c = Gate [-50, -28]
gate1: threshold = c; hyst = 4; hold = 0.015; range = -75  # noise gate
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 130; resonance = 0.4  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a * 0.6)  # tube saturation
stage2: y = softclip(y, 1.6)  # soft clip
eq1: type = peak; freq = 3500; q = 1.2; gain = b  # peak EQ
ir1: mix = 0.46; gain = 1  # impulse response

name: Edge Of Breakup
description: One soft tube, no cab IR. Dynamic clean-to-crunch for pickers.
script:
# Edge Of Breakup
# How it sounds: One soft tube, no cab IR. Dynamic clean-to-crunch for pickers.
# a Push: 0.6 to 3.2, default 1.4
# b Low: 50 to 140, default 75
# c Top: 4500 to 9000, default 6800

param a = Push [0.6, 3.2]
param b = Low [50, 140]
param c = Top [4500, 9000]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.25  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a)  # tube saturation
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 3800; q = 0.6; gain = 1.8  # high shelf
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.26  # lowpass

name: Pedalboard Crunch
description: Klon-style clean blend into a crunch amp, medium cab.
script:
# Pedalboard Crunch
# How it sounds: Klon-style clean blend into a crunch amp, medium cab.
# a Pedal: 1 to 7, default 3.2
# b Amp: 1 to 5, default 2.2
# c Blend: 0.25 to 0.85, default 0.58

param a = Pedal [1, 7]
param b = Amp [1, 5]
param c = Blend [0.25, 0.85]
stage1: y = x  # waveshape / mix
bus dirt:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  stage2: y = diode(x, a)  # diode clip
  stage3: y = tube(y, b)  # tube saturation
  filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 6200; resonance = 0.35  # lowpass
  ir1: mix = 0.4; gain = 2  # impulse response
out: main = 1-c; dirt = c  # mix buses back to the output

name: Wet Dry Split Guitar
description: Left stays drier amp, right is delayed wet. Stereo DI / dual cab feel.

name: Script Phaser Guitar
description: Four-stage-ish phaser on a guitar insert. Slow swirl.
script:
# Script Phaser Guitar
# How it sounds: Four-stage-ish phaser on a guitar insert. Slow swirl.
# a Rate: 0.08 to 1.4, default 0.28
# b Depth: 400 to 2200, default 1100
# c Mix: 0.2 to 0.85, default 0.5

param a = Rate [0.08, 1.4]
param b = Depth [400, 2200]
param c = Mix [0.2, 0.85]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1  # LFO
stage1: y = x  # waveshape / mix
bus swirl:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  filter1: type = bandpass; center = 700 + osc1 * b; width = 500; resonance = 0.7  # bandpass
  filter2: type = bandpass; center = 1400 + osc1 * b * 0.7; width = 600; resonance = 0.65  # bandpass
out: main = 1-c; swirl = c  # mix buses back to the output

name: Analog Chorus Guitar
description: CE-style: short modulated delay, not a phaser.
script:
# Analog Chorus Guitar
# How it sounds: CE-style: short modulated delay, not a phaser.
# a Rate: 0.15 to 2.2, default 0.55
# b Depth: 4 to 18, default 9
# c Mix: 0.2 to 0.7, default 0.38

param a = Rate [0.15, 2.2]
param b = Depth [4, 18]
param c = Mix [0.2, 0.7]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1  # LFO
delay1: time = 12 + osc1 * b; feedback = 0.08; mix = c; damp = 7000  # delay line

name: Vibe Rotary Guitar
description: Uni-vibe cousin: AM plus a sweeping bandpass. Slow rotary.
script:
# Vibe Rotary Guitar
# How it sounds: Uni-vibe cousin: AM plus a sweeping bandpass. Slow rotary.
# a Rate: 0.2 to 3, default 0.7
# b Chorus: 300 to 1800, default 800
# c AM: 0.15 to 0.7, default 0.35

param a = Rate [0.2, 3]
param b = Chorus [300, 1800]
param c = AM [0.15, 0.7]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1  # LFO
filter1: type = bandpass; center = 900 + osc1 * b; width = 700; resonance = 0.8  # bandpass
stage1: y = x * (1 - c + c * (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1))  # waveshape / mix

name: Country Slap Guitar
description: Tele / country: clean tube, 95 ms slap, light spring.
script:
# Country Slap Guitar
# How it sounds: Tele / country: clean tube, 95 ms slap, light spring.
# a Clean: 0.4 to 2, default 0.85
# b Slap: 70 to 130, default 95
# c Room: 0.08 to 0.35, default 0.16

param a = Clean [0.4, 2]
param b = Slap [70, 130]
param c = Room [0.08, 0.35]
stage1: y = tube(x, a)  # tube saturation
delay1: time = b; feedback = 0.06; mix = 0.22; damp = 5200  # delay line
reverb1: size = 0.2; decay = c; damp = 0.4; mix = 0.18; width = 0.4  # reverb
ir1: mix = 0.3; gain = 2  # impulse response

name: Surf Spring Crash
description: Splashier spring than Clean Spring Send. More drip, more HPF.
script:
# Surf Spring Crash
# How it sounds: Splashier spring than Clean Spring Send. More drip, more HPF.
# a Drip: 0.25 to 0.7, default 0.42
# b Drive: 0.5 to 2.4, default 1.1
# c Splash: 0.2 to 0.65, default 0.38

param a = Drip [0.25, 0.7]
param b = Drive [0.5, 2.4]
param c = Splash [0.2, 0.65]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 160; resonance = 0.35  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, b)  # tube saturation
reverb1: size = a; decay = 0.55; damp = 0.22; mix = c; width = 0.35  # reverb

name: Jazz Box Warm
description: Hollow-body jazz: low cut gentle, dark LPF, tiny tube, no IR.
script:
# Jazz Box Warm
# How it sounds: Hollow-body jazz: low cut gentle, dark LPF, tiny tube, no IR.
# a Warm: 0.4 to 1.8, default 0.9
# b Dark: 1800 to 4500, default 2800
# c Body: 0 to 4, default 1.8

param a = Warm [0.4, 1.8]
param b = Dark [1800, 4500]
param c = Body [0, 4]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 70; resonance = 0.2  # highpass
eq1: type = peak; freq = 220; q = 0.8; gain = c  # peak EQ
stage1: y = tube(x, a)  # tube saturation
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.3  # lowpass

name: Funk Wah Env
description: Auto-wah for 16th funk. Envelope opens a bandpass.
script:
# Funk Wah Env
# How it sounds: Auto-wah for 16th funk. Envelope opens a bandpass.
# a Range: 400 to 2400, default 1400
# b Q: 0.8 to 2.4, default 1.5
# c Mix: 0.35 to 1, default 0.75

param a = Range [400, 2400]
param b = Q [0.8, 2.4]
param c = Mix [0.35, 1]
env1: attack = 0.004; release = 0.08  # envelope follower
stage1: y = x  # waveshape / mix
bus wah:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  filter1: type = bandpass; center = 350 + env1 * a; width = 400; resonance = b  # bandpass
out: main = 1-c; wah = c  # mix buses back to the output

name: Metal Scoop Cab
description: Modern metal: 90 Hz tight, 400 scoop, 1.5 kHz bark, dark cab.
script:
# Metal Scoop Cab
# How it sounds: Modern metal: 90 Hz tight, 400 scoop, 1.5 kHz bark, dark cab.
# a Gain: 5 to 13, default 8.5
# b Bark: 1 to 6, default 3.2
# c Cab: 0.3 to 0.7, default 0.5

param a = Gain [5, 13]
param b = Bark [1, 6]
param c = Cab [0.3, 0.7]
gate1: threshold = -42; hyst = 5; hold = 0.02; range = -80  # noise gate
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 90; resonance = 0.58  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a * 0.5)  # tube saturation
stage2: y = hardclip(softclip(y, 1.4), 0.62)  # soft clip
eq1: type = peak; freq = 400; q = 1.1; gain = -6  # peak EQ
eq2: type = peak; freq = 1500; q = 1.15; gain = b  # peak EQ
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 4200; resonance = 0.48  # lowpass
ir1: mix = c; gain = 0  # impulse response

name: British Crunch Stack
description: Two British-voiced tubes, 800 Hz bark, no American scoop.
script:
# British Crunch Stack
# How it sounds: Two British-voiced tubes, 800 Hz bark, no American scoop.
# a Drive: 1.6 to 8, default 3.8
# b Bark: 2 to 7, default 4
# c Cab: 0.25 to 0.65, default 0.42

param a = Drive [1.6, 8]
param b = Bark [2, 7]
param c = Cab [0.25, 0.65]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 110; resonance = 0.38  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a * 0.65)  # tube saturation
stage2: y = tube(y, a * 0.5)  # tube saturation
eq1: type = peak; freq = 800; q = 1.05; gain = b  # peak EQ
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 5600; resonance = 0.4  # lowpass
ir1: mix = c; gain = 1  # impulse response

name: American Clean Cab
description: Blackface cousin with IR. Brighter and more open than Edge Of Breakup.
script:
# American Clean Cab
# How it sounds: Blackface cousin with IR. Brighter and more open than Edge Of Breakup.
# a Drive: 0.4 to 2.2, default 0.95
# b Bright: 0 to 6, default 3
# c Cab: 0.2 to 0.6, default 0.38

param a = Drive [0.4, 2.2]
param b = Bright [0, 6]
param c = Cab [0.2, 0.6]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 50; resonance = 0.2  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a)  # tube saturation
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 5200; q = 0.55; gain = b  # high shelf
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 9800; resonance = 0.22  # lowpass
ir1: mix = c; gain = 2  # impulse response

name: Lead Presence Stack
description: Lead: 4 kHz shelf, slower gate, medium cab. Sings above a rhythm wall.
script:
# Lead Presence Stack
# How it sounds: Lead: 4 kHz shelf, slower gate, medium cab. Sings above a rhythm wall.
# a Gain: 3 to 10, default 6
# b Air: 1 to 6, default 3
# c Sustain: 0.02 to 0.12, default 0.05

param a = Gain [3, 10]
param b = Air [1, 6]
param c = Sustain [0.02, 0.12]
gate1: threshold = -40; hyst = 4; hold = c; range = -70  # noise gate
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 140; resonance = 0.35  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a * 0.7)  # tube saturation
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 4000; q = 0.6; gain = b  # high shelf
ir1: mix = 0.44; gain = 1  # impulse response

name: Rhythm Mid Scoop
description: Palm-mute rhythm. Deeper 280 Hz scoop than Scooped Rhythm Wall, less gain.
script:
# Rhythm Mid Scoop
# How it sounds: Palm-mute rhythm. Deeper 280 Hz scoop than Scooped Rhythm Wall, less gain.
# a Gain: 3 to 9, default 5.5
# b Scoop: -9 to -2, default -5
# c Click: 1 to 5, default 2.6

param a = Gain [3, 9]
param b = Scoop [-9, -2]
param c = Click [1, 5]
gate1: threshold = -46; hyst = 6; hold = 0.03; range = -78  # noise gate
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 100; resonance = 0.5  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a * 0.55)  # tube saturation
eq1: type = peak; freq = 280; q = 1.2; gain = b  # peak EQ
eq2: type = peak; freq = 1800; q = 1.1; gain = c  # peak EQ
ir1: mix = 0.45; gain = 0  # impulse response

name: Single Coil Bright
description: Strat / tele: 5 kHz silk, light breakup, vintage cab.
script:
# Single Coil Bright
# How it sounds: Strat / tele: 5 kHz silk, light breakup, vintage cab.
# a Push: 0.5 to 2.6, default 1.2
# b Silk: 1 to 6, default 3.2
# c Grit: 0.4 to 1.8, default 0.8

param a = Push [0.5, 2.6]
param b = Silk [1, 6]
param c = Grit [0.4, 1.8]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 90; resonance = 0.28  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a)  # tube saturation
stage2: y = diode(y, c)  # diode clip
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 5200; q = 0.55; gain = b  # high shelf
ir1: mix = 0.32; gain = 2  # impulse response

name: Humbucker Thick
description: LP / humbucker: 200 Hz body, darker LPF, British cab.
script:
# Humbucker Thick
# How it sounds: LP / humbucker: 200 Hz body, darker LPF, British cab.
# a Drive: 1 to 5, default 2.4
# b Body: 1 to 6, default 3
# c Dark: 3200 to 6500, default 4800

param a = Drive [1, 5]
param b = Body [1, 6]
param c = Dark [3200, 6500]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 70; resonance = 0.28  # highpass
eq1: type = peak; freq = 200; q = 0.85; gain = b  # peak EQ
stage1: y = tube(x, a)  # tube saturation
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.35  # lowpass
ir1: mix = 0.42; gain = 1  # impulse response

name: Acoustic Sim Box
description: Electric to faux-acoustic: notch body, high bandpass, tiny room.
script:
# Acoustic Sim Box
# How it sounds: Electric to faux-acoustic: notch body, high bandpass, tiny room.
# a Body: 200 to 500, default 320
# b Notch: -10 to -3, default -6
# c Room: 0.08 to 0.3, default 0.16

param a = Body [200, 500]
param b = Notch [-10, -3]
param c = Room [0.08, 0.3]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 90; resonance = 0.3  # highpass
eq1: type = peak; freq = a; q = 2.2; gain = b  # peak EQ
filter2: type = bandpass; center = 1800; width = 1400; resonance = 0.45  # bandpass
reverb1: size = 0.18; decay = c; damp = 0.45; mix = 0.16; width = 0.5  # reverb

name: Twelve String Chorus
description: Short stereo chorus + sparkle shelf. 12-string illusion.
script:
# Twelve String Chorus
# How it sounds: Short stereo chorus + sparkle shelf. 12-string illusion.
# a Rate: 0.4 to 2.5, default 1.1
# b Depth: 5 to 16, default 9
# c Sparkle: 1 to 5, default 2.4

param a = Rate [0.4, 2.5]
param b = Depth [5, 16]
param c = Sparkle [1, 5]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1  # LFO
delay1: time = 9 + osc1 * b; feedback = 0.05; mix = 0.4; damp = 8000  # delay line
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 6500; q = 0.5; gain = c  # high shelf

name: Slide Dirt Bed
description: Slide guitar: long sustain tube, dark, small room, no gate.
script:
# Slide Dirt Bed
# How it sounds: Slide guitar: long sustain tube, dark, small room, no gate.
# a Sustain: 1.2 to 5, default 2.6
# b Dark: 2200 to 5200, default 3400
# c Room: 0.1 to 0.4, default 0.2

param a = Sustain [1.2, 5]
param b = Dark [2200, 5200]
param c = Room [0.1, 0.4]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 100; resonance = 0.25  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a)  # tube saturation
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.32  # lowpass
reverb1: size = 0.28; decay = c; damp = 0.5; mix = 0.22; width = 0.45  # reverb

name: Ambient Swell Guitar
description: Volume-swell pad: slow env opens a hall. Post-rock.
script:
# Ambient Swell Guitar
# How it sounds: Volume-swell pad: slow env opens a hall. Post-rock.
# a Rise: 0.05 to 0.4, default 0.16
# b Hall: 0.4 to 0.85, default 0.62
# c Blend: 0.25 to 0.75, default 0.48

param a = Rise [0.05, 0.4]
param b = Hall [0.4, 0.85]
param c = Blend [0.25, 0.75]
env1: attack = a; release = 0.35  # envelope follower
stage1: y = x * (0.15 + 0.85 * env1)  # waveshape / mix
reverb1: size = b; decay = 2.2; damp = 0.4; mix = c; width = 0.8  # reverb

name: Volume Bloom Lead
description: Env swells a tube lead into a short plate. Cinematic lead.
script:
# Volume Bloom Lead
# How it sounds: Env swells a tube lead into a short plate. Cinematic lead.
# a Drive: 1.2 to 6, default 3
# b Bloom: 0.04 to 0.22, default 0.09
# c Plate: 0.15 to 0.5, default 0.28

param a = Drive [1.2, 6]
param b = Bloom [0.04, 0.22]
param c = Plate [0.15, 0.5]
env1: attack = b; release = 0.18  # envelope follower
stage1: y = tube(x * (0.2 + 0.8 * env1), a)  # tube saturation
reverb1: size = 0.3; decay = c; damp = 0.38; mix = 0.28; width = 0.6  # reverb
ir1: mix = 0.3; gain = 1  # impulse response

name: DI Amp Blend Bass
description: Clean DI plus a grind bus. Blend is the amp. Mix 100.
script:
# DI Amp Blend Bass
# How it sounds: Clean DI plus a grind bus. Blend is the amp. Mix 100.
# a Grind: 1 to 6, default 2.8
# b Blend: 0.15 to 0.7, default 0.38
# c Low: 40 to 90, default 55

param a = Grind [1, 6]
param b = Blend [0.15, 0.7]
param c = Low [40, 90]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.25  # highpass
stage1: y = x  # waveshape / mix
bus amp:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  stage2: y = tube(x, a)  # tube saturation
  filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 4200; resonance = 0.35  # lowpass
  ir1: mix = 0.35; gain = 2  # impulse response
out: main = 1-b; amp = b  # mix buses back to the output

name: Pick Attack Bass
description: Env boosts 2 kHz click on picked bass. Insert.
script:
# Pick Attack Bass
# How it sounds: Env boosts 2 kHz click on picked bass. Insert.
# a Click: 0 to 7, default 3.2
# b Fast: 0.003 to 0.03, default 0.01
# c Low: 40 to 100, default 50

param a = Click [0, 7]
param b = Fast [0.003, 0.03]
param c = Body [40, 100]
env1: type = peak; attack = 0.001; release = b  # envelope follower
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.22  # highpass
eq1: type = peak; freq = 2100; q = 1.3; gain = a * env1  # peak EQ

name: Fretless Warm Bass
description: Dark LPF, slow opto, no click. Fretless / synth bass.
script:
# Fretless Warm Bass
# How it sounds: Dark LPF, slow opto, no click. Fretless / synth bass.
# a Dark: 1200 to 4000, default 2400
# b Ride: 3 to 10, default 6
# c Tube: 0.4 to 1.8, default 0.9

param a = Dark [1200, 4000]
param b = Ride [3, 10]
param c = Tube [0.4, 1.8]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 35; resonance = 0.2  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, c)  # tube saturation
comp1: threshold = -b; ratio = 3; attack = 0.02; release = 0.28; knee = 8; makeup = 2  # compressor
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = a; resonance = 0.28  # lowpass

name: Synth Sub Round
description: 808 / sine sub: HPF 25, soft clip, tiny even harmonics.
script:
# Synth Sub Round
# How it sounds: 808 / sine sub: HPF 25, soft clip, tiny even harmonics.
# a Round: 0.4 to 2.2, default 1
# b Floor: 22 to 45, default 28
# c Ceiling: 0.4 to 0.95, default 0.72

param a = Round [0.4, 2.2]
param b = Floor [22, 45]
param c = Ceiling [0.4, 0.95]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.18  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a)  # tube saturation
stage2: y = hardclip(softclip(y, 1.1), c)  # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 180; resonance = 0.25  # lowpass

name: Slap Bass Pop
description: Slap bass: 3 kHz pop, fast FET, high HPF.
script:
# Slap Bass Pop
# How it sounds: Slap bass: 3 kHz pop, fast FET, high HPF.
# a Pop: 1 to 7, default 3.4
# b Peak: 3 to 11, default 6
# c Cut: 60 to 140, default 90

param a = Pop [1, 7]
param b = Peak [3, 11]
param c = Cut [60, 140]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.3  # highpass
eq1: type = peak; freq = 3000; q = 1.4; gain = a  # peak EQ
comp1: threshold = -b; ratio = 8; attack = 0.0006; release = 0.06; makeup = 2  # compressor

name: Bass DI Chorus
description: Chorus only above 200 Hz so the sub stays mono.
script:
# Bass DI Chorus
# How it sounds: Chorus only above 200 Hz so the sub stays mono.
# a Rate: 0.2 to 1.8, default 0.55
# b Depth: 4 to 14, default 8
# c Mix: 0.15 to 0.55, default 0.3

param a = Rate [0.2, 1.8]
param b = Depth [4, 14]
param c = Mix [0.15, 0.55]
xover1: f1 = 200  # crossover
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1  # LFO
bus high:
  delay1: time = 10 + osc1 * b; feedback = 0.06; mix = c; damp = 6000  # delay line
out: low = 1; high = 1  # mix buses back to the output

name: Grit Mid Bass
description: Saturate 400–800 Hz only. Sub stays clean.
script:
# Grit Mid Bass
# How it sounds: Saturate 400–800 Hz only. Sub stays clean.
# a Grit: 1 to 5, default 2.4
# b Low: 180 to 400, default 280
# c High: 700 to 1400, default 900

param a = Grit [1, 5]
param b = Low [180, 400]
param c = High [700, 1400]
xover1: f1 = b; f2 = c  # crossover
bus mid:
  stage1: y = diode(x, a)  # diode clip
out: low = 1; mid = 1; high = 1  # mix buses back to the output

name: Bass Amp Cab Only
description: No extra clip: just HPF, British cab, gentle LPF.
script:
# Bass Amp Cab Only
# How it sounds: No extra clip: just HPF, British cab, gentle LPF.
# a Cut: 30 to 80, default 45
# b Cab: 0.25 to 0.75, default 0.48
# c Top: 2500 to 6000, default 4000

param a = Cut [30, 80]
param b = Cab [0.25, 0.75]
param c = Top [2500, 6000]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = a; resonance = 0.22  # highpass
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.28  # lowpass
ir1: mix = b; gain = 3  # impulse response

name: Sidechain Duck Bass
description: Bass ducks from the host sidechain (kick). Mix 100.
script:
# Sidechain Duck Bass
# How it sounds: Bass ducks from the host sidechain (kick). Mix 100.
# a Depth: 0.2 to 0.9, default 0.55
# b Release: 0.04 to 0.28, default 0.12
# c Floor: 25 to 50, default 32

param a = Depth [0.2, 0.9]
param b = Release [0.04, 0.28]
param c = Floor [25, 50]
sidechain1: mix = a  # host sidechain
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.2  # highpass
comp1: threshold = -18; ratio = 6; attack = 0.001; release = b; source = sidechain; makeup = 0  # compressor

name: Octave Dirt Bass
description: Sub octave then a tight tube. Not Precision Octaver alone.
script:
# Octave Dirt Bass
# How it sounds: Sub octave then a tight tube. Not Precision Octaver alone.
# a Sub: 0.2 to 0.9, default 0.45
# b Dirt: 0.8 to 3.5, default 1.6
# c Low: 30 to 70, default 42

param a = Sub [0.2, 0.9]
param b = Dirt [0.8, 3.5]
param c = Low [30, 70]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.2  # highpass
octaver1: mix = a; sub = 1; up = 0; tone = 160; thresh = 0.05  # analog octaver
stage1: y = tube(x, b)  # tube saturation
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 3500; resonance = 0.3  # lowpass

name: Mute Click Bass
description: Palm-mute bass: gate + 1.2 kHz click, no cab.
script:
# Mute Click Bass
# How it sounds: Palm-mute bass: gate + 1.2 kHz click, no cab.
# a Open: -50 to -28, default -38
# b Click: 0 to 6, default 2.8
# c Tight: 50 to 120, default 75

param a = Open [-50, -28]
param b = Click [0, 6]
param c = Tight [50, 120]
gate1: threshold = a; hyst = 5; hold = 0.02; range = -70  # noise gate
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.4  # highpass
eq1: type = peak; freq = 1200; q = 1.4; gain = b  # peak EQ

name: Motown Bass Round
description: Round fingerstyle: 100 Hz bump, slow comp, vintage cab.
script:
# Motown Bass Round
# How it sounds: Round fingerstyle: 100 Hz bump, slow comp, vintage cab.
# a Boom: 1 to 6, default 3
# b Glue: 3 to 9, default 5.5
# c Cab: 0.15 to 0.5, default 0.28

param a = Boom [1, 6]
param b = Glue [3, 9]
param c = Cab [0.15, 0.5]
eq1: type = peak; freq = 100; q = 0.8; gain = a  # peak EQ
comp1: threshold = -b; ratio = 3; attack = 0.025; release = 0.22; makeup = 2  # compressor
ir1: mix = c; gain = 2  # impulse response

name: Fuzz Bass Stack
description: Fuzz on a bus, dry sub stays. Blend is fuzz.
script:
# Fuzz Bass Stack
# How it sounds: Fuzz on a bus, dry sub stays. Blend is fuzz.
# a Fuzz: 2 to 9, default 4.5
# b Blend: 0.12 to 0.55, default 0.28
# c Tone: 800 to 3500, default 1800

param a = Fuzz [2, 9]
param b = Blend [0.12, 0.55]
param c = Tone [800, 3500]
stage1: y = x  # waveshape / mix
bus fuzz:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 80; resonance = 0.3  # highpass
  stage2: y = fold(x, -0.3, 0.3)  # wavefold
  stage3: y = softclip(y, a)  # soft clip
  filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.4  # lowpass
out: main = 1-b; fuzz = b  # mix buses back to the output

name: Bass Limit Polish
description: Transparent peak control after a DI. No tone change.
script:
# Bass Limit Polish
# How it sounds: Transparent peak control after a DI. No tone change.
# a Ceiling: -4 to -0.2, default -1
# b Release: 0.04 to 0.2, default 0.09
# c Low: 25 to 50, default 32

param a = Ceiling [-4, -0.2]
param b = Release [0.04, 0.2]
param c = Low [25, 50]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.18  # highpass
limit1: ceiling = a; release = b  # limiter

name: Direct Amp SVT Dark
description: Darker SVT cousin: more 200 Hz, less top, medium cab.
script:
# Direct Amp SVT Dark
# How it sounds: Darker SVT cousin: more 200 Hz, less top, medium cab.
# a Drive: 1.2 to 6, default 2.8
# b Wool: 1 to 6, default 3.2
# c Cab: 0.3 to 0.7, default 0.48

param a = Drive [1.2, 6]
param b = Wool [1, 6]
param c = Cab [0.3, 0.7]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 40; resonance = 0.25  # highpass
eq1: type = peak; freq = 200; q = 0.85; gain = b  # peak EQ
stage1: y = tube(x, a)  # tube saturation
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 3200; resonance = 0.32  # lowpass
ir1: mix = c; gain = 1  # impulse response

name: Sub Only Octave
description: Just the analog sub, no dry. Bass / guitar. Mix to taste in the host.
script:
# Sub Only Octave
# How it sounds: Just the analog sub, no dry. Bass / guitar. Mix to taste in the host.
# a Tone: 80 to 400, default 180
# b Level: 0.3 to 1.2, default 0.7
# c Low: 30 to 80, default 45

param a = Tone [80, 400]
param b = Level [0.3, 1.2]
param c = Low [30, 80]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.2  # highpass
octaver1: mix = 1; sub = 1; up = 0; tone = a; thresh = 0.05  # analog octaver
stage1: y = x * b  # waveshape / mix
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 400; resonance = 0.25  # lowpass

name: Up Octave Chime
description: Plus-one only, bright. 12-string / lead sparkle.
script:
# Up Octave Chime
# How it sounds: Plus-one only, bright. 12-string / lead sparkle.
# a Mix: 0.15 to 0.7, default 0.35
# b Tone: 200 to 800, default 420
# c Air: 1 to 5, default 2.2

param a = Mix [0.15, 0.7]
param b = Tone [200, 800]
param c = Air [1, 5]
octaver1: mix = a; sub = 0; up = 1; tone = b; thresh = 0.05  # analog octaver
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 6000; q = 0.5; gain = c  # high shelf

name: Both Octaves Stack
description: Sub + up together, mid scoop so it does not pile.
script:
# Both Octaves Stack
# How it sounds: Sub + up together, mid scoop so it does not pile.
# a Mix: 0.2 to 0.8, default 0.45
# b Scoop: -6 to 0, default -2.5
# c Tone: 120 to 600, default 280

param a = Mix [0.2, 0.8]
param b = Scoop [-6, 0]
param c = Tone [0.25, 0.75]
octaver1: mix = a; sub = 1; up = 1; tone = c; thresh = 0.05  # analog octaver
eq1: type = peak; freq = 500; q = 0.9; gain = b  # peak EQ

name: Octave Into Dirt
description: Octave then diode. Synth-bass / riff.
script:
# Octave Into Dirt
# How it sounds: Octave then diode. Synth-bass / riff.
# a Mix: 0.25 to 0.85, default 0.5
# b Dirt: 1 to 5, default 2.2
# c Tone: 900 to 4000, default 2200

param a = Mix [0.25, 0.85]
param b = Dirt [1, 5]
param c = Tone [900, 4000]
octaver1: mix = a; sub = 1; up = 0; tone = 180; thresh = 0.05  # analog octaver
stage1: y = diode(x, b)  # diode clip
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.35  # lowpass

name: Octave Then Gate
description: Octave plus a tight gate so muted notes die.
script:
# Octave Then Gate
# How it sounds: Octave plus a tight gate so muted notes die.
# a Mix: 0.2 to 0.75, default 0.42
# b Open: -48 to -26, default -36
# c Hold: 0.01 to 0.08, default 0.03

param a = Mix [0.2, 0.75]
param b = Open [-48, -26]
param c = Hold [0.01, 0.08]
octaver1: mix = a; sub = 1; up = 0; tone = 170; thresh = 0.05  # analog octaver
gate1: threshold = b; hyst = 5; hold = c; range = -72  # noise gate

name: Harmony Bed Octave
description: Quiet up-octave into a small hall. Pad / harmony.
script:
# Harmony Bed Octave
# How it sounds: Quiet up-octave into a small hall. Pad / harmony.
# a Mix: 0.1 to 0.45, default 0.22
# b Hall: 0.2 to 0.55, default 0.35
# c Blend: 0.1 to 0.4, default 0.2

param a = Mix [0.1, 0.45]
param b = Hall [0.2, 0.55]
param c = Blend [0.1, 0.4]
octaver1: mix = a; sub = 0; up = 1; tone = 360; thresh = 0.05  # analog octaver
reverb1: size = b; decay = 0.8; damp = 0.4; mix = c; width = 0.7  # reverb

name: Tracking Octave Tight
description: Higher track threshold, less flutter on busy parts.
script:
# Tracking Octave Tight
# How it sounds: Higher track threshold, less flutter on busy parts.
# a Mix: 0.2 to 0.8, default 0.48
# b Track: 0.02 to 0.14, default 0.07
# c Tone: 80 to 400, default 180

param a = Mix [0.2, 0.8]
param b = Track [0.02, 0.14]
param c = Tone [80, 400]
octaver1: mix = a; sub = 1; up = 0; tone = c; thresh = b  # analog octaver
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 40; resonance = 0.2  # highpass

name: Vocoder Formant Shift
description: Vocoder as a formant color, self if no sidechain. Voice / synth.
script:
# Vocoder Formant Shift
# How it sounds: Vocoder as a formant color, self if no sidechain. Voice / synth.
# a Formant: 0.6 to 1.6, default 1.05
# b Mix: 0.2 to 1, default 0.55
# c Q: 0.8 to 3.5, default 1.6

param a = Formant [0.6, 1.6]
param b = Mix [0.2, 1]
param c = Q [0.8, 3.5]
vocoder1: bands = 16; formant = a; mix = b; q = c  # vocoder (voice on Sidechain)

name: Vocoder Talk Box
description: Narrower, more mouth. Sidechain voice recommended.
script:
# Vocoder Talk Box
# How it sounds: Narrower, more mouth. Sidechain voice recommended.
# a Formant: 0.7 to 1.8, default 1.2
# b Mix: 0.3 to 1, default 0.7
# c Tone: 2000 to 7000, default 4500

param a = Formant [0.7, 1.8]
param b = Mix [0.3, 1]
param c = Tone [2000, 7000]
vocoder1: bands = 12; formant = a; mix = b  # vocoder (voice on Sidechain)
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.3  # lowpass

name: Octave Shimmer Send
description: Up-octave into a long verb on a send. Honest shimmer, not pitch-shift feedback.
script:
# Octave Shimmer Send
# How it sounds: Up-octave into a long verb on a send. Honest shimmer, not pitch-shift feedback.
# a Mix: 0.15 to 0.6, default 0.32
# b Hall: 0.4 to 0.85, default 0.62
# c Blend: 0.15 to 0.55, default 0.28

param a = Mix [0.15, 0.6]
param b = Hall [0.4, 0.85]
param c = Blend [0.15, 0.55]
stage1: y = x  # waveshape / mix
bus shine:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  octaver1: mix = a; sub = 0; up = 1; tone = 400; thresh = 0.05  # analog octaver
  reverb1: size = b; decay = 2.4; damp = 0.35; mix = 1; width = 0.85  # reverb
out: main = 1-c; shine = c  # mix buses back to the output

name: Bass Synth Stack
description: Sub octave + fold + LPF. Acid / reese cousin, not Acid Hash.
script:
# Bass Synth Stack
# How it sounds: Sub octave + fold + LPF. Acid / reese cousin, not Acid Hash.
# a Sub: 0.3 to 0.9, default 0.55
# b Fold: 0.15 to 0.5, default 0.28
# c Cut: 400 to 2200, default 1100

param a = Sub [0.3, 0.9]
param b = Fold [0.15, 0.5]
param c = Cut [400, 2200]
octaver1: mix = a; sub = 1; up = 0; tone = 140; thresh = 0.05  # analog octaver
stage1: y = fold(x, -b, b)  # wavefold
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.55  # lowpass

name: Straight Eighth Pop
description: Pop insert delay. Straight 1/8, darker than 2290.
script:
# Straight Eighth Pop
# How it sounds: Pop insert delay. Straight 1/8, darker than 2290.
# a Feedback: 0.08 to 0.55, default 0.22
# b Tone: 1800 to 7000, default 4800
# c Mix: 0.12 to 0.55, default 0.28

param a = Feedback [0.08, 0.55]
param b = Tone [1800, 7000]
param c = Mix [0.12, 0.55]
delay1: time = 1/8; feedback = a; mix = c; damp = b  # delay line

name: Triplet Delay
description: Shuffle / swing throw. 1/8 triplet.
script:
# Triplet Delay
# How it sounds: Shuffle / swing throw. 1/8 triplet.
# a Feedback: 0.08 to 0.55, default 0.28
# b Tone: 1800 to 7000, default 4200
# c Mix: 0.12 to 0.55, default 0.28

param a = Feedback [0.08, 0.55]
param b = Tone [1800, 7000]
param c = Mix [0.12, 0.55]
delay1: time = 1/8t; feedback = a; mix = c; damp = b  # delay line

name: Sixteenth Sprinkle
description: Tight 1/16 sprinkle. Rhythm guitar / hat.
script:
# Sixteenth Sprinkle
# How it sounds: Tight 1/16 sprinkle. Rhythm guitar / hat.
# a Feedback: 0.08 to 0.55, default 0.12
# b Tone: 1800 to 7000, default 5500
# c Mix: 0.12 to 0.55, default 0.28

param a = Feedback [0.08, 0.55]
param b = Tone [1800, 7000]
param c = Mix [0.12, 0.55]
delay1: time = 1/16; feedback = a; mix = c; damp = b  # delay line

name: Half Note Wash
description: Slow wash. Ballad guitar / vocal.
script:
# Half Note Wash
# How it sounds: Slow wash. Ballad guitar / vocal.
# a Feedback: 0.08 to 0.55, default 0.35
# b Tone: 1800 to 7000, default 3800
# c Mix: 0.12 to 0.55, default 0.28

param a = Feedback [0.08, 0.55]
param b = Tone [1800, 7000]
param c = Mix [0.12, 0.55]
delay1: time = 1/2; feedback = a; mix = c; damp = b  # delay line

name: Dotted Quarter Dub
description: Dub delay. Dotted 1/4, more feedback.
script:
# Dotted Quarter Dub
# How it sounds: Dub delay. Dotted 1/4, more feedback.
# a Feedback: 0.08 to 0.55, default 0.42
# b Tone: 1800 to 7000, default 3200
# c Mix: 0.12 to 0.55, default 0.28

param a = Feedback [0.08, 0.55]
param b = Tone [1800, 7000]
param c = Mix [0.12, 0.55]
delay1: time = 1/4.; feedback = a; mix = c; damp = b  # delay line

name: Dub Feedback Cave
description: High feedback, dark, then a tiny room. Dub send.
script:
# Dub Feedback Cave
# How it sounds: High feedback, dark, then a tiny room. Dub send.
# a Feedback: 0.35 to 0.72, default 0.52
# b Cave: 0.2 to 0.55, default 0.34
# c Mix: 0.15 to 0.5, default 0.3

param a = Feedback [0.35, 0.72]
param b = Cave [0.2, 0.55]
param c = Mix [0.15, 0.5]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 180; resonance = 0.25  # highpass
delay1: time = 1/4; feedback = a; mix = 1; damp = 2800  # delay line
reverb1: size = b; decay = 0.6; damp = 0.55; mix = 0.25; width = 0.5  # reverb
stage1: y = x * c  # waveshape / mix

name: Dark Bucket Brigade
description: BBD cousin: HPF, dark damp, slight diode. Not Memory Man.
script:
# Dark Bucket Brigade
# How it sounds: BBD cousin: HPF, dark damp, slight diode. Not Memory Man.
# a Time: 180 to 520, default 320
# b Feedback: 0.15 to 0.5, default 0.3
# c Mix: 0.15 to 0.5, default 0.28

param a = Time [180, 520]
param b = Feedback [0.15, 0.5]
param c = Mix [0.15, 0.5]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 220; resonance = 0.3  # highpass
delay1: time = a; feedback = b; mix = c; damp = 2400  # delay line
stage1: y = diode(x, 1.15)  # diode clip

name: Bright Digital Grid
description: Clean 1/8 grid, bright damp, no analog dirt.
script:
# Bright Digital Grid
# How it sounds: Clean 1/8 grid, bright damp, no analog dirt.
# a Feedback: 0.08 to 0.4, default 0.18
# b Mix: 0.12 to 0.45, default 0.24
# c Air: 0 to 4, default 1.5

param a = Feedback [0.08, 0.4]
param b = Mix [0.12, 0.45]
param c = Air [0, 4]
delay1: time = 1/8; feedback = a; mix = b; damp = 9000  # delay line
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 7000; q = 0.5; gain = c  # high shelf

name: Multi Tap Stair
description: Two taps: 1/8 then 1/4. Stair echo.
script:
# Multi Tap Stair
# How it sounds: Two taps: 1/8 then 1/4. Stair echo.
# a Short: 0.08 to 0.35, default 0.16
# b Long: 0.1 to 0.4, default 0.2
# c Mix: 0.15 to 0.5, default 0.28

param a = Short [0.08, 0.35]
param b = Long [0.1, 0.4]
param c = Mix [0.15, 0.5]
delay1: time = 1/8; feedback = a; mix = c * 0.6; damp = 5000  # delay line
delay2: time = 1/4; feedback = b; mix = c * 0.5; damp = 4000  # delay line

name: Mid Only Echo
description: Delay on the mid only. Sides stay dry.
script:
# Mid Only Echo
# How it sounds: Delay on the mid only. Sides stay dry.
# a Time: 0 to 1, default 0.5
# b Feedback: 0.12 to 0.45, default 0.24
# c Mix: 0.15 to 0.5, default 0.28

param a = Time [1/8, 1/4]
param b = Feedback [0.12, 0.45]
param c = Mix [0.15, 0.5]
ms1: mode = encode  # mid/side encode
delay1: channel = mid; time = 1/8; feedback = b; mix = c; damp = 4500  # delay line
ms2: mode = decode  # mid/side decode

name: Side Only Echo
description: Delay on the sides only. Center stays the dry word.
script:
# Side Only Echo
# How it sounds: Delay on the sides only. Center stays the dry word.
# a Feedback: 0.12 to 0.5, default 0.26
# b Mix: 0.15 to 0.55, default 0.3
# c Tone: 2500 to 7000, default 4200

param a = Feedback [0.12, 0.5]
param b = Mix [0.15, 0.55]
param c = Tone [2500, 7000]
ms1: mode = encode  # mid/side encode
delay1: channel = side; time = 1/8.; feedback = a; mix = b; damp = c  # delay line
ms2: mode = decode  # mid/side decode

name: Filtered Throw
description: Band-limited throw. 300–3 kHz into the delay.
script:
# Filtered Throw
# How it sounds: Band-limited throw. 300–3 kHz into the delay.
# a Feedback: 0.12 to 0.48, default 0.24
# b Mix: 0.12 to 0.5, default 0.26
# c Top: 2000 to 5000, default 3200

param a = Feedback [0.12, 0.48]
param b = Mix [0.12, 0.5]
param c = Top [2000, 5000]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 300; resonance = 0.25  # highpass
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.28  # lowpass
delay1: time = 1/8.; feedback = a; mix = b; damp = 4000  # delay line

name: Long Wash Delay
description: Long ms delay, low feedback, for pads.
script:
# Long Wash Delay
# How it sounds: Long ms delay, low feedback, for pads.
# a Time: 380 to 900, default 560
# b Feedback: 0.08 to 0.32, default 0.16
# c Mix: 0.15 to 0.55, default 0.3

param a = Time [380, 900]
param b = Feedback [0.08, 0.32]
param c = Mix [0.15, 0.55]
delay1: time = a; feedback = b; mix = c; damp = 3600  # delay line
reverb1: size = 0.3; decay = 0.5; damp = 0.45; mix = 0.12; width = 0.6  # reverb

name: Slap Room Combo
description: 90 ms slap then a booth. Guitar / vocal send.
script:
# Slap Room Combo
# How it sounds: 90 ms slap then a booth. Guitar / vocal send.
# a Slap: 70 to 130, default 92
# b Room: 0.12 to 0.4, default 0.22
# c Mix: 0.15 to 0.5, default 0.26

param a = Slap [70, 130]
param b = Room [0.12, 0.4]
param c = Mix [0.15, 0.5]
delay1: time = a; feedback = 0.07; mix = c; damp = 4800  # delay line
reverb1: size = b; decay = 0.25; damp = 0.5; mix = 0.18; width = 0.45  # reverb

name: Swell Delay Rise
description: Env opens delay mix. Reverse-feel swell, not true reverse.
script:
# Swell Delay Rise
# How it sounds: Env opens delay mix. Reverse-feel swell, not true reverse.
# a Rise: 0.05 to 0.3, default 0.12
# b Time: 0 to 1, default 0.5
# c Feedback: 0.15 to 0.45, default 0.26

param a = Rise [0.05, 0.3]
param b = Time [1/8, 1/4]
param c = Feedback [0.15, 0.45]
env1: attack = a; release = 0.2  # envelope follower
delay1: time = 1/4; feedback = c; mix = 0.15 + env1 * 0.45; damp = 4000  # delay line

name: Ping Tight
description: Short ping-pong. 1/16 L / 1/8 R feel via two times.
script:
# Ping Tight
# How it sounds: Short ping-pong. 1/16 L / 1/8 R feel via two times.
# a Feedback: 0.1 to 0.4, default 0.2
# b Mix: 0.15 to 0.5, default 0.28
# c Damp: 3000 to 8000, default 5200

param a = Feedback [0.1, 0.4]
param b = Mix [0.15, 0.5]
param c = Damp [3000, 8000]
delay1: time = 1/16; feedback = a; mix = b; damp = c; pingpong = true  # delay line

name: Ping Wide Slow
description: Wide ping-pong on 1/4. Pads / vocals.
script:
# Ping Wide Slow
# How it sounds: Wide ping-pong on 1/4. Pads / vocals.
# a Feedback: 0.15 to 0.48, default 0.28
# b Mix: 0.15 to 0.5, default 0.3
# c Width: 0.4 to 1, default 0.7

param a = Feedback [0.15, 0.48]
param b = Mix [0.15, 0.5]
param c = Width [0.4, 1]
delay1: time = 1/4; feedback = a; mix = b; damp = 4500; pingpong = true  # delay line
widen1: width = c; delay = 10; bass = 160  # mono to stereo

name: Saturation Echo
description: Tube into delay so repeats get dirtier.
script:
# Saturation Echo
# How it sounds: Tube into delay so repeats get dirtier.
# a Drive: 0.8 to 3.2, default 1.5
# b Feedback: 0.15 to 0.48, default 0.28
# c Mix: 0.15 to 0.5, default 0.28

param a = Drive [0.8, 3.2]
param b = Feedback [0.15, 0.48]
param c = Mix [0.15, 0.5]
stage1: y = tube(x, a)  # tube saturation
delay1: time = 1/8; feedback = b; mix = c; damp = 3800  # delay line

name: Gate Tail Delay
description: Delay then a gate so tails chop. Industrial / EBM.
script:
# Gate Tail Delay
# How it sounds: Delay then a gate so tails chop. Industrial / EBM.
# a Feedback: 0.2 to 0.55, default 0.32
# b Open: -42 to -20, default -30
# c Mix: 0.15 to 0.5, default 0.3

param a = Feedback [0.2, 0.55]
param b = Open [-42, -20]
param c = Mix [0.15, 0.5]
delay1: time = 1/8; feedback = a; mix = c; damp = 4000  # delay line
gate1: threshold = b; hyst = 4; hold = 0.02; range = -60  # noise gate

name: Chorus Into Delay
description: Short chorus then 1/8 delay.
script:
# Chorus Into Delay
# How it sounds: Short chorus then 1/8 delay.
# a Rate: 0.2 to 1.8, default 0.55
# b Feedback: 0.12 to 0.42, default 0.22
# c Mix: 0.15 to 0.5, default 0.26

param a = Rate [0.2, 1.8]
param b = Feedback [0.12, 0.42]
param c = Mix [0.15, 0.5]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1  # LFO
delay1: time = 11 + osc1 * 6; feedback = 0.06; mix = 0.28; damp = 7000  # delay line
delay2: time = 1/8; feedback = b; mix = c; damp = 5000  # delay line

name: Delay Into Plate
description: 1/8 delay feeding a short plate.
script:
# Delay Into Plate
# How it sounds: 1/8 delay feeding a short plate.
# a Feedback: 0.12 to 0.4, default 0.22
# b Plate: 0.15 to 0.45, default 0.26
# c Mix: 0.15 to 0.5, default 0.28

param a = Feedback [0.12, 0.4]
param b = Plate [0.15, 0.45]
param c = Mix [0.15, 0.5]
delay1: time = 1/8; feedback = a; mix = 0.35; damp = 4500  # delay line
reverb1: size = b; decay = 0.4; damp = 0.38; mix = c; width = 0.65  # reverb

name: Looper Pad Delay
description: Very long time, low feedback. Texture bed, not a rhythm delay.
script:
# Looper Pad Delay
# How it sounds: Very long time, low feedback. Texture bed, not a rhythm delay.
# a Time: 700 to 1400, default 980
# b Feedback: 0.05 to 0.22, default 0.12
# c Mix: 0.2 to 0.6, default 0.35

param a = Time [700, 1400]
param b = Feedback [0.05, 0.22]
param c = Mix [0.2, 0.6]
delay1: time = a; feedback = b; mix = c; damp = 3000  # delay line
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 5000; resonance = 0.25  # lowpass

name: Haas Pre Delay
description: 12–28 ms only. Width, not an echo.
script:
# Haas Pre Delay
# How it sounds: 12–28 ms only. Width, not an echo.
# a Offset: 10 to 28, default 16
# b Mix: 0.2 to 0.7, default 0.45
# c Bass: 80 to 200, default 130

param a = Offset [10, 28]
param b = Mix [0.2, 0.7]
param c = Bass [80, 200]
widen1: width = b; delay = a; bass = c  # mono to stereo

name: Small Booth
description: Tight vocal booth. Insert or short send.
script:
# Small Booth
# How it sounds: Tight vocal booth. Insert or short send.
# a Size: 0.08 to 0.28, default 0.14
# b Decay: 0.08 to 0.28, default 0.14
# c Mix: 0.08 to 0.4, default 0.18

param a = Size [0.08, 0.28]
param b = Decay [0.08, 0.28]
param c = Mix [0.08, 0.4]
reverb1: size = a; decay = b; damp = 0.55; mix = c; width = 0.35  # reverb

name: Drum Room Close
description: Close kit room. Faster than Drum Chamber.
script:
# Drum Room Close
# How it sounds: Close kit room. Faster than Drum Chamber.
# a Size: 0.16 to 0.4, default 0.24

param b = Decay [0.12, 0.4]
param c = Mix [0.1, 0.4]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 140; resonance = 0.25  # highpass
reverb1: size = a; decay = b; damp = 0.48; mix = c; width = 0.55  # reverb

name: Vocal Plate Short
description: Bright short plate. Lead vocal send.
script:
# Vocal Plate Short
# How it sounds: Bright short plate. Lead vocal send.
# a Size: 0.12 to 0.35, default 0.2
# b Decay: 0.15 to 0.45, default 0.26
# c Mix: 0.1 to 0.45, default 0.22

param a = Size [0.12, 0.35]
param b = Decay [0.15, 0.45]
param c = Mix [0.1, 0.45]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 200; resonance = 0.22  # highpass
reverb1: size = a; decay = b; damp = 0.32; mix = c; width = 0.7  # reverb

name: Gated Eighties
description: Big room then a hard gate. Snare / 80s tom.
script:
# Gated Eighties
# How it sounds: Big room then a hard gate. Snare / 80s tom.
# a Size: 0.3 to 0.65, default 0.45
# b Open: -28 to -8, default -16

param b = Open [-28, -8]
param c = Mix [0.15, 0.55]

gate1: threshold = b; hyst = 3; hold = 0.04; range = -70  # noise gate
stage1: y = x  # waveshape / mix

name: Cathedral Tail
description: Very large, dark, slow. Score / organ.
script:
# Cathedral Tail
# How it sounds: Very large, dark, slow. Score / organ.
# a Size: 0.55 to 0.92, default 0.74

# c Mix: 0.12 to 0.45, default 0.24

param a = Size [0.55, 0.92]
param b = Decay [1.4, 3.5]
param c = Mix [0.12, 0.45]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 160; resonance = 0.2  # highpass
reverb1: size = a; decay = b; damp = 0.58; mix = c; width = 0.88  # reverb

name: Chamber Wood
description: Wooden chamber: mid-small, warmer damp than Studio Room.
script:
# Chamber Wood
# How it sounds: Wooden chamber: mid-small, warmer damp than Studio Room.
# a Size: 0.2 to 0.48, default 0.32
# b Decay: 0.25 to 0.7, default 0.4
# c Mix: 0.1 to 0.4, default 0.2

param a = Size [0.2, 0.48]
param b = Decay [0.25, 0.7]
param c = Mix [0.1, 0.4]
reverb1: size = a; decay = b; damp = 0.62; mix = c; width = 0.5  # reverb

name: Shimmer Verb Send
description: Hall on a send with an up-octave in the wet only.
script:
# Shimmer Verb Send
# How it sounds: Hall on a send with an up-octave in the wet only.
# a Size: 0.4 to 0.8, default 0.58
# b Octave: 0.15 to 0.55, default 0.3
# c Mix: 0.12 to 0.45, default 0.24

param a = Size [0.4, 0.8]
param b = Octave [0.15, 0.55]
param c = Mix [0.12, 0.45]
stage1: y = x  # waveshape / mix
bus shine:
