  octaver1: mix = b; sub = 0; up = 1; tone = 380; thresh = 0.05  # analog octaver
  reverb1: size = a; decay = 2.0; damp = 0.36; mix = 1; width = 0.82  # reverb
out: main = 1-c; shine = c  # mix buses back to the output

name: Snare Plate Hit
description: Plate with a 200 Hz cut so snares do not boom.
script:
# Snare Plate Hit
# How it sounds: Plate with a 200 Hz cut so snares do not boom.
# a Size: 0.18 to 0.45, default 0.28

filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 200; resonance = 0.28  # highpass
reverb1: size = a; decay = b; damp = 0.34; mix = c; width = 0.68  # reverb

name: Dark Hall Score
description: Darker than Concert Hall. Low-passed tail.
script:
# Dark Hall Score
# How it sounds: Darker than Concert Hall. Low-passed tail.
# a Size: 0.4 to 0.8, default 0.58
# b Decay: 0.8 to 2.4, default 1.4
# c Mix: 0.12 to 0.42, default 0.24

param a = Size [0.4, 0.8]
param b = Decay [0.8, 2.4]
param c = Mix [0.12, 0.42]

name: Plate Into Chorus

# Air Verb Only

description: Slow leveler. Vocal / bass / pad. Mix 100.
script:

param a = Drive [3, 12]
param b = Attack [0.0002, 0.006]
param c = Release [0.03, 0.16]
comp1: threshold = -a; ratio = 12; attack = b; release = c; knee = 1; makeup = 3  # compressor

# All Buttons Smash

# b Makeup: 2 to 12, default 6

param a = Smash [6, 16]

filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 80; resonance = 0.25  # highpass

param b = Attack [0.008, 0.04]
param c = Makeup [0, 4]
comp1: threshold = -a; ratio = 2; attack = b; release = 0.18; knee = 6; makeup = c; hpf = 90  # compressor

name: NY Parallel Smash
description: Dry plus a smashed bus. Drums / vocal.
script:
# NY Parallel Smash
# How it sounds: Dry plus a smashed bus. Drums / vocal.
# a Smash: 5 to 16, default 9
# b Blend: 0.12 to 0.55, default 0.3
# c HPF: 60 to 200, default 110

param a = Smash [5, 16]
param b = Blend [0.12, 0.55]
param c = HPF [60, 200]
stage1: y = x  # waveshape / mix
bus smash:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.3  # highpass
  comp1: threshold = -a; ratio = 12; attack = 0.0004; release = 0.07; makeup = 8  # compressor
out: main = 1-b; smash = b  # mix buses back to the output

param b = Release [0.06, 0.4]
param c = Floor [-28, -8]
sidechain1: mix = a  # host sidechain
comp1: threshold = c; ratio = 8; attack = 0.001; release = b; source = sidechain; makeup = 0  # compressor

  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  ott1: depth = a; in = c; mix = 1  # OTT (3-band up+down)

script:
# 808 Sub Kick
# How it sounds: Sine-like 808: tiny HPF, tube, LPF 120.
# a Round: 0.5 to 2.2, default 1.05
# b Sub: 22 to 50, default 30
# c Ceiling: 0.45 to 0.95, default 0.75

param a = Round [0.5, 2.2]
param b = Sub [22, 50]
param c = Ceiling [0.45, 0.95]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.18  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a)  # tube saturation
stage2: y = hardclip(softclip(y, 1.05), c)  # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 140; resonance = 0.22  # lowpass

name: Parallel Crush Kit
description: Kit bus: dry plus crushed. Not Room Crush.
script:
# Parallel Crush Kit
# How it sounds: Kit bus: dry plus crushed. Not Room Crush.
# a Crush: 3 to 12, default 6.5
# b Blend: 0.12 to 0.5, default 0.26
# c Tone: 2500 to 7000, default 4200

param a = Crush [3, 12]
param b = Blend [0.12, 0.5]
param c = Tone [2500, 7000]
stage1: y = x  # waveshape / mix
bus crush:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 90; resonance = 0.28  # highpass
  stage2: y = hardclip(softclip(x, a * 0.35), 0.5)  # soft clip
  filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.3  # lowpass
out: main = 1-b; crush = b  # mix buses back to the output

name: Gated Room Snare
description: Snare send: room then gate.
script:
# Gated Room Snare
# How it sounds: Snare send: room then gate.
# a Size: 0.22 to 0.55, default 0.36
# b Open: -24 to -8, default -14
# c Mix: 0.15 to 0.5, default 0.28

param a = Size [0.22, 0.55]
param b = Open [-24, -8]
param c = Mix [0.15, 0.5]
stage1: y = x  # waveshape / mix
bus room:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  reverb1: size = a; decay = 0.4; damp = 0.42; mix = 1; width = 0.55  # reverb
  gate1: threshold = b; hyst = 3; hold = 0.035; range = -70  # noise gate
out: main = 1-c; room = c  # mix buses back to the output

name: Tom Body Desk
description: Toms: 80 HPF, 180 body, slow comp.
script:
# Tom Body Desk
# How it sounds: Toms: 80 HPF, 180 body, slow comp.
# a Body: 1 to 6, default 3
# b Glue: 3 to 10, default 5.5
# c Cut: 50 to 110, default 75

param a = Body [1, 6]
param b = Glue [3, 10]
param c = Cut [50, 110]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.25  # highpass
eq1: type = peak; freq = 180; q = 0.9; gain = a  # peak EQ
comp1: threshold = -b; ratio = 3; attack = 0.012; release = 0.16; makeup = 2  # compressor

name: Overhead Glue
description: OH pair: gentle glue, high shelf, small room.
script:
# Overhead Glue
# How it sounds: OH pair: gentle glue, high shelf, small room.
# a Glue: 3 to 9, default 5
# b Air: 0 to 4, default 1.6
# c Room: 0.08 to 0.28, default 0.14

param a = Glue [3, 9]
param b = Air [0, 4]
param c = Room [0.08, 0.28]
comp1: threshold = -a; ratio = 2.5; attack = 0.01; release = 0.14; makeup = 1  # compressor
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 10000; q = 0.5; gain = b  # high shelf
reverb1: size = 0.2; decay = c; damp = 0.4; mix = 0.12; width = 0.7  # reverb

name: Room Mic Smash
description: Room mics: HPF, smash, dark.
script:
# Room Mic Smash
# How it sounds: Room mics: HPF, smash, dark.
# a Smash: 6 to 16, default 10
# b Dark: 2000 to 5500, default 3600
# c HPF: 80 to 220, default 130

param a = Smash [6, 16]
param b = Dark [2000, 5500]
param c = HPF [80, 220]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.3  # highpass
comp1: threshold = -a; ratio = 12; attack = 0.0005; release = 0.09; makeup = 7  # compressor
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.28  # lowpass

name: Clap Plate Desk
description: Clap / snap: short plate, 300 HPF.
script:
# Clap Plate Desk
# How it sounds: Clap / snap: short plate, 300 HPF.
# a Size: 0.12 to 0.35, default 0.2
# b Mix: 0.12 to 0.45, default 0.24
# c Cut: 180 to 400, default 260

param a = Size [0.12, 0.35]
param b = Mix [0.12, 0.45]
param c = Cut [180, 400]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.28  # highpass
reverb1: size = a; decay = 0.28; damp = 0.32; mix = b; width = 0.6  # reverb

name: Kick Sidechain Kit
description: Kit bus ducks from host sidechain (kick).
script:
# Kick Sidechain Kit
# How it sounds: Kit bus ducks from host sidechain (kick).
# a Depth: 0.2 to 0.85, default 0.5
# b Release: 0.05 to 0.25, default 0.12
# c Floor: -24 to -8, default -14

param a = Depth [0.2, 0.85]
param b = Release [0.05, 0.25]
param c = Floor [-24, -8]
sidechain1: mix = a  # host sidechain
comp1: threshold = c; ratio = 6; attack = 0.001; release = b; source = sidechain  # compressor

name: Transient Kit Snap
description: Whole kit transient. Faster env than Envelope Shaper.
script:
# Transient Kit Snap
# How it sounds: Whole kit transient. Faster env than Envelope Shaper.
# a Snap: 0.15 to 1, default 0.45
# b Fast: 0.004 to 0.025, default 0.009
# c Mix: 0.3 to 1, default 0.7

param a = Snap [0.15, 1]
param b = Fast [0.004, 0.025]
param c = Mix [0.3, 1]
env1: type = peak; attack = 0.001; release = b  # envelope follower
stage1: y = lerp(x, x * clamp(1 + a * env1, 0.2, 3), c)  # dry/wet blend

name: Lo-Fi Kit Crush
description: Kit: bitcrush + LPF. Breakbeat / sample.
script:
# Lo-Fi Kit Crush
# How it sounds: Kit: bitcrush + LPF. Breakbeat / sample.
# a Bits: 4 to 10, default 7
# b Tone: 1800 to 7000, default 3800
# c Mix: 0.25 to 1, default 0.55

param a = Bits [4, 10]
param b = Tone [1800, 7000]
param c = Mix [0.25, 1]
stage1: y = lerp(x, bitcrush(softclip(x, 1.3), a), c)  # soft clip
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.35  # lowpass

name: Cymbal Splash Verb
description: Crash / splash: bright plate, 500 HPF.
script:
# Cymbal Splash Verb
# How it sounds: Crash / splash: bright plate, 500 HPF.
# a Size: 0.2 to 0.55, default 0.34
# b Mix: 0.1 to 0.4, default 0.2
# c Cut: 300 to 800, default 480

param a = Size [0.2, 0.55]
param b = Mix [0.1, 0.4]
param c = Cut [300, 800]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.22  # highpass
reverb1: size = a; decay = 0.7; damp = 0.28; mix = b; width = 0.8  # reverb

name: Rimshot Crack
description: Rimshot: 4 kHz spike, very fast FET.
script:
# Rimshot Crack
# How it sounds: Rimshot: 4 kHz spike, very fast FET.
# a Spike: 1 to 8, default 3.8
# b Hit: 4 to 14, default 8
# c Cut: 250 to 600, default 360

param a = Spike [1, 8]
param b = Hit [4, 14]
param c = Cut [250, 600]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.3  # highpass
eq1: type = peak; freq = 4200; q = 1.6; gain = a  # peak EQ
comp1: threshold = -b; ratio = 10; attack = 0.0003; release = 0.05; makeup = 2  # compressor

name: Perc Shaker Air
description: Shaker / tamb: 1 kHz HPF, air, no low.
script:
# Perc Shaker Air
# How it sounds: Shaker / tamb: 1 kHz HPF, air, no low.
# a Air: 1 to 6, default 2.6
# b Cut: 700 to 1600, default 1100
# c Grit: 0.3 to 1.4, default 0.7

param a = Air [1, 6]
param b = Cut [700, 1600]
param c = Grit [0.3, 1.4]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.22  # highpass
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 8000; q = 0.5; gain = a  # high shelf
stage1: y = softclip(x, c)  # soft clip

name: Live Kit Glue
description: Full live kit bus. SSL-ish + tiny room.
script:
# Live Kit Glue
# How it sounds: Full live kit bus. SSL-ish + tiny room.
# a Glue: 4 to 11, default 6.5
# b Room: 0.08 to 0.28, default 0.14
# c Click: 0 to 3, default 1.2

param a = Glue [4, 11]
param b = Room [0.08, 0.28]
param c = Click [0, 3]
comp1: threshold = -a; ratio = 3; attack = 0.008; release = 0.14; hpf = 80; makeup = 2  # compressor
eq1: type = peak; freq = 4000; q = 1.1; gain = c  # peak EQ
reverb1: size = 0.18; decay = b; damp = 0.45; mix = 0.1; width = 0.55  # reverb

name: Sample Drum Polish
description: One-shot polish: limit, click, no room.
script:
# Sample Drum Polish
# How it sounds: One-shot polish: limit, click, no room.
# a Click: 0 to 5, default 2
# b Ceiling: -2 to -0.2, default -0.6
# c Cut: 40 to 100, default 55

param a = Click [0, 5]
param b = Ceiling [-2, -0.2]
param c = Cut [40, 100]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.22  # highpass
eq1: type = peak; freq = 2800; q = 1.2; gain = a  # peak EQ
limit1: ceiling = b; release = 0.08  # limiter

name: Brush Kit Soft
description: Brushes: slow comp, dark, small booth.
script:
# Brush Kit Soft
# How it sounds: Brushes: slow comp, dark, small booth.
# a Glue: 3 to 9, default 5
# b Dark: 2500 to 6000, default 4000
# c Booth: 0.08 to 0.25, default 0.14

param a = Glue [3, 9]
param b = Dark [2500, 6000]
param c = Booth [0.08, 0.25]
comp1: threshold = -a; ratio = 2.5; attack = 0.02; release = 0.22; makeup = 1.5  # compressor
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.25  # lowpass
reverb1: size = 0.16; decay = c; damp = 0.5; mix = 0.14; width = 0.4  # reverb

name: Slow Chorus Pad
description: Slow wide chorus for pads. Not Chorus Delay.
script:
# Slow Chorus Pad
# How it sounds: Slow wide chorus for pads. Not Chorus Delay.
# a Rate: 0.08 to 0.6, default 0.22
# b Depth: 6 to 20, default 11
# c Mix: 0.2 to 0.7, default 0.4

param a = Rate [0.08, 0.6]
param b = Depth [6, 20]
param c = Mix [0.2, 0.7]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1  # LFO
delay1: time = 14 + osc1 * b; feedback = 0.08; mix = c; damp = 7500  # delay line

name: Fast Flange Jet
description: Faster, more feedback than chorus. Jet / flange.
script:
# Fast Flange Jet
# How it sounds: Faster, more feedback than chorus. Jet / flange.
# a Rate: 0.15 to 2.5, default 0.55
# b Depth: 1 to 8, default 3.5
# c Feedback: 0.15 to 0.55, default 0.32

param a = Rate [0.15, 2.5]
param b = Depth [1, 8]
param c = Feedback [0.15, 0.55]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1  # LFO
delay1: time = 2 + osc1 * b; feedback = c; mix = 0.45; damp = 8000  # delay line

name: Barber Pole Phaser
description: Two sweeping bandpasses. Slow climb.
script:
# Barber Pole Phaser
# How it sounds: Two sweeping bandpasses. Slow climb.
# a Rate: 0.05 to 0.8, default 0.18
# b Span: 300 to 2000, default 900
# c Mix: 0.25 to 0.85, default 0.5

param a = Rate [0.05, 0.8]
param b = Span [300, 2000]
param c = Mix [0.25, 0.85]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1  # LFO
stage1: y = x  # waveshape / mix
bus swirl:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  filter1: type = bandpass; center = 500 + osc1 * b; width = 400; resonance = 0.85  # bandpass
  filter2: type = bandpass; center = 1800 + osc1 * b * 0.6; width = 500; resonance = 0.8  # bandpass
out: main = 1-c; swirl = c  # mix buses back to the output

name: Tremolo Square Cut
description: Harder than Classic Tremolo. Square AM.
script:
# Tremolo Square Cut
# How it sounds: Harder than Classic Tremolo. Square AM.
# a Rate: 1 to 12, default 4
# b Depth: 0.3 to 1, default 0.7
# c Shape: 0.2 to 0.9, default 0.45

param a = Rate [1, 12]
param b = Depth [0.3, 1]
param c = Shape [0.2, 0.9]
osc1: shape = square; freq = a; depth = 1  # LFO
stage1: y = x * (1 - b + b * (c + (1-c) * (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1)))  # waveshape / mix

name: Tremolo Sine Warm
description: Soft sine trem + tiny tube. Rhodes / guitar.
script:
# Tremolo Sine Warm
# How it sounds: Soft sine trem + tiny tube. Rhodes / guitar.
# a Rate: 1.5 to 8, default 3.2
# b Depth: 0.2 to 0.8, default 0.45
# c Warm: 0.4 to 1.6, default 0.8

param a = Rate [1.5, 8]
param b = Depth [0.2, 0.8]
param c = Warm [0.4, 1.6]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1  # LFO
stage1: y = tube(x * (1 - b + b * (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1)), c)  # tube saturation

name: Auto Pan Wide
description: LFO left/right via mid/side trick.
script:
# Auto Pan Wide
# How it sounds: LFO left/right via mid/side trick.
# a Rate: 0.1 to 2, default 0.4
# b Width: 0.3 to 1, default 0.7
# c Mix: 0.3 to 1, default 0.8

param a = Rate [0.1, 2]
param b = Width [0.3, 1]
param c = Mix [0.3, 1]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1  # LFO
widen1: width = b * (0.4 + 0.6 * (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1)); delay = 12; bass = 140  # mono to stereo
stage1: y = lerp(x, y, c)  # dry/wet blend

name: Ring Mod Metallic
description: Audio-rate AM. Bells / robots. Not Ring Modulator stock.
script:
# Ring Mod Metallic
# How it sounds: Audio-rate AM. Bells / robots. Not Ring Modulator stock.
# a Freq: 40 to 400, default 120
# b Mix: 0.15 to 0.8, default 0.4
# c Tone: 2000 to 8000, default 5000

param a = Freq [40, 400]
param b = Mix [0.15, 0.8]
param c = Tone [2000, 8000]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1  # LFO
stage1: y = lerp(x, x * osc1, b)  # dry/wet blend
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.3  # lowpass

name: Vibrato Only
description: Pitch wobble, no dry. Guitar / vocal special.
script:
# Vibrato Only
# How it sounds: Pitch wobble, no dry. Guitar / vocal special.
# a Rate: 3 to 8, default 5
# b Depth: 2 to 10, default 5
# c Mix: 0.2 to 1, default 0.7

param a = Rate [3, 8]
param b = Depth [2, 10]
param c = Mix [0.2, 1]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1  # LFO
delay1: time = 8 + osc1 * b; feedback = 0.02; mix = c; damp = 8000  # delay line

name: Leslie Slow
description: Slow rotary: AM + bandpass sweep.
script:
# Leslie Slow
# How it sounds: Slow rotary: AM + bandpass sweep.
# a Rate: 0.4 to 1.6, default 0.75
# b Horn: 400 to 1800, default 900
# c AM: 0.2 to 0.7, default 0.4

param a = Rate [0.4, 1.6]
param b = Horn [400, 1800]
param c = AM [0.2, 0.7]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1  # LFO
filter1: type = bandpass; center = 900 + osc1 * b; width = 700; resonance = 0.6  # bandpass
stage1: y = x * (1 - c + c * (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1))  # waveshape / mix

name: Leslie Fast
description: Fast rotary. Same idea as Leslie Slow, higher rate.
script:
# Leslie Fast
# How it sounds: Fast rotary. Same idea as Leslie Slow, higher rate.
# a Rate: 4 to 9, default 6.2
# b Horn: 500 to 2200, default 1200
# c AM: 0.25 to 0.8, default 0.5

param a = Rate [4, 9]
param b = Horn [500, 2200]
param c = AM [0.25, 0.8]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1  # LFO
filter1: type = bandpass; center = 1100 + osc1 * b; width = 800; resonance = 0.55  # bandpass
stage1: y = x * (1 - c + c * (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1))  # waveshape / mix

name: Envelope Phaser
description: Env, not LFO, sweeps the notch.
script:
# Envelope Phaser
# How it sounds: Env, not LFO, sweeps the notch.
# a Span: 300 to 1800, default 900
# b Mix: 0.25 to 0.9, default 0.5
# c Rel: 0.04 to 0.2, default 0.09

param a = Span [300, 1800]
param b = Mix [0.25, 0.9]
param c = Rel [0.04, 0.2]
env1: attack = 0.006; release = c  # envelope follower
stage1: y = x  # waveshape / mix
bus swirl:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  filter1: type = bandpass; center = 600 + env1 * a; width = 350; resonance = 0.9  # bandpass
out: main = 1-b; swirl = b  # mix buses back to the output

name: Detune Widen Mod
description: Haas + slow chorus. Synths.
script:
# Detune Widen Mod
# How it sounds: Haas + slow chorus. Synths.
# a Rate: 0.1 to 0.8, default 0.28
# b Haas: 8 to 22, default 14
# c Width: 0.3 to 1, default 0.62

param a = Rate [0.1, 0.8]
param b = Haas [8, 22]
param c = Width [0.3, 1]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1  # LFO
widen1: width = c; delay = b; bass = 150  # mono to stereo
delay1: time = 12 + osc1 * 5; feedback = 0.05; mix = 0.22; damp = 7000  # delay line

name: Chopper Sixteenth
description: Tempo 1/16 gate. Not Chopper stock (free Hz).
script:
# Chopper Sixteenth
# How it sounds: Tempo 1/16 gate. Not Chopper stock (free Hz).
# a Depth: 0.4 to 1, default 0.85
# b Smooth: 0.001 to 0.02, default 0.006
# c Mix: 0.3 to 1, default 0.8

param a = Depth [0.4, 1]
param b = Smooth [0.001, 0.02]
param c = Mix [0.3, 1]
osc1: shape = square; freq = 1/16; depth = 1  # LFO
stage1: y = lerp(x, x * (1 - a + a * (0.05 + 0.95 * (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1))), c)  # dry/wet blend
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 12000; resonance = 0.2  # lowpass

name: Wow Flutter Tape
description: Slow wow on a short delay. Tape motion, not Tape Saturate.
script:
# Wow Flutter Tape
# How it sounds: Slow wow on a short delay. Tape motion, not Tape Saturate.
# a Wow: 0.2 to 1.2, default 0.45
# b Depth: 1 to 6, default 3
# c Mix: 0.2 to 0.7, default 0.4

param a = Wow [0.2, 1.2]
param b = Depth [1, 6]
param c = Mix [0.2, 0.7]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1  # LFO
delay1: time = 18 + osc1 * b; feedback = 0.12; mix = c; damp = 5000  # delay line
stage1: y = tube(x, 0.9)  # tube saturation

name: DJ Low Kill
description: Kill the lows. DJ / transition.
script:
# DJ Low Kill
# How it sounds: Kill the lows. DJ / transition.
# a Cut: 80 to 400, default 180
# b Res: 0.2 to 1.2, default 0.45
# c Mix: 0.5 to 1, default 1

param a = Cut [80, 400]
param b = Res [0.2, 1.2]
param c = Mix [0.5, 1]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = a; resonance = b  # highpass
stage1: y = lerp(x, y, c)  # dry/wet blend

name: DJ High Kill
description: Kill the highs.
script:
# DJ High Kill
# How it sounds: Kill the highs.
# a Cut: 800 to 6000, default 2500
# b Res: 0.2 to 1.2, default 0.4
# c Mix: 0.5 to 1, default 1

param a = Cut [800, 6000]
param b = Res [0.2, 1.2]
param c = Mix [0.5, 1]
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = a; resonance = b  # lowpass
stage1: y = lerp(x, y, c)  # dry/wet blend

name: Reso Acid Slide
description: High-res LPF, env opens. 303 cousin, not Acid Line.
script:
# Reso Acid Slide
# How it sounds: High-res LPF, env opens. 303 cousin, not Acid Line.
# a Cut: 200 to 4000, default 800
# b Res: 0.8 to 3.2, default 1.8
# c Env: 200 to 2500, default 900

param a = Cut [200, 4000]
param b = Res [0.8, 3.2]
param c = Env [200, 2500]
env1: attack = 0.004; release = 0.12  # envelope follower
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = a + env1 * c; resonance = b  # lowpass

name: Notch Honk Cut
description: Deep notch. Feedback / honk removal.
script:
# Notch Honk Cut
# How it sounds: Deep notch. Feedback / honk removal.
# a Freq: 200 to 2500, default 800
# b Depth: -16 to -4, default -9
# c Q: 1 to 6, default 2.4

param a = Freq [200, 2500]
param b = Depth [-16, -4]
param c = Q [1, 6]
eq1: type = notch; freq = a; q = c; gain = b  # notch

name: Bandpass Radio
description: Radio band without crush.
script:
# Bandpass Radio
# How it sounds: Radio band without crush.
# a Center: 600 to 2500, default 1200
# b Width: 300 to 1600, default 700
# c Mix: 0.4 to 1, default 0.85

param a = Center [600, 2500]
param b = Width [300, 1600]
param c = Mix [0.4, 1]
stage1: y = x  # waveshape / mix
bus band:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  filter1: type = bandpass; center = a; width = b  # bandpass
out: main = 1-c; band = c  # mix buses back to the output

name: LFO Filter Sweep
description: Slow LPF sweep. Pads / breaks.
script:
# LFO Filter Sweep
# How it sounds: Slow LPF sweep. Pads / breaks.
# a Rate: 0.05 to 0.8, default 0.15
# b Span: 400 to 4000, default 1800
# c Floor: 200 to 1200, default 400

param a = Rate [0.05, 0.8]
param b = Span [400, 4000]
param c = Floor [200, 1200]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1  # LFO
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = c + (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1) * b; resonance = 0.7  # lowpass

name: HPF Rumble Cut
description: Just a musical HPF. Mix / bus.
script:
# HPF Rumble Cut
# How it sounds: Just a musical HPF. Mix / bus.
# a Cut: 25 to 120, default 40
# b Res: 0.15 to 0.7, default 0.28
# c Mix: 0.5 to 1, default 1

param a = Cut [25, 120]
param b = Res [0.15, 0.7]
param c = Mix [0.5, 1]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = a; resonance = b  # highpass
eq1: type = lowshelf; freq = 80; q = 0.55; gain = -1.2  # low shelf
stage1: y = x  # waveshape / mix

name: Tilt Dark Bright
description: Low shelf vs high shelf tilt.
script:
# Tilt Dark Bright
# How it sounds: Low shelf vs high shelf tilt.
# a Tilt: -6 to 6, default 2
# b Pivot: 400 to 1600, default 800
# c Mix: 0.4 to 1, default 1

param a = Tilt [-6, 6]
param b = Pivot [400, 1600]
param c = Mix [0.4, 1]
eq1: type = lowshelf; freq = b; q = 0.6; gain = -a  # low shelf
eq2: type = highshelf; freq = b; q = 0.6; gain = a  # high shelf
stage1: y = lerp(x, y, c)  # dry/wet blend

name: Formant Vowel
description: Two formant peaks. Voice / synth.
script:
# Formant Vowel
# How it sounds: Two formant peaks. Voice / synth.
# a Vowel: 400 to 900, default 600
# b Bright: 0.6 to 1.6, default 1.05
# c Mix: 0.3 to 1, default 0.65

param a = Vowel [400, 900]
param b = Bright [0.6, 1.6]
param c = Mix [0.3, 1]
stage1: y = x  # waveshape / mix
bus vow:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  filter1: type = bandpass; center = a; width = 180; resonance = 1.4  # bandpass
  filter2: type = bandpass; center = a * b * 2.2; width = 260; resonance = 1.2  # bandpass
out: main = 1-c; vow = c  # mix buses back to the output

name: Comb Metallic
description: Short delay comb. Metal / Karplus-ish.
script:
# Comb Metallic
# How it sounds: Short delay comb. Metal / Karplus-ish.
# a Time: 4 to 28, default 11
# b Feedback: 0.2 to 0.7, default 0.42
# c Mix: 0.2 to 0.8, default 0.45

param a = Time [4, 28]
param b = Feedback [0.2, 0.7]
param c = Mix [0.2, 0.8]
delay1: time = a; feedback = b; mix = c; damp = 6000  # delay line

name: Shelf Air Only Filt
description: Just a high shelf. Mix bus air.
script:
# Shelf Air Only Filt
# How it sounds: Just a high shelf. Mix bus air.
# a Air: 0 to 7, default 2.4
# b Freq: 6000 to 14000, default 9500
# c Mix: 0.4 to 1, default 1

param a = Air [0, 7]
param b = Freq [6000, 14000]
param c = Mix [0.4, 1]
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = b; q = 0.5; gain = a  # high shelf
stage1: y = lerp(x, y, c)  # dry/wet blend

name: Low Shelf Weight
description: Just a low shelf. Weight without a bass plugin.
script:
# Low Shelf Weight
# How it sounds: Just a low shelf. Weight without a bass plugin.
# a Weight: -4 to 6, default 2
# b Freq: 60 to 180, default 100
# c Mix: 0.4 to 1, default 1

param a = Weight [-4, 6]
param b = Freq [60, 180]
param c = Mix [0.4, 1]
eq1: type = lowshelf; freq = b; q = 0.6; gain = a  # low shelf
stage1: y = lerp(x, y, c)  # dry/wet blend

name: Gentle Bus Glue M
description: 2:1 mixbus. Lighter than Bus Glue.
script:
# Gentle Bus Glue M
# How it sounds: 2:1 mixbus. Lighter than Bus Glue.
# a Glue: 3 to 10, default 6
# b Attack: 0.01 to 0.04, default 0.02
# c Ceiling: -1.5 to -0.2, default -0.5

param a = Glue [3, 10]
param b = Attack [0.01, 0.04]
param c = Ceiling [-1.5, -0.2]
comp1: threshold = -a; ratio = 1.8; attack = b; release = 0.22; knee = 8; makeup = 0.8; hpf = 80  # compressor
limit1: ceiling = c; release = 0.1  # limiter

name: Loudness Clip Master
description: Soft-pre clip then limit. Not Loudness Clip stock.
script:
# Loudness Clip Master
# How it sounds: Soft-pre clip then limit. Not Loudness Clip stock.
# a Drive: 0.85 to 1.5, default 1.05
# b Ceiling: -1.2 to -0.15, default -0.4
# c Tone: 8000 to 16000, default 11000

param a = Drive [0.85, 1.5]
param b = Ceiling [-1.2, -0.15]
param c = Tone [8000, 16000]
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x, a), 0.92)  # soft clip
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = c; q = 0.5; gain = 0.6  # high shelf
limit1: ceiling = b; release = 0.08  # limiter

name: Air And Weight
description: Low shelf + air. No clip.
script:
# Air And Weight
# How it sounds: Low shelf + air. No clip.
# a Weight: 0 to 3, default 1.2
# b Air: 0 to 3, default 1.4
# c Pivot: 80 to 160, default 110

param a = Weight [0, 3]
param b = Air [0, 3]
param c = Pivot [80, 160]
eq1: type = lowshelf; freq = c; q = 0.55; gain = a  # low shelf
eq2: type = highshelf; freq = 11000; q = 0.5; gain = b  # high shelf

name: Mid Focus Master
description: MS: lift mid 1–3 kHz, tame sides 300 Hz.
script:
# Mid Focus Master
# How it sounds: MS: lift mid 1–3 kHz, tame sides 300 Hz.
# a Mid: 0 to 3, default 1.2
# b Side: -4 to 0, default -1.5
# c Width: 0.7 to 1.15, default 0.95

param a = Mid [0, 3]
param b = Side [-4, 0]
param c = Width [0.7, 1.15]
ms1: mode = encode  # mid/side encode
eq1: channel = mid; type = peak; freq = 1800; q = 0.9; gain = a  # peak EQ
eq2: channel = side; type = peak; freq = 300; q = 0.8; gain = b  # peak EQ
ms2: mode = decode  # mid/side decode
widen1: width = c; delay = 8; bass = 120  # mono to stereo

name: Stereo Widen Safe
description: Gentle widen, bass mono. Safer than Haas Width.
script:
# Stereo Widen Safe
# How it sounds: Gentle widen, bass mono. Safer than Haas Width.
# a Width: 0.15 to 0.7, default 0.35
# b Haas: 6 to 16, default 10
# c Bass: 80 to 180, default 120

param a = Width [0.15, 0.7]
param b = Haas [6, 16]
param c = Bass [80, 180]
widen1: width = a; delay = b; bass = c  # mono to stereo

name: Mono Check Fold
description: Utility: collapse toward mono to check.
script:
# Mono Check Fold
# How it sounds: Utility: collapse toward mono to check.
# a Width: 0 to 1, default 0.15
# b Bass: 60 to 160, default 100
# c Level: 0.7 to 1.1, default 1

param a = Width [0, 1]
param b = Bass [60, 160]
param c = Level [0.7, 1.1]
widen1: width = a; delay = 0; bass = b  # mono to stereo
stage1: y = x * c  # waveshape / mix

name: Tilt Master
description: Mastering tilt EQ.
script:
# Tilt Master
# How it sounds: Mastering tilt EQ.
# a Tilt: -3 to 3, default 0.8
# b Pivot: 500 to 1200, default 800
# c Ceiling: -1 to -0.2, default -0.4

param a = Tilt [-3, 3]
param b = Pivot [500, 1200]
param c = Ceiling [-1, -0.2]
eq1: type = lowshelf; freq = b; q = 0.55; gain = -a  # low shelf
eq2: type = highshelf; freq = b; q = 0.55; gain = a  # high shelf
limit1: ceiling = c; release = 0.1  # limiter

name: OTT Glue Master
description: Very light OTT on the mixbus.
script:
# OTT Glue Master
# How it sounds: Very light OTT on the mixbus.
# a Depth: 0.08 to 0.35, default 0.16
# b Time: 0.02 to 0.08, default 0.035
# c Ceiling: -1 to -0.2, default -0.4

param a = Depth [0.08, 0.35]
param b = Time [0.02, 0.08]
param c = Ceiling [-1, -0.2]
ott1: depth = a; time = b; in = 1; low = 0.9; mid = 1; high = 1.05  # OTT (3-band up+down)
limit1: ceiling = c; release = 0.1  # limiter

name: Safety Ceiling Master
description: Last plugin: just a limiter.
script:
# Safety Ceiling Master
# How it sounds: Last plugin: just a limiter.
# a Ceiling: -2 to -0.1, default -0.3
# b Release: 0.05 to 0.2, default 0.09
# c In: 0.9 to 1.2, default 1

param a = Ceiling [-2, -0.1]
param b = Release [0.05, 0.2]
param c = In [0.9, 1.2]
stage1: y = x * c  # waveshape / mix
limit1: ceiling = a; release = b  # limiter

name: Presence Master
description: 2.8 kHz presence only. Dense mixes.
script:
# Presence Master
# How it sounds: 2.8 kHz presence only. Dense mixes.
# a Cut: 0 to 2.5, default 1
# b Q: 0.6 to 1.4, default 0.9
# c Ceiling: -1 to -0.2, default -0.4

param a = Cut [0, 2.5]
param b = Q [0.6, 1.4]
param c = Ceiling [-1, -0.2]
eq1: type = peak; freq = 2800; q = b; gain = a  # peak EQ
limit1: ceiling = c; release = 0.1  # limiter

name: Dark Master
description: Darken a harsh mix. High cut + tiny clip.
script:
# Dark Master
# How it sounds: Darken a harsh mix. High cut + tiny clip.
# a Top: 7000 to 14000, default 11000
# b Air: -3 to 0, default -1.2
# c Ceiling: -1 to -0.2, default -0.4

param a = Top [7000, 14000]
param b = Air [-3, 0]
param c = Ceiling [-1, -0.2]
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = a; resonance = 0.22  # lowpass
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 9000; q = 0.5; gain = b  # high shelf
limit1: ceiling = c; release = 0.1  # limiter

name: Punch Master
description: Transient lift then glue. Rock / hip-hop.
script:
# Punch Master
# How it sounds: Transient lift then glue. Rock / hip-hop.
# a Punch: 0.05 to 0.4, default 0.16
# b Glue: 3 to 9, default 5.5
# c Ceiling: -1 to -0.2, default -0.4

param a = Punch [0.05, 0.4]
param b = Glue [3, 9]
param c = Ceiling [-1, -0.2]
env1: type = peak; attack = 0.001; release = 0.012  # envelope follower
stage1: y = x * clamp(1 + a * env1, 0.5, 2)  # waveshape / mix
comp1: threshold = -b; ratio = 2; attack = 0.012; release = 0.18; makeup = 0.5  # compressor
limit1: ceiling = c; release = 0.09  # limiter

name: High Pass Utility
description: Clean HPF. Every track.
script:
# High Pass Utility
# How it sounds: Clean HPF. Every track.
# a Cut: 20 to 200, default 40
# b Res: 0.15 to 0.6, default 0.25
# c Mix: 0.5 to 1, default 1

param a = Cut [20, 200]
param b = Res [0.15, 0.6]
param c = Mix [0.5, 1]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = a; resonance = b  # highpass
stage1: y = lerp(x, y, c)  # dry/wet blend

name: Low Pass Utility
description: Clean LPF.
script:
# Low Pass Utility
# How it sounds: Clean LPF.
# a Cut: 1000 to 16000, default 8000
# b Res: 0.15 to 0.6, default 0.25
# c Mix: 0.5 to 1, default 1

param a = Cut [1000, 16000]
param b = Res [0.15, 0.6]
param c = Mix [0.5, 1]
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = a; resonance = b  # lowpass
stage1: y = lerp(x, y, c)  # dry/wet blend

name: Gain Stage Utility
description: Just level. Gain staging.
script:
# Gain Stage Utility
# How it sounds: Just level. Gain staging.
# a Gain: 0.25 to 2, default 1
# b Trim: -12 to 12, default 0
# c Ceiling: -1 to 0, default -0.3

param a = Gain [0.25, 2]
param b = Trim [-12, 12]
param c = Ceiling [-1, 0]
stage1: y = x * a * pow(10, b / 20)  # waveshape / mix
limit1: ceiling = c; release = 0.08  # limiter

name: Phase Flip Utility
description: Invert polarity.
script:
# Phase Flip Utility
# How it sounds: Invert polarity.
# a Flip: 0 to 1, default 1
# b Level: 0.5 to 1.2, default 1
# c Mix: 0 to 1, default 1

param a = Flip [0, 1]
param b = Level [0.5, 1.2]
param c = Mix [0, 1]
stage1: y = lerp(x, x * (1 - 2 * a), c) * b  # dry/wet blend

name: MS Encode Utility
description: Listen mid/side. Encode only — decode after.
script:
# MS Encode Utility
# How it sounds: Listen mid/side. Encode only — decode after.
# a Mid: 0 to 2, default 1
# b Side: 0 to 2, default 1
# c Listen: 0 to 1, default 1

param a = Mid [0, 2]
param b = Side [0, 2]
param c = Listen [0, 1]
ms1: mode = encode  # mid/side encode
stage1: channel = mid; y = x * a  # waveshape / mix
stage2: channel = side; y = x * b * c  # waveshape / mix
ms2: mode = decode  # mid/side decode

name: Dry Wet Utility
description: Parallel rack: dry vs this track's input copy. Blend.
script:
# Dry Wet Utility
# How it sounds: Parallel rack: dry vs this track's input copy. Blend.
# a Blend: 0 to 1, default 0.5
# b WetGain: 0.4 to 1.6, default 1
# c HPF: 20 to 200, default 30

param a = Blend [0, 1]
param b = WetGain [0.4, 1.6]
param c = HPF [20, 200]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.2  # highpass
stage1: y = x  # waveshape / mix
bus wet:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  stage2: y = x * b  # waveshape / mix
out: main = 1-a; wet = a  # mix buses back to the output

name: Meter Probe Utility
description: Dry meter in the chain. Does not change the sound.
script:
# Meter Probe Utility
# How it sounds: Dry meter in the chain. Does not change the sound.
# a Gain: 0.5 to 1.5, default 1
# b Trim: 0.7 to 1.3, default 1
# c Mix: 0.5 to 1, default 1

param a = Gain [0.5, 1.5]
param b = Trim [0.7, 1.3]
param c = Mix [0.5, 1]
meter1: mode = loudness  # meter (dry)
stage1: y = x * a * b  # waveshape / mix
stage2: y = lerp(x, y, c)  # dry/wet blend

name: Safety Clip Utility
description: Last-resort clip. Different ceiling range than Safety Clip stock.
script:
# Safety Clip Utility
# How it sounds: Last-resort clip. Different ceiling range than Safety Clip stock.
# a Ceiling: 0.7 to 0.99, default 0.92
# b Drive: 0.8 to 1.3, default 1
# c Mix: 0.5 to 1, default 1

param a = Ceiling [0.7, 0.99]
param b = Drive [0.8, 1.3]
param c = Mix [0.5, 1]
stage1: y = lerp(x, hardclip(softclip(x, b), a), c)  # soft clip

name: Missing Air
description: Implied air via 10 kHz shelf + tiny fold. Not Loudness Curve.
script:
# Missing Air
# How it sounds: Implied air via 10 kHz shelf + tiny fold. Not Loudness Curve.
# a Air: 1 to 6, default 2.6
# b Fold: 0.05 to 0.2, default 0.1
# c Mix: 0.3 to 1, default 0.55

param a = Air [1, 6]
param b = Fold [0.05, 0.2]
param c = Mix [0.3, 1]
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 10500; q = 0.5; gain = a  # high shelf
stage1: y = lerp(x, fold(x, -b, b), c)  # wavefold

name: Center Cut Through
description: Boost mid 2.5 kHz, dip sides 2.5 kHz. Vocal in a dense mix.
script:
# Center Cut Through
# How it sounds: Boost mid 2.5 kHz, dip sides 2.5 kHz. Vocal in a dense mix.
# a Mid: 0 to 4, default 2
# b Side: -4 to 0, default -1.8
# c Freq: 1800 to 3500, default 2500

param a = Mid [0, 4]
param b = Side [-4, 0]
param c = Freq [1800, 3500]
ms1: mode = encode  # mid/side encode
eq1: channel = mid; type = peak; freq = c; q = 1.1; gain = a  # peak EQ
eq2: channel = side; type = peak; freq = c; q = 1.1; gain = b  # peak EQ
ms2: mode = decode  # mid/side decode

name: Bass Weight Trick
description: Even harmonics under 120 Hz. Implied bass on small speakers.
script:
# Bass Weight Trick
# How it sounds: Even harmonics under 120 Hz. Implied bass on small speakers.
# a Harm: 0.6 to 2.2, default 1.2
# b BandHz: 80 to 160, default 110
# c Mix: 0.2 to 0.8, default 0.45

param a = Harm [0.6, 2.2]
param b = BandHz [80, 160]
param c = Mix [0.2, 0.8]
xover1: f1 = b  # crossover
bus low:
  stage1: y = tube(x, a)  # tube saturation
out: low = c; high = 1  # mix buses back to the output

name: Ear Tickle 3k
description: Narrow 3.2 kHz lift. Speech / lead.
script:
# Ear Tickle 3k
# How it sounds: Narrow 3.2 kHz lift. Speech / lead.
# a Tickle: 0 to 4, default 1.8
# b Q: 1 to 3, default 1.6
# c Mix: 0.4 to 1, default 1

param a = Tickle [0, 4]
param b = Q [1, 3]
param c = Mix [0.4, 1]
eq1: type = peak; freq = 3200; q = b; gain = a  # peak EQ
stage1: y = lerp(x, y, c)  # dry/wet blend

name: Width Without Haas
description: Side shelf only. No delay.
script:
# Width Without Haas
# How it sounds: Side shelf only. No delay.
# a Side: 0 to 5, default 2.4
# b Freq: 4000 to 10000, default 7000
# c Mid: 0.8 to 1.1, default 1

param a = Side [0, 5]
param b = Freq [4000, 10000]
param c = Mid [0.8, 1.1]
ms1: mode = encode  # mid/side encode
stage1: channel = mid; y = x * c  # waveshape / mix
eq1: channel = side; type = highshelf; freq = b; q = 0.5; gain = a  # high shelf
ms2: mode = decode  # mid/side decode

name: Green Boost Only
description: TS mid-hump, almost no clip. Boost into an amp.
script:
# Green Boost Only
# How it sounds: TS mid-hump, almost no clip. Boost into an amp.
# a Boost: 1 to 6, default 2.4
# b Mid: 3 to 8, default 5
# c Tone: 1500 to 5000, default 2800

param a = Boost [1, 6]
param b = Mid [3, 8]
param c = Tone [1500, 5000]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 700; resonance = 0.25  # highpass
eq1: type = peak; freq = 720; q = 1.5; gain = b  # peak EQ
stage1: y = softclip(x, a * 0.35)  # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.35  # lowpass

name: Transparent Diode
description: Klon cousin without the stock blend graph: diode + 1 kHz bump.
script:
# Transparent Diode
# How it sounds: Klon cousin without the stock blend graph: diode + 1 kHz bump.
# a Drive: 0.8 to 6, default 2.6
# b Bell: 1 to 5, default 2.6
# c Level: 0.4 to 1.2, default 0.85

param a = Drive [0.8, 6]
param b = Bell [1, 5]
param c = Level [0.4, 1.2]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 90; resonance = 0.25  # highpass
stage1: y = diode(x, a) * c  # diode clip
eq1: type = peak; freq = 1100; q = 0.85; gain = b  # peak EQ
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 8500; resonance = 0.28  # lowpass

name: Silicon Fuzz Gate
description: Brighter fuzz than Fuzz Face, with a faster gate.
script:
# Silicon Fuzz Gate
# How it sounds: Brighter fuzz than Fuzz Face, with a faster gate.
# a Fuzz: 3 to 14, default 8
# b Tone: 800 to 5000, default 2400
# c Open: -48 to -26, default -36

param a = Fuzz [3, 14]
param b = Tone [800, 5000]
param c = Open [-48, -26]
gate1: threshold = c; hyst = 6; hold = 0.02; range = -75  # noise gate
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 80; resonance = 0.32  # highpass
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x, a * 0.35), 0.42)  # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.55  # lowpass

name: Octave Fuzz
description: Fuzz after a little up-octave. Synth-fuzz.
script:
# Octave Fuzz
# How it sounds: Fuzz after a little up-octave. Synth-fuzz.
# a Fuzz: 2 to 10, default 5
# b Octave: 0.1 to 0.5, default 0.25
# c Tone: 1200 to 4500, default 2600

param a = Fuzz [2, 10]
param b = Octave [0.1, 0.5]
param c = Tone [1200, 4500]
octaver1: mix = b; sub = 0; up = 1; tone = 400; thresh = 0.05  # analog octaver
stage1: y = fold(x, -0.28, 0.28)  # wavefold
stage2: y = softclip(y, a)  # soft clip
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.4  # lowpass

name: Power Amp Grind
description: Just the power-amp end: tube + hard-knee + cab. No preamp stack.
script:
# Power Amp Grind
# How it sounds: Just the power-amp end: tube + hard-knee + cab. No preamp stack.
# a Grind: 1.2 to 6, default 2.8
# b Ceiling: 0.4 to 0.85, default 0.62
# c Cab: 0.25 to 0.65, default 0.42

param a = Grind [1.2, 6]
param b = Ceiling [0.4, 0.85]
param c = Cab [0.25, 0.65]
stage1: y = tube(x, a)  # tube saturation
stage2: y = hardclip(softclip(y, 1.3), b)  # soft clip
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 5500; resonance = 0.4  # lowpass
ir1: mix = c; gain = 1  # impulse response

name: Preamp Only Stack
description: Three tubes, no cab, open LPF. Re-amp later.
script:
# Preamp Only Stack
# How it sounds: Three tubes, no cab, open LPF. Re-amp later.
# a Gain: 2 to 10, default 5.5
# b Tight: 60 to 180, default 100
# c Top: 4000 to 9000, default 6500

param a = Gain [2, 10]
param b = Tight [60, 180]
param c = Top [4000, 9000]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.4  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a * 0.45)  # tube saturation
stage2: y = tube(y, a * 0.4)  # tube saturation
stage3: y = tube(y, a * 0.3)  # tube saturation
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.3  # lowpass

name: Hard Ceiling Pedal
description: Pedal-style hard ceiling after a soft pre. Not Hard Clip Pedal stock.
script:
# Hard Ceiling Pedal
# How it sounds: Pedal-style hard ceiling after a soft pre. Not Hard Clip Pedal stock.
# a Drive: 1.5 to 8, default 3.8
# b Ceiling: 0.3 to 0.75, default 0.5
# c Tone: 1500 to 6000, default 3200

param a = Drive [1.5, 8]
param b = Ceiling [0.3, 0.75]
param c = Tone [1500, 6000]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 100; resonance = 0.3  # highpass
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x, a), b)  # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.45  # lowpass

name: Asym Tube Push
description: More even harmonics: tube + tiny DC. Blues.
script:
# Asym Tube Push
# How it sounds: More even harmonics: tube + tiny DC. Blues.
# a Drive: 0.8 to 4.5, default 2.1
# b Bias: 0 to 0.12, default 0.04
# c Tone: 2500 to 7000, default 4500

param a = Drive [0.8, 4.5]
param b = Bias [0.0, 0.12]
param c = Tone [2500, 7000]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 70; resonance = 0.25  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x + b, a)  # tube saturation
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.3  # lowpass

name: Fold Then Recover
description: Fold then a steep LPF. Not Wave Folder stock.
script:
# Fold Then Recover
# How it sounds: Fold then a steep LPF. Not Wave Folder stock.
# a Fold: 0.15 to 0.55, default 0.3
# b Recover: 1200 to 5000, default 2800
# c Level: 0.4 to 1.1, default 0.75

param a = Fold [0.15, 0.55]
param b = Recover [1200, 5000]
param c = Level [0.4, 1.1]
stage1: y = fold(x, -a, a) * c  # wavefold
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.42  # lowpass

name: Bitcrush Then Cab
description: Crush into a vintage cab. Digital amp.
script:
# Bitcrush Then Cab
# How it sounds: Crush into a vintage cab. Digital amp.
# a Bits: 4 to 11, default 7
# b Drive: 0.8 to 3, default 1.5
# c Cab: 0.25 to 0.65, default 0.4

param a = Bits [4, 11]
param b = Drive [0.8, 3]
param c = Cab [0.25, 0.65]
stage1: y = bitcrush(softclip(x, b), a)  # soft clip
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 5500; resonance = 0.35  # lowpass
ir1: mix = c; gain = 2  # impulse response

name: Diode Stack Pedal
description: Two diodes in series, mid bump.
script:
# Diode Stack Pedal
# How it sounds: Two diodes in series, mid bump.
# a Drive: 1 to 7, default 3.2
# b Mid: 1 to 6, default 3
# c Tone: 1800 to 6500, default 3500

param a = Drive [1, 7]
param b = Mid [1, 6]
param c = Tone [1800, 6500]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 110; resonance = 0.3  # highpass
stage1: y = diode(x, a)  # diode clip
stage2: y = diode(y, a * 0.7)  # diode clip
eq1: type = peak; freq = 900; q = 1.1; gain = b  # peak EQ
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.38  # lowpass

name: Softclip Open
description: Widest softclip, almost hi-fi. Not Soft Overdrive.
script:
# Softclip Open
# How it sounds: Widest softclip, almost hi-fi. Not Soft Overdrive.
# a Drive: 0.5 to 3.5, default 1.4
# b Air: 0 to 4, default 1.6
# c Level: 0.5 to 1.3, default 0.95

param a = Drive [0.5, 3.5]
param b = Air [0, 4]
param c = Level [0.5, 1.3]
stage1: y = softclip(x, a) * c  # soft clip
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 7000; q = 0.5; gain = b  # high shelf

name: Parallel Dirt Blend
description: Clean plus a diode bus. Not Klon Centaur.
script:
# Parallel Dirt Blend
# How it sounds: Clean plus a diode bus. Not Klon Centaur.
# a Drive: 1 to 7, default 3
# b Blend: 0.15 to 0.7, default 0.4
# c Tone: 2000 to 7000, default 4000

param a = Drive [1, 7]
param b = Blend [0.15, 0.7]
param c = Tone [2000, 7000]
stage1: y = x  # waveshape / mix
bus dirt:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  stage2: y = diode(x, a)  # diode clip
  filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.32  # lowpass
out: main = 1-b; dirt = b  # mix buses back to the output

name: High Gain American
description: American high-gain without Mesa name. Tight + cab.
script:
# High Gain American
# How it sounds: American high-gain without Mesa name. Tight + cab.
# a Gain: 4 to 12, default 7.5
# b Tight: 50 to 140, default 85
# c Cab: 0.3 to 0.7, default 0.48

param a = Gain [4, 12]
param b = Tight [50, 140]
param c = Cab [0.3, 0.7]
gate1: threshold = -44; hyst = 6; hold = 0.025; range = -78  # noise gate
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.55  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a * 0.5)  # tube saturation
stage2: y = tube(y, a * 0.4)  # tube saturation
stage3: y = hardclip(softclip(y, 1.4), 0.65)  # soft clip
ir1: mix = c; gain = 0  # impulse response

name: British Plexi Bark
description: Plexi cousin: 800 Hz bark, no Marshall name.
script:
# British Plexi Bark
# How it sounds: Plexi cousin: 800 Hz bark, no Marshall name.
# a Drive: 1.5 to 7, default 3.4
# b Bark: 2 to 7, default 4
# c Cab: 0.25 to 0.6, default 0.4

param a = Drive [1.5, 7]
param b = Bark [2, 7]
param c = Cab [0.25, 0.6]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 105; resonance = 0.36  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a * 0.6)  # tube saturation
stage2: y = tube(y, a * 0.5)  # tube saturation
eq1: type = peak; freq = 800; q = 1.05; gain = b  # peak EQ
ir1: mix = c; gain = 1  # impulse response

name: Tweed Edge
description: Small tweed: loose low, early breakup, vintage cab.
script:
# Tweed Edge
# How it sounds: Small tweed: loose low, early breakup, vintage cab.
# a Push: 0.7 to 3.5, default 1.6
# b Loose: 40 to 90, default 55
# c Cab: 0.2 to 0.55, default 0.35

param a = Push [0.7, 3.5]
param b = Loose [40, 90]
param c = Cab [0.2, 0.55]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.22  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a)  # tube saturation
eq1: type = peak; freq = 150; q = 0.7; gain = 2  # peak EQ
ir1: mix = c; gain = 2  # impulse response

name: Chime OD Stack
description: OD into a chime amp. Not Vox Top Boost.
script:
# Chime OD Stack
# How it sounds: OD into a chime amp. Not Vox Top Boost.
# a Pedal: 1 to 6, default 2.8
# b Chime: 1 to 5, default 2.6
# c Cab: 0.2 to 0.55, default 0.35

param a = Pedal [1, 6]
param b = Chime [1, 5]
param c = Cab [0.2, 0.55]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 450; resonance = 0.35  # highpass
stage1: y = softclip(x, a)  # soft clip
eq1: type = peak; freq = 2000; q = 1.2; gain = b  # peak EQ
stage2: y = tube(y, 1.3)  # tube saturation
ir1: mix = c; gain = 1  # impulse response

name: Rat Into Amp
description: RAT filter into a tube stage + medium cab.
script:
# Rat Into Amp
# How it sounds: RAT filter into a tube stage + medium cab.
# a Dist: 2 to 10, default 5.5
# b Filter: 500 to 3500, default 1600
# c Amp: 0.8 to 3, default 1.6

param a = Dist [2, 10]
param b = Filter [500, 3500]
param c = Amp [0.8, 3]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 80; resonance = 0.3  # highpass
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x, a * 0.5), 0.52)  # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.58  # lowpass
stage2: y = tube(y, c)  # tube saturation
ir1: mix = 0.4; gain = 1  # impulse response

name: Muff Into Amp
description: Stacked-filter fuzz into a dark cab.
script:
# Muff Into Amp
# How it sounds: Stacked-filter fuzz into a dark cab.
# a Fuzz: 2 to 9, default 5
# b Scoop: 500 to 1200, default 800
# c Cab: 0.3 to 0.7, default 0.45

param a = Fuzz [2, 9]
param b = Scoop [500, 1200]
param c = Cab [0.3, 0.7]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 70; resonance = 0.32  # highpass
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 3800; resonance = 0.4  # lowpass
stage1: y = softclip(x, a)  # soft clip
eq1: type = peak; freq = b; q = 0.9; gain = -4.5  # peak EQ
ir1: mix = c; gain = 2  # impulse response

name: Crunch Rhythm Pedal
description: Medium crunch, 1.2 kHz, no IR.
script:
# Crunch Rhythm Pedal
# How it sounds: Medium crunch, 1.2 kHz, no IR.
# a Drive: 1.4 to 6, default 3.2
# b Mid: 1 to 5, default 2.6
# c Tone: 2500 to 6500, default 4200

param a = Drive [1.4, 6]
param b = Mid [1, 5]
param c = Tone [2500, 6500]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 100; resonance = 0.32  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a)  # tube saturation
eq1: type = peak; freq = 1200; q = 1.05; gain = b  # peak EQ
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.35  # lowpass

name: Lead Satin Clip
description: Smoother lead clip + presence, no gate.
script:
# Lead Satin Clip
# How it sounds: Smoother lead clip + presence, no gate.
# a Drive: 1.6 to 7, default 3.5
# b Air: 1 to 5, default 2.4
# c Level: 0.4 to 1.1, default 0.75

param a = Drive [1.6, 7]
param b = Air [1, 5]
param c = Level [0.4, 1.1]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 130; resonance = 0.3  # highpass
stage1: y = softclip(x, a) * c  # soft clip
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 4200; q = 0.55; gain = b  # high shelf

name: Bass Dirt Pedal
description: Bass-safe dirt: blend, LPF 3 kHz.
script:
# Bass Dirt Pedal
# How it sounds: Bass-safe dirt: blend, LPF 3 kHz.
# a Drive: 1 to 6, default 2.6
# b Blend: 0.1 to 0.55, default 0.28
# c Top: 1500 to 4000, default 2600

param a = Drive [1, 6]
param b = Blend [0.1, 0.55]
param c = Top [1500, 4000]
stage1: y = x  # waveshape / mix
bus dirt:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 50; resonance = 0.22  # highpass
  stage2: y = tube(x, a)  # tube saturation
  filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.3  # lowpass
out: main = 1-b; dirt = b  # mix buses back to the output

name: Synth Clip Desk
description: Synths: softclip + 8 kHz recovery. Not a guitar amp.
script:
# Synth Clip Desk
# How it sounds: Synths: softclip + 8 kHz recovery. Not a guitar amp.
# a Drive: 0.8 to 4, default 1.8
# b Top: 4000 to 12000, default 8000
# c Level: 0.5 to 1.2, default 0.9

param a = Drive [0.8, 4]
param b = Top [4000, 12000]
param c = Level [0.5, 1.2]
stage1: y = softclip(x, a) * c  # soft clip
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.25  # lowpass

name: Vocal Tube Desk
description: Vocal: tiny tube, HPF 80, no cab.
script:
# Vocal Tube Desk
# How it sounds: Vocal: tiny tube, HPF 80, no cab.
# a Warm: 0.5 to 2.2, default 1.05
# b Air: 0 to 4, default 1.6
# c Cut: 50 to 140, default 80

param a = Warm [0.5, 2.2]
param b = Air [0, 4]
param c = Cut [50, 140]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.22  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a)  # tube saturation
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 8000; q = 0.5; gain = b  # high shelf

name: Drum Clip Bus
description: Drum bus clip, 80 HPF, 6 kHz LPF.
script:
# Drum Clip Bus
# How it sounds: Drum bus clip, 80 HPF, 6 kHz LPF.
# a Drive: 1 to 5, default 2.2
# b Ceiling: 0.45 to 0.9, default 0.7
# c Top: 3500 to 8000, default 5500

param a = Drive [1, 5]
param b = Ceiling [0.45, 0.9]
param c = Top [3500, 8000]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 70; resonance = 0.25  # highpass
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x, a), b)  # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.28  # lowpass

name: Mixbus Satin
description: Mixbus: barely-there tube + limit.
script:
# Mixbus Satin
# How it sounds: Mixbus: barely-there tube + limit.
# a Satin: 0.4 to 1.4, default 0.75
# b Ceiling: -1.2 to -0.2, default -0.4
# c Air: 0 to 2, default 0.6

param a = Satin [0.4, 1.4]
param b = Ceiling [-1.2, -0.2]
param c = Air [0, 2]
stage1: y = tube(x, a)  # tube saturation
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 12000; q = 0.5; gain = c  # high shelf
limit1: ceiling = b; release = 0.1  # limiter

name: Lo-Fi Amp Sim
description: Tiny speaker: 300–3.5 kHz + crush.
script:
# Lo-Fi Amp Sim
# How it sounds: Tiny speaker: 300–3.5 kHz + crush.
# a Bits: 5 to 11, default 8
# b Low: 180 to 450, default 280
# c High: 2500 to 5000, default 3500

param a = Bits [5, 11]
param b = Low [180, 450]
param c = High [2500, 5000]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.35  # highpass
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.4  # lowpass
stage1: y = bitcrush(softclip(x, 1.5), a)  # soft clip

name: Kick Click Split
description: Kick: click on a high bus, body on low. Not Kick Rumble.
script:
# Kick Click Split
# How it sounds: Kick: click on a high bus, body on low. Not Kick Rumble.
# a Click: 0 to 6, default 2.8
# b Body: 0 to 5, default 2.2
# c BandHz: 180 to 400, default 260

param a = Click [0, 6]
param b = Body [0, 5]
param c = BandHz [180, 400]
xover1: f1 = c  # crossover
bus low:
  eq1: type = peak; freq = 55; q = 1.1; gain = b  # peak EQ
bus high:
  eq2: type = peak; freq = 3000; q = 1.3; gain = a  # peak EQ
out: low = 1; high = 1  # mix buses back to the output

name: Warehouse Body
description: Kick body + short metal delay. Not Warehouse Rumble.
script:
# Warehouse Body
# How it sounds: Kick body + short metal delay. Not Warehouse Rumble.
# a Metal: 8 to 28, default 16
# b Body: 1 to 5, default 2.6
# c Mix: 0.08 to 0.3, default 0.14

param a = Metal [8, 28]
param b = Body [1, 5]
param c = Mix [0.08, 0.3]
eq1: type = peak; freq = 60; q = 1.05; gain = b  # peak EQ
delay1: time = a; feedback = 0.22; mix = c; damp = 2500  # delay line

name: Hard Clip Club
description: Club clip lighter than Hardcore Clip.
script:
# Hard Clip Club
# How it sounds: Club clip lighter than Hardcore Clip.
# a Drive: 2 to 9, default 5
# b Ceiling: 0.28 to 0.7, default 0.45
# c Top: 3000 to 7000, default 4800

param a = Drive [2, 9]
param b = Ceiling [0.28, 0.7]
param c = Top [3000, 7000]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 80; resonance = 0.3  # highpass
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x, a * 0.4), b)  # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.32  # lowpass

name: Gabber Mid Bark
description: Mid bark + sub bus. Not Gabber Drive.
script:
# Gabber Mid Bark
# How it sounds: Mid bark + sub bus. Not Gabber Drive.
# a Bark: 2 to 8, default 4
# b Sub: 0.2 to 0.8, default 0.4
# c Drive: 2 to 8, default 4.5

param a = Bark [2, 8]
param b = Sub [0.2, 0.8]
param c = Drive [2, 8]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 90; resonance = 0.35  # highpass
eq1: type = peak; freq = 1400; q = 1.2; gain = a  # peak EQ
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x, c * 0.35), 0.4)  # soft clip
bus sub:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 90; resonance = 0.25  # lowpass
  stage2: y = tube(x, 1.2)  # tube saturation
out: main = 1; sub = b  # mix buses back to the output

name: Acid Soft Slide
description: Softer acid than Acid Hash. Env LPF.
script:
# Acid Soft Slide
# How it sounds: Softer acid than Acid Hash. Env LPF.
# a Cut: 250 to 3500, default 900
# b Res: 0.7 to 2.8, default 1.5
# c Env: 200 to 2000, default 800

param a = Cut [250, 3500]
param b = Res [0.7, 2.8]
param c = Env [200, 2000]
env1: attack = 0.005; release = 0.14  # envelope follower
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = a + env1 * c; resonance = b  # lowpass
stage1: y = diode(x, 1.3)  # diode clip

name: Tekno Metal Delay
description: Shorter comb than Tekno Comb.
script:
# Tekno Metal Delay
# How it sounds: Shorter comb than Tekno Comb.
# a Time: 6 to 22, default 11
# b Feedback: 0.2 to 0.6, default 0.38
# c Drive: 1 to 5, default 2.2

param a = Time [6, 22]
param b = Feedback [0.2, 0.6]
param c = Drive [1, 5]
stage1: y = tube(x, c)  # tube saturation
delay1: time = a; feedback = b; mix = 0.28; damp = 4500  # delay line

name: Industrial Chop
description: Gate + clip. Not Industrial Gate stock.
script:
# Industrial Chop
# How it sounds: Gate + clip. Not Industrial Gate stock.
# a Open: -36 to -14, default -24
# b Drive: 1.5 to 7, default 3.2
# c Hold: 0.01 to 0.08, default 0.03

param a = Open [-36, -14]
param b = Drive [1.5, 7]
param c = Hold [0.01, 0.08]
gate1: threshold = a; hyst = 4; hold = c; range = -70  # noise gate
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x, b), 0.55)  # soft clip
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 100; resonance = 0.3  # highpass

name: Hoover Fold Club
description: Fold + chorus. Not Hoover Dirt.
script:
# Hoover Fold Club
# How it sounds: Fold + chorus. Not Hoover Dirt.
# a Fold: 0.18 to 0.5, default 0.3
# b Rate: 0.2 to 1.5, default 0.55
# c Mix: 0.2 to 0.6, default 0.32

param a = Fold [0.18, 0.5]
param b = Rate [0.2, 1.5]
param c = Mix [0.2, 0.6]
stage1: y = fold(x, -a, a)  # wavefold
osc1: shape = sine; freq = b; depth = 1  # LFO
delay1: time = 11 + osc1 * 6; feedback = 0.08; mix = c; damp = 5000  # delay line

name: Rave Stab Desk
description: Stab: fast env LPF + clip.
script:
# Rave Stab Desk
# How it sounds: Stab: fast env LPF + clip.
# a Cut: 400 to 4000, default 1600
# b Drive: 1.2 to 6, default 2.8
# c Rel: 0.05 to 0.25, default 0.12

param a = Cut [400, 4000]
param b = Drive [1.2, 6]
param c = Rel [0.05, 0.25]
env1: attack = 0.003; release = c  # envelope follower
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = a * (0.3 + 0.7 * env1); resonance = 0.8  # lowpass
stage1: y = softclip(x, b)  # soft clip

name: Club Sidechain Pad
description: Pad ducks from kick sidechain.
script:
# Club Sidechain Pad
# How it sounds: Pad ducks from kick sidechain.
# a Depth: 0.3 to 1, default 0.7
# b Release: 0.08 to 0.35, default 0.16
# c Floor: -22 to -8, default -14

param a = Depth [0.3, 1]
param b = Release [0.08, 0.35]
param c = Floor [-22, -8]
sidechain1: mix = a  # host sidechain
comp1: threshold = c; ratio = 8; attack = 0.001; release = b; source = sidechain  # compressor

name: Club OTT Lift
description: OTT for club busses. Punchier than OTT Smash.
script:
# Club OTT Lift
# How it sounds: OTT for club busses. Punchier than OTT Smash.
# a Depth: 0.25 to 0.85, default 0.48
# b Time: 0.008 to 0.04, default 0.016
# c In: 0.8 to 1.8, default 1.15

param a = Depth [0.25, 0.85]
param b = Time [0.008, 0.04]
param c = In [0.8, 1.8]
ott1: depth = a; time = b; in = c; low = 1.1; mid = 0.95; high = 1.05  # OTT (3-band up+down)

name: Club Mono Kick
description: Force kick mono below 150 Hz.
script:
# Club Mono Kick
# How it sounds: Force kick mono below 150 Hz.
# a BandHz: 80 to 200, default 140
# b Weight: 0 to 4, default 1.8
# c Click: 0 to 3, default 1.2

param a = BandHz [80, 200]
param b = Weight [0, 4]
param c = Click [0, 3]
xover1: f1 = a  # crossover
bus low:
  eq1: type = peak; freq = 55; q = 1.05; gain = b  # peak EQ
ms1: mode = encode  # mid/side encode
stage1: channel = side; y = x * 0  # mute this channel
ms2: mode = decode  # mid/side decode
eq2: type = peak; freq = 3000; q = 1.2; gain = c  # peak EQ
out: low = 1; high = 1  # mix buses back to the output

name: Supersaw Glue
description: Widen + light OTT + clip. Leads / stacks.
script:
# Supersaw Glue
# How it sounds: Widen + light OTT + clip. Leads / stacks.
# a Width: 0.3 to 1, default 0.62
# b Depth: 0.15 to 0.55, default 0.3
# c Drive: 0.8 to 2.2, default 1.2

param a = Width [0.3, 1]
param b = Depth [0.15, 0.55]
param c = Drive [0.8, 2.2]
widen1: width = a; delay = 12; bass = 160  # mono to stereo
ott1: depth = b; time = 0.02; in = 1  # OTT (3-band up+down)
stage1: y = softclip(x, c)  # soft clip

name: Pluck Envelope
description: Fast env LPF for plucks.
script:
# Pluck Envelope
# How it sounds: Fast env LPF for plucks.
# a Cut: 400 to 5000, default 1800
# b Rel: 0.04 to 0.22, default 0.1
# c Res: 0.4 to 1.8, default 0.9

param a = Cut [400, 5000]
param b = Rel [0.04, 0.22]
param c = Res [0.4, 1.8]
env1: attack = 0.002; release = b  # envelope follower
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = a * (0.25 + 0.75 * env1); resonance = c  # lowpass

name: Drop Impact FX
description: Impact: clip + short verb + click EQ.
script:
# Drop Impact FX
# How it sounds: Impact: clip + short verb + click EQ.
# a Drive: 1.5 to 7, default 3.2
# b Room: 0.12 to 0.4, default 0.22
# c Click: 0 to 5, default 2

param a = Drive [1.5, 7]
param b = Room [0.12, 0.4]
param c = Click [0, 5]
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x, a), 0.55)  # soft clip
eq1: type = peak; freq = 80; q = 1.2; gain = c  # peak EQ
reverb1: size = b; decay = 0.22; damp = 0.45; mix = 0.16; width = 0.5  # reverb

name: Build Filter Rise
description: LFO (or automate Cut) opens an LPF.
script:
# Build Filter Rise
# How it sounds: LFO (or automate Cut) opens an LPF.
# a Floor: 200 to 1500, default 500
# b Span: 500 to 6000, default 2800
# c Rate: 0.03 to 0.25, default 0.08

param a = Floor [200, 1500]
param b = Span [500, 6000]
param c = Rate [0.03, 0.25]
osc1: shape = saw; freq = c; depth = 1  # LFO
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = a + (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1) * b; resonance = 0.75  # lowpass

name: Sidechain Pad EDM
description: Four-on-the-floor duck.
script:
# Sidechain Pad EDM
# How it sounds: Four-on-the-floor duck.
# a Depth: 0.35 to 1, default 0.75
# b Release: 0.1 to 0.4, default 0.2
# c Floor: -24 to -8, default -14

param a = Depth [0.35, 1]
param b = Release [0.1, 0.4]
param c = Floor [-24, -8]
sidechain1: mix = a  # host sidechain
comp1: threshold = c; ratio = 10; attack = 0.001; release = b; source = sidechain  # compressor

name: Reese Mid Growl
description: Mid grit + chorus. Bass reese.
script:
# Reese Mid Growl
# How it sounds: Mid grit + chorus. Bass reese.
# a Grit: 1 to 5, default 2.4
# b Rate: 0.15 to 1, default 0.4
# c BandHz: 120 to 280, default 180

param a = Grit [1, 5]
param b = Rate [0.15, 1]
param c = BandHz [120, 280]
xover1: f1 = c  # crossover
bus high:
  stage1: y = diode(x, a)  # diode clip
  osc1: shape = sine; freq = b; depth = 1  # LFO
  delay1: time = 12 + osc1 * 5; feedback = 0.06; mix = 0.25; damp = 5000  # delay line
out: low = 1; high = 1  # mix buses back to the output

name: White Noise Riser
description: HPF sweep on noise / FX.
script:
# White Noise Riser
# How it sounds: HPF sweep on noise / FX.
# a Cut: 200 to 4000, default 800
# b Res: 0.3 to 1.4, default 0.6
# c Drive: 0.6 to 2, default 1.1

param a = Cut [200, 4000]
param b = Res [0.3, 1.4]
param c = Drive [0.6, 2]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = a; resonance = b  # highpass
stage1: y = softclip(x, c)  # soft clip

name: Festival Group Vocal
description: Gang vocal: widen + short slap + OTT.
script:
# Festival Group Vocal
# How it sounds: Gang vocal: widen + short slap + OTT.
# a Width: 0.3 to 1, default 0.55
# b Depth: 0.15 to 0.5, default 0.28
# c Slap: 70 to 130, default 95

param a = Width [0.3, 1]
param b = Depth [0.15, 0.5]
param c = Slap [70, 130]
widen1: width = a; delay = 14; bass = 180  # mono to stereo
delay1: time = c; feedback = 0.08; mix = 0.16; damp = 4500  # delay line
ott1: depth = b; time = 0.02; in = 1  # OTT (3-band up+down)

name: Festival Lead Clip
description: Lead: clip + 3 kHz + widen.
script:
# Festival Lead Clip
# How it sounds: Lead: clip + 3 kHz + widen.
# a Drive: 1.2 to 5, default 2.4
# b Cut: 1 to 5, default 2.4
# c Width: 0.2 to 0.8, default 0.45

param a = Drive [1.2, 5]
param b = Cut [1, 5]
param c = Width [0.2, 0.8]
stage1: y = softclip(x, a)  # soft clip
eq1: type = peak; freq = 3000; q = 1.15; gain = b  # peak EQ
widen1: width = c; delay = 11; bass = 200  # mono to stereo

name: Festival Drum Bus
description: EDM drum bus: OTT + clip + HPF.
script:
# Festival Drum Bus
# How it sounds: EDM drum bus: OTT + clip + HPF.
# a Depth: 0.2 to 0.7, default 0.38
# b Drive: 1 to 4, default 1.8
# c Cut: 30 to 80, default 45

param a = Depth [0.2, 0.7]
param b = Drive [1, 4]
param c = Cut [30, 80]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.22  # highpass
ott1: depth = a; time = 0.015; in = 1.1  # OTT (3-band up+down)
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x, b), 0.72)  # soft clip

name: Tape Hiss Bed
description: Dark LPF + wow. Not Cassette.
script:
# Tape Hiss Bed
# How it sounds: Dark LPF + wow. Not Cassette.
# a Top: 2500 to 7000, default 4200
# b Wow: 0.2 to 1, default 0.4
# c Drive: 0.6 to 2, default 1.1

param a = Top [2500, 7000]
param b = Wow [0.2, 1]
param c = Drive [0.6, 2]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = b; depth = 1  # LFO
delay1: time = 16 + osc1 * 3; feedback = 0.08; mix = 0.2; damp = 4000  # delay line
stage1: y = tube(x, c)  # tube saturation
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = a; resonance = 0.28  # lowpass

name: AM Radio Narrow
description: Narrower than Phone Line. 500–2.8 kHz.
script:
# AM Radio Narrow
# How it sounds: Narrower than Phone Line. 500–2.8 kHz.
# a Low: 350 to 700, default 500
# b High: 2000 to 3500, default 2800
# c Bits: 6 to 11, default 8

param a = Low [350, 700]
param b = High [2000, 3500]
param c = Bits [6, 11]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = a; resonance = 0.4  # highpass
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.35  # lowpass
stage1: y = bitcrush(softclip(x, 1.3), c)  # soft clip

name: VHS Tracking
description: Wow + dark + tiny crush. Video tape.
script:
# VHS Tracking
# How it sounds: Wow + dark + tiny crush. Video tape.
# a Wow: 0.15 to 0.8, default 0.35
# b Bits: 6 to 12, default 9
# c Top: 2000 to 5500, default 3400

param a = Wow [0.15, 0.8]
param b = Bits [6, 12]
param c = Top [2000, 5500]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1  # LFO
delay1: time = 20 + osc1 * 4; feedback = 0.1; mix = 0.18; damp = 3500  # delay line
stage1: y = bitcrush(x, b)  # bitcrush
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.3  # lowpass

name: Broken Speaker
description: 300–2.5 kHz + fold.
script:
# Broken Speaker
# How it sounds: 300–2.5 kHz + fold.
# a Fold: 0.12 to 0.4, default 0.22
# b Low: 200 to 450, default 300
# c High: 1800 to 3500, default 2500

param a = Fold [0.12, 0.4]
param b = Low [200, 450]
param c = High [1800, 3500]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.4  # highpass
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.42  # lowpass
stage1: y = fold(x, -a, a)  # wavefold

name: Dusty Vinyl Bed
description: Notch + dark + gentle clip. Not Vinyl Dirt.
script:
# Dusty Vinyl Bed
# How it sounds: Notch + dark + gentle clip. Not Vinyl Dirt.
# a Scratch: 400 to 2000, default 900
# b Top: 3000 to 7000, default 4800
# c Dust: 0.6 to 1.8, default 1.05

param a = Scratch [400, 2000]
param b = Top [3000, 7000]
param c = Dust [0.6, 1.8]
eq1: type = notch; freq = a; q = 2.4; gain = -8  # notch
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.28  # lowpass
stage1: y = diode(x, c)  # diode clip

name: Pocket Recorder
description: 8 kHz LPF, light crush, HPF 120.
script:
# Pocket Recorder
# How it sounds: 8 kHz LPF, light crush, HPF 120.
# a Bits: 6 to 12, default 9
# b Top: 4000 to 9000, default 6500
# c Cut: 80 to 200, default 120

param a = Bits [6, 12]
param b = Top [4000, 9000]
param c = Cut [80, 200]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.25  # highpass
stage1: y = bitcrush(softclip(x, 1.2), a)  # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.3  # lowpass

name: Wow Only Tape
description: Just wow, almost no tone loss.
script:
# Wow Only Tape
# How it sounds: Just wow, almost no tone loss.
# a Rate: 0.25 to 1.4, default 0.55
# b Depth: 1 to 7, default 3.2
# c Mix: 0.2 to 0.8, default 0.4

param a = Rate [0.25, 1.4]
param b = Depth [1, 7]
param c = Mix [0.2, 0.8]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1  # LFO
delay1: time = 14 + osc1 * b; feedback = 0.06; mix = c; damp = 7000  # delay line

name: Flutter Only Tape
description: Faster than wow. Capstan flutter.
script:
# Flutter Only Tape
# How it sounds: Faster than wow. Capstan flutter.
# a Rate: 4 to 12, default 7
# b Depth: 0.5 to 3, default 1.4
# c Mix: 0.15 to 0.6, default 0.32

param a = Rate [4, 12]
param b = Depth [0.5, 3]
param c = Mix [0.15, 0.6]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1  # LFO
delay1: time = 12 + osc1 * b; feedback = 0.05; mix = c; damp = 6500  # delay line

name: Telephone Then Room
description: Phone band plus a cheap room.
script:
# Telephone Then Room
# How it sounds: Phone band plus a cheap room.
# a Low: 280 to 600, default 400
# b High: 2400 to 4000, default 3200
# c Room: 0.1 to 0.35, default 0.2

param a = Low [280, 600]
param b = High [2400, 4000]
param c = Room [0.1, 0.35]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = a; resonance = 0.4  # highpass
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.35  # lowpass
reverb1: size = c; decay = 0.25; damp = 0.45; mix = 0.18; width = 0.4  # reverb

name: Chip Tune Crush
description: 4–7 bits + 5 kHz. Game / chiptune.
script:
# Chip Tune Crush
# How it sounds: 4–7 bits + 5 kHz. Game / chiptune.
# a Bits: 3 to 8, default 5
# b Top: 2500 to 7000, default 4500
# c Drive: 0.8 to 2.4, default 1.3

param a = Bits [3, 8]
param b = Top [2500, 7000]
param c = Drive [0.8, 2.4]
stage1: y = bitcrush(softclip(x, c), a)  # soft clip
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.4  # lowpass

name: Worn Cassette 2
description: Darker cassette: 3 kHz LPF + wow + tube.
script:
# Worn Cassette 2
# How it sounds: Darker cassette: 3 kHz LPF + wow + tube.
# a Top: 1800 to 4500, default 2800
# b Wow: 0.2 to 0.9, default 0.4
# c Warm: 0.6 to 1.8, default 1.05

param a = Top [1800, 4500]
param b = Wow [0.2, 0.9]
param c = Warm [0.6, 1.8]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = b; depth = 1  # LFO
delay1: time = 18 + osc1 * 3; feedback = 0.1; mix = 0.16; damp = 3000  # delay line
stage1: y = tube(x, c)  # tube saturation
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = a; resonance = 0.3  # lowpass

name: Pad Cloud Hall
description: Long hall + slow chorus. Pads.
script:
# Pad Cloud Hall
# How it sounds: Long hall + slow chorus. Pads.
# a Size: 0.45 to 0.88, default 0.66
# b Rate: 0.05 to 0.4, default 0.14
# c Mix: 0.2 to 0.6, default 0.36

param a = Size [0.45, 0.88]
param b = Rate [0.05, 0.4]
param c = Mix [0.2, 0.6]
reverb1: size = a; decay = 2.4; damp = 0.4; mix = c; width = 0.85  # reverb
osc1: shape = sine; freq = b; depth = 1  # LFO
delay1: time = 16 + osc1 * 8; feedback = 0.08; mix = 0.2; damp = 6000  # delay line

name: Drone Low Bed
description: Dark drone: LPF + long verb + octave sub.
script:
# Drone Low Bed
# How it sounds: Dark drone: LPF + long verb + octave sub.
# a Sub: 0.1 to 0.5, default 0.25
# b Top: 400 to 1600, default 900
# c Hall: 0.4 to 0.85, default 0.62

param a = Sub [0.1, 0.5]
param b = Top [400, 1600]
param c = Hall [0.4, 0.85]
octaver1: mix = a; sub = 1; up = 0; tone = 120; thresh = 0.05  # analog octaver
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.3  # lowpass
reverb1: size = c; decay = 2.6; damp = 0.6; mix = 0.4; width = 0.7  # reverb

name: Ice Crystal Verb
description: Bright long verb + up octave. Not Crystal Edge.
script:
# Ice Crystal Verb
# How it sounds: Bright long verb + up octave. Not Crystal Edge.
# a Size: 0.4 to 0.8, default 0.58
# b Octave: 0.1 to 0.45, default 0.24
# c Mix: 0.2 to 0.55, default 0.32

param a = Size [0.4, 0.8]
param b = Octave [0.1, 0.45]
param c = Mix [0.2, 0.55]
stage1: y = x  # waveshape / mix
bus ice:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  octaver1: mix = b; sub = 0; up = 1; tone = 420; thresh = 0.05  # analog octaver
  reverb1: size = a; decay = 2.2; damp = 0.28; mix = 1; width = 0.88  # reverb
out: main = 1-c; ice = c  # mix buses back to the output

name: Fog Lowpass
description: Just a slow darkening. Mix / pad.
script:
# Fog Lowpass
# How it sounds: Just a slow darkening. Mix / pad.
# a Top: 800 to 5000, default 2200
# b Res: 0.2 to 0.8, default 0.35
# c Mix: 0.4 to 1, default 0.85

param a = Top [800, 5000]
param b = Res [0.2, 0.8]
param c = Mix [0.4, 1]
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = a; resonance = b  # lowpass
stage1: y = tube(x, 0.7)  # tube saturation
stage2: y = lerp(x, y, c)  # dry/wet blend

name: Night Hall
description: Darker than Dark Ambient Verb. 3 kHz LPF on the tail.
script:
# Night Hall
# How it sounds: Darker than Dark Ambient Verb. 3 kHz LPF on the tail.
# a Size: 0.4 to 0.8, default 0.58
# b Decay: 1 to 2.8, default 1.7
# c Mix: 0.2 to 0.55, default 0.34

param a = Size [0.4, 0.8]
param b = Decay [1, 2.8]
param c = Mix [0.2, 0.55]
reverb1: size = a; decay = b; damp = 0.65; mix = c; width = 0.8  # reverb
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 3200; resonance = 0.22  # lowpass

name: Slow Swell Ambient
description: Env opens a hall. Guitar / keys.
script:
# Slow Swell Ambient
# How it sounds: Env opens a hall. Guitar / keys.
# a Rise: 0.08 to 0.45, default 0.18
# b Size: 0.35 to 0.8, default 0.55
# c Mix: 0.25 to 0.7, default 0.42

param a = Rise [0.08, 0.45]
param b = Size [0.35, 0.8]
param c = Mix [0.25, 0.7]
env1: attack = a; release = 0.4  # envelope follower
stage1: y = x * (0.12 + 0.88 * env1)  # waveshape / mix
reverb1: size = b; decay = 2.0; damp = 0.42; mix = c; width = 0.82  # reverb

name: Distant Radio Amb
description: Bandpass + long verb. Memory / flashback.
script:
# Distant Radio Amb
# How it sounds: Bandpass + long verb. Memory / flashback.
# a Center: 700 to 1800, default 1100
# b Size: 0.35 to 0.75, default 0.52
# c Mix: 0.2 to 0.6, default 0.35

param a = Center [700, 1800]
param b = Size [0.35, 0.75]
param c = Mix [0.2, 0.6]
filter1: type = bandpass; center = a; width = 900  # bandpass
reverb1: size = b; decay = 1.8; damp = 0.45; mix = c; width = 0.75  # reverb

name: Tidal Delay Amb
description: Long dotted delay into a hall.
script:
# Tidal Delay Amb
# How it sounds: Long dotted delay into a hall.
# a Feedback: 0.25 to 0.55, default 0.36
# b Size: 0.3 to 0.7, default 0.48
# c Mix: 0.2 to 0.55, default 0.32

param a = Feedback [0.25, 0.55]
param b = Size [0.3, 0.7]
param c = Mix [0.2, 0.55]
delay1: time = 1/4.; feedback = a; mix = 0.35; damp = 3500  # delay line
reverb1: size = b; decay = 1.6; damp = 0.45; mix = c; width = 0.78  # reverb

name: Glass Plate Amb
description: Bright plate, long, no octave.
script:
# Glass Plate Amb
# How it sounds: Bright plate, long, no octave.
# a Size: 0.28 to 0.6, default 0.42
# b Decay: 0.8 to 2.2, default 1.3
# c Mix: 0.18 to 0.5, default 0.3

param a = Size [0.28, 0.6]
param b = Decay [0.8, 2.2]
param c = Mix [0.18, 0.5]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 220; resonance = 0.22  # highpass
reverb1: size = a; decay = b; damp = 0.26; mix = c; width = 0.8  # reverb

name: Wind Highpass Amb
description: HPF + air verb. Wind / air beds.
script:
# Wind Highpass Amb

# c Mix: 0.2 to 0.55, default 0.32

param a = Cut [200, 1200]
param b = Size [0.3, 0.7]
param c = Mix [0.2, 0.55]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = a; resonance = 0.28  # highpass
reverb1: size = b; decay = 1.5; damp = 0.32; mix = c; width = 0.85  # reverb

# Soft Chorus Cloud

param a = Rate [0.04, 0.25]
param b = Depth [8, 22]
param c = Mix [0.25, 0.7]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1  # LFO
delay1: time = 18 + osc1 * b; feedback = 0.1; mix = c; damp = 6500  # delay line

name: Underwater LPF
description: Deep LPF + short room. Underwater.
script:
# Underwater LPF
# How it sounds: Deep LPF + short room. Underwater.
# a Top: 400 to 1800, default 900
# b Room: 0.15 to 0.45, default 0.28
# c Mix: 0.2 to 0.6, default 0.35

param a = Top [400, 1800]
param b = Room [0.15, 0.45]
param c = Mix [0.2, 0.6]
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = a; resonance = 0.35  # lowpass
reverb1: size = b; decay = 0.7; damp = 0.7; mix = c; width = 0.5  # reverb

name: Impact Body Boom
description: Impact: sub bump + short clip. Not Boom Tail.
script:
# Impact Body Boom
# How it sounds: Impact: sub bump + short clip. Not Boom Tail.
# a Sub: 1 to 6, default 3
# b Drive: 1 to 5, default 2.2
# c Room: 0.1 to 0.35, default 0.2

param a = Sub [1, 6]
param b = Drive [1, 5]
param c = Room [0.1, 0.35]
eq1: type = peak; freq = 45; q = 1.2; gain = a  # peak EQ
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x, b), 0.6)  # soft clip
reverb1: size = c; decay = 0.28; damp = 0.55; mix = 0.18; width = 0.45  # reverb

name: Dialogue Phone
description: Phone filter for dialogue. Not Dialogue Seat.
script:
# Dialogue Phone
# How it sounds: Phone filter for dialogue. Not Dialogue Seat.
# a Low: 300 to 700, default 420
# b High: 2500 to 4200, default 3200
# c Grit: 0.5 to 2, default 1

param a = Low [300, 700]
param b = High [2500, 4200]
param c = Grit [0.5, 2]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = a; resonance = 0.4  # highpass
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.35  # lowpass

name: Far Plane Darker
description: More HPF and darker than Far Plane.
script:
# Far Plane Darker
# How it sounds: More HPF and darker than Far Plane.
# a Cut: 250 to 800, default 420
