# c Mix: 0.2 to 0.55, default 0.32

param a = Cut [250, 800]
param b = Size [0.35, 0.75]
param c = Mix [0.2, 0.55]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = a; resonance = 0.25  # highpass
reverb1: size = b; decay = 1.4; damp = 0.58; mix = c; width = 0.7  # reverb

name: Tension Pulse
description: Slow trem + dark hall. Not Tension Bed.
script:
# Tension Pulse
# How it sounds: Slow trem + dark hall. Not Tension Bed.
# a Rate: 0.15 to 1.2, default 0.4
# b Size: 0.3 to 0.7, default 0.48
# c Depth: 0.2 to 0.7, default 0.4

param a = Rate [0.15, 1.2]
param b = Size [0.3, 0.7]
param c = Depth [0.2, 0.7]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1  # LFO
stage1: y = x * (1 - c + c * (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1))  # waveshape / mix
reverb1: size = b; decay = 1.6; damp = 0.55; mix = 0.3; width = 0.65  # reverb

name: Score String Hall
description: Strings: long hall, no octave. Not Score Hall.
script:
# Score String Hall
# How it sounds: Strings: long hall, no octave. Not Score Hall.
# a Size: 0.4 to 0.82, default 0.6
# b Decay: 1.2 to 2.8, default 1.8
# c Mix: 0.18 to 0.5, default 0.3

param a = Size [0.4, 0.82]
param b = Decay [1.2, 2.8]
param c = Mix [0.18, 0.5]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 80; resonance = 0.2  # highpass
reverb1: size = a; decay = b; damp = 0.42; mix = c; width = 0.8  # reverb

name: Wide Canvas Soft
description: Softer widen than Wide Canvas.
script:
# Wide Canvas Soft
# How it sounds: Softer widen than Wide Canvas.
# a Width: 0.25 to 0.85, default 0.5
# b Haas: 8 to 20, default 13
# c Air: 0 to 3, default 1.2

param a = Width [0.25, 0.85]
param b = Haas [8, 20]
param c = Air [0, 3]
widen1: width = a; delay = b; bass = 150  # mono to stereo
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 9000; q = 0.5; gain = c  # high shelf

name: Trailer Whoosh
description: HPF sweep + short verb. Whoosh / fly-by.
script:
# Trailer Whoosh
# How it sounds: HPF sweep + short verb. Whoosh / fly-by.
# a Cut: 200 to 2500, default 700
# b Room: 0.12 to 0.4, default 0.22
# c Drive: 0.6 to 2.2, default 1.1

param a = Cut [200, 2500]
param b = Room [0.12, 0.4]
param c = Drive [0.6, 2.2]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = a; resonance = 0.45  # highpass
stage1: y = softclip(x, c)  # soft clip
reverb1: size = b; decay = 0.35; damp = 0.4; mix = 0.22; width = 0.7  # reverb

name: Horror Low Drone
description: Sub + dark verb. Horror bed.
script:
# Horror Low Drone
# How it sounds: Sub + dark verb. Horror bed.
# a Sub: 0.15 to 0.6, default 0.32
# b Top: 300 to 1200, default 600
# c Hall: 0.4 to 0.85, default 0.62

param a = Sub [0.15, 0.6]
param b = Top [300, 1200]
param c = Hall [0.4, 0.85]
octaver1: mix = a; sub = 1; up = 0; tone = 100; thresh = 0.05  # analog octaver
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.32  # lowpass
reverb1: size = c; decay = 2.4; damp = 0.7; mix = 0.38; width = 0.6  # reverb

name: Dialogue Air Seat
description: Dialogue: HPF 80, air, tiny booth.
script:
# Dialogue Air Seat
# How it sounds: Dialogue: HPF 80, air, tiny booth.
# a Air: 0 to 4, default 1.6
# b Cut: 60 to 140, default 85
# c Booth: 0.08 to 0.25, default 0.14

param a = Air [0, 4]
param b = Cut [60, 140]
param c = Booth [0.08, 0.25]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.22  # highpass
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 8000; q = 0.5; gain = a  # high shelf
reverb1: size = 0.16; decay = c; damp = 0.48; mix = 0.12; width = 0.35  # reverb

name: Infinite Repeat
description: High feedback delay, dark. Not Feedback Screamer.
script:
# Infinite Repeat
# How it sounds: High feedback delay, dark. Not Feedback Screamer.
# a Feedback: 0.45 to 0.78, default 0.6
# b Time: 180 to 600, default 320
# c Tone: 1500 to 4500, default 2800

param a = Feedback [0.45, 0.78]
param b = Time [180, 600]
param c = Tone [1500, 4500]
delay1: time = b; feedback = a; mix = 0.45; damp = c  # delay line
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 160; resonance = 0.25  # highpass

name: Glitch Hold Gate
description: Choppy gate, 1/16. Not Glitch Gate.
script:
# Glitch Hold Gate
# How it sounds: Choppy gate, 1/16. Not Glitch Gate.
# a Depth: 0.5 to 1, default 0.85
# b Open: -30 to -8, default -18
# c Mix: 0.3 to 1, default 0.8

param a = Depth [0.5, 1]
param b = Open [-30, -8]
param c = Mix [0.3, 1]
osc1: shape = square; freq = 1/16; depth = 1  # LFO
gate1: threshold = b; hyst = 3; hold = 0.01; range = -70  # noise gate
stage1: y = lerp(x, x * (1 - a + a * (0.05 + 0.95 * (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1))), c)  # dry/wet blend

name: Alien Formant
description: Moving formant. Not Alien Ring.
script:
# Alien Formant
# How it sounds: Moving formant. Not Alien Ring.
# a Rate: 0.1 to 2, default 0.45
# b Center: 400 to 1400, default 800
# c Mix: 0.25 to 0.9, default 0.55

param a = Rate [0.1, 2]
param b = Center [400, 1400]
param c = Mix [0.25, 0.9]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1  # LFO
stage1: y = x  # waveshape / mix
bus mouth:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  filter1: type = bandpass; center = b + osc1 * 400; width = 220; resonance = 1.5  # bandpass
out: main = 1-c; mouth = c  # mix buses back to the output

name: Stutter Repeat
description: Very short delay, high mix. Stutter.
script:
# Stutter Repeat
# How it sounds: Very short delay, high mix. Stutter.
# a Time: 8 to 40, default 18
# b Feedback: 0.2 to 0.65, default 0.4
# c Mix: 0.25 to 0.85, default 0.5

param a = Time [8, 40]
param b = Feedback [0.2, 0.65]
param c = Mix [0.25, 0.85]
delay1: time = a; feedback = b; mix = c; damp = 6000  # delay line

name: Freeze-ish Wash
description: Long time, high feedback, LPF. Pseudo freeze.
script:
# Freeze-ish Wash
# How it sounds: Long time, high feedback, LPF. Pseudo freeze.
# a Time: 400 to 1200, default 720
# b Feedback: 0.4 to 0.75, default 0.58
# c Top: 1500 to 5000, default 3000

param a = Time [400, 1200]
param b = Feedback [0.4, 0.75]
param c = Top [1500, 5000]
delay1: time = a; feedback = b; mix = 0.5; damp = c  # delay line
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.28  # lowpass

name: Ring Then Verb
description: Ring mod into a hall.
script:
# Ring Then Verb
# How it sounds: Ring mod into a hall.
# a Freq: 50 to 300, default 110
# b Size: 0.25 to 0.65, default 0.42
# c Mix: 0.2 to 0.7, default 0.35

param a = Freq [50, 300]
param b = Size [0.25, 0.65]
param c = Mix [0.2, 0.7]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1  # LFO
stage1: y = lerp(x, x * osc1, 0.55)  # dry/wet blend
reverb1: size = b; decay = 1.1; damp = 0.4; mix = c; width = 0.7  # reverb

name: Cascade Taps
description: Three delay times stacked. Not Cascade Loop Dirt.
script:
# Cascade Taps
# How it sounds: Three delay times stacked. Not Cascade Loop Dirt.
# a Mix: 0.15 to 0.5, default 0.28
# b Feedback: 0.08 to 0.3, default 0.16
# c Tone: 2500 to 7000, default 4200

param a = Mix [0.15, 0.5]
param b = Feedback [0.08, 0.3]
param c = Tone [2500, 7000]
delay1: time = 1/16; feedback = b; mix = a * 0.5; damp = c  # delay line
delay2: time = 1/8; feedback = b; mix = a * 0.4; damp = c  # delay line
delay3: time = 1/4; feedback = b * 0.8; mix = a * 0.35; damp = c  # delay line

name: Noise Blow Soft
description: HPF + fold, softer than Noise Blow.
script:
# Noise Blow Soft
# How it sounds: HPF + fold, softer than Noise Blow.
# a Cut: 200 to 2000, default 700
# b Fold: 0.1 to 0.4, default 0.22
# c Mix: 0.2 to 0.8, default 0.45

param a = Cut [200, 2000]
param b = Fold [0.1, 0.4]
param c = Mix [0.2, 0.8]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = a; resonance = 0.35  # highpass
stage1: y = lerp(x, fold(x, -b, b), c)  # wavefold

name: Comb Taste Soft
description: Longer comb, less feedback than Comb Taste.
script:
# Comb Taste Soft
# How it sounds: Longer comb, less feedback than Comb Taste.
# a Time: 12 to 48, default 24
# b Feedback: 0.15 to 0.5, default 0.28
# c Mix: 0.15 to 0.6, default 0.32

param a = Time [12, 48]
param b = Feedback [0.15, 0.5]
param c = Mix [0.15, 0.6]
delay1: time = a; feedback = b; mix = c; damp = 5500  # delay line

name: Impact Designer
description: Design hits: clip, sub, short room.
script:
# Impact Designer
# How it sounds: Design hits: clip, sub, short room.
# a Drive: 1.2 to 7, default 3
# b Sub: 0 to 6, default 2.4
# c Room: 0.08 to 0.32, default 0.16

param a = Drive [1.2, 7]
param b = Sub [0, 6]
param c = Room [0.08, 0.32]
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x, a), 0.55)  # soft clip
eq1: type = peak; freq = 50; q = 1.3; gain = b  # peak EQ
reverb1: size = c; decay = 0.2; damp = 0.5; mix = 0.15; width = 0.4  # reverb

name: Riser Designer
description: HPF + resonance + verb. Automate Cut.
script:
# Riser Designer
# How it sounds: HPF + resonance + verb. Automate Cut.
# a Cut: 150 to 4000, default 600
# b Res: 0.4 to 2, default 0.9
# c Hall: 0.2 to 0.6, default 0.36

param a = Cut [150, 4000]
param b = Res [0.4, 2]
param c = Hall [0.2, 0.6]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = a; resonance = b  # highpass
reverb1: size = c; decay = 1.0; damp = 0.4; mix = 0.28; width = 0.75  # reverb

name: Downer Designer
description: LPF + long delay. Downer / collapse.
script:
# Downer Designer
# How it sounds: LPF + long delay. Downer / collapse.
# a Top: 400 to 4000, default 1400
# b Time: 300 to 900, default 520
# c Feedback: 0.2 to 0.55, default 0.34

param a = Top [400, 4000]
param b = Time [300, 900]
param c = Feedback [0.2, 0.55]
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = a; resonance = 0.4  # lowpass
delay1: time = b; feedback = c; mix = 0.35; damp = 3000  # delay line

name: Texture Crush
description: Crush + bandpass. Texture layer.
script:
# Texture Crush
# How it sounds: Crush + bandpass. Texture layer.
# a Bits: 4 to 10, default 7
# b Center: 400 to 2000, default 900
# c Width: 200 to 1200, default 500

param a = Bits [4, 10]
param b = Center [400, 2000]
param c = Width [200, 1200]
stage1: y = bitcrush(softclip(x, 1.4), a)  # soft clip
filter1: type = bandpass; center = b; width = c  # bandpass

name: Sub Drop FX
description: Octave sub + clip. Drop FX.
script:
# Sub Drop FX
# How it sounds: Octave sub + clip. Drop FX.
# a Sub: 0.3 to 0.9, default 0.55
# b Drive: 1 to 5, default 2.2
# c Top: 80 to 200, default 130

param a = Sub [0.3, 0.9]
param b = Drive [1, 5]
param c = Top [80, 200]
octaver1: mix = a; sub = 1; up = 0; tone = 90; thresh = 0.04  # analog octaver
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x, b), 0.65)  # soft clip
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.25  # lowpass

name: Metal Hit Ring
description: Short comb + clip. Metal hit.
script:
# Metal Hit Ring
# How it sounds: Short comb + clip. Metal hit.
# a Time: 5 to 20, default 10
# b Drive: 1.2 to 6, default 2.8
# c Mix: 0.2 to 0.7, default 0.4

param a = Time [5, 20]
param b = Drive [1.2, 6]
param c = Mix [0.2, 0.7]
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x, b), 0.5)  # soft clip
delay1: time = a; feedback = 0.35; mix = c; damp = 5000  # delay line

name: Air Whoosh SD
description: HPF + air verb. Whoosh layer.
script:
# Air Whoosh SD
# How it sounds: HPF + air verb. Whoosh layer.
# a Cut: 300 to 2500, default 800
# b Size: 0.2 to 0.55, default 0.34
# c Mix: 0.2 to 0.55, default 0.32

param a = Cut [300, 2500]
param b = Size [0.2, 0.55]
param c = Mix [0.2, 0.55]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = a; resonance = 0.4  # highpass
reverb1: size = b; decay = 0.55; damp = 0.3; mix = c; width = 0.8  # reverb

name: Glitch Buffer
description: Tiny delay, square AM. Buffer glitch.
script:
# Glitch Buffer
# How it sounds: Tiny delay, square AM. Buffer glitch.
# a Time: 6 to 30, default 14
# b Rate: 4 to 16, default 8
# c Mix: 0.25 to 0.85, default 0.5

param a = Time [6, 30]
param b = Rate [4, 16]
param c = Mix [0.25, 0.85]
osc1: shape = square; freq = b; depth = 1  # LFO
delay1: time = a; feedback = 0.25; mix = c; damp = 6000  # delay line
stage1: y = x * (0.2 + 0.8 * (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1))  # waveshape / mix

name: Body Resonator
description: Resonant bandpass as a body.
script:
# Body Resonator
# How it sounds: Resonant bandpass as a body.
# a Center: 80 to 400, default 160
# b Q: 0.8 to 2.8, default 1.5
# c Mix: 0.2 to 0.8, default 0.4

param a = Center [80, 400]
param b = Q [0.8, 2.8]
param c = Mix [0.2, 0.8]
stage1: y = x  # waveshape / mix
bus body:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  filter1: type = bandpass; center = a; width = 80; resonance = b  # bandpass
out: main = 1-c; body = c  # mix buses back to the output

name: Lead Presence Synth
description: Lead: 2.8 kHz, clip, widen.
script:
# Lead Presence Synth
# How it sounds: Lead: 2.8 kHz, clip, widen.
# a Drive: 0.8 to 4, default 1.8
# b Cut: 1 to 5, default 2.4
# c Width: 0.15 to 0.7, default 0.38

param a = Drive [0.8, 4]
param b = Cut [1, 5]
param c = Width [0.15, 0.7]
stage1: y = softclip(x, a)  # soft clip
eq1: type = peak; freq = 2800; q = 1.15; gain = b  # peak EQ
widen1: width = c; delay = 11; bass = 180  # mono to stereo

name: Pad Widen Synth
description: Pad: widen + slow chorus + hall.
script:
# Pad Widen Synth
# How it sounds: Pad: widen + slow chorus + hall.
# a Width: 0.25 to 0.9, default 0.55
# b Rate: 0.05 to 0.4, default 0.14
# c Hall: 0.2 to 0.55, default 0.34

param a = Width [0.25, 0.9]
param b = Rate [0.05, 0.4]
param c = Hall [0.2, 0.55]
widen1: width = a; delay = 14; bass = 160  # mono to stereo
osc1: shape = sine; freq = b; depth = 1  # LFO
delay1: time = 15 + osc1 * 7; feedback = 0.08; mix = 0.22; damp = 6500  # delay line
reverb1: size = 0.4; decay = c; damp = 0.42; mix = 0.22; width = 0.8  # reverb

name: Bass Reese Synth
description: Reese: mid grit + chorus above 150 Hz.
script:
# Bass Reese Synth
# How it sounds: Reese: mid grit + chorus above 150 Hz.
# a Grit: 1 to 4.5, default 2.1
# b Rate: 0.2 to 1.2, default 0.45
# c BandHz: 100 to 220, default 150

param a = Grit [1, 4.5]
param b = Rate [0.2, 1.2]
param c = BandHz [100, 220]
xover1: f1 = c  # crossover
bus high:
  stage1: y = diode(x, a)  # diode clip
  osc1: shape = sine; freq = b; depth = 1  # LFO
  delay1: time = 11 + osc1 * 5; feedback = 0.06; mix = 0.22; damp = 4800  # delay line
out: low = 1; high = 1  # mix buses back to the output

name: Pluck Desk Synth
description: Pluck: env LPF + tiny room.
script:
# Pluck Desk Synth
# How it sounds: Pluck: env LPF + tiny room.
# a Cut: 500 to 5000, default 2000
# b Rel: 0.05 to 0.25, default 0.1
# c Room: 0.08 to 0.3, default 0.16

param a = Cut [500, 5000]
param b = Rel [0.05, 0.25]
param c = Room [0.08, 0.3]
env1: attack = 0.002; release = b  # envelope follower
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = a * (0.3 + 0.7 * env1); resonance = 0.7  # lowpass
reverb1: size = 0.18; decay = c; damp = 0.4; mix = 0.14; width = 0.55  # reverb

name: Keys Rhodes Trem
description: Keys: sine trem + warm tube.
script:
# Keys Rhodes Trem
# How it sounds: Keys: sine trem + warm tube.
# a Rate: 2 to 7, default 4
# b Depth: 0.2 to 0.7, default 0.4
# c Warm: 0.4 to 1.6, default 0.85

param a = Rate [2, 7]
param b = Depth [0.2, 0.7]
param c = Warm [0.4, 1.6]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1  # LFO
stage1: y = tube(x * (1 - b + b * (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1)), c)  # tube saturation

name: Keys Piano Hall
description: Piano: HPF 40, small hall, gentle glue.
script:
# Keys Piano Hall
# How it sounds: Piano: HPF 40, small hall, gentle glue.
# a Glue: 3 to 9, default 5
# b Size: 0.18 to 0.45, default 0.28
# c Mix: 0.08 to 0.32, default 0.16

param a = Glue [3, 9]
param b = Size [0.18, 0.45]
param c = Mix [0.08, 0.32]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 40; resonance = 0.2  # highpass
comp1: threshold = -a; ratio = 2.5; attack = 0.012; release = 0.16; makeup = 1  # compressor
reverb1: size = b; decay = 0.7; damp = 0.42; mix = c; width = 0.65  # reverb

name: Organ Rotary Synth
description: Organ: rotary AM + bandpass.
script:
# Organ Rotary Synth
# How it sounds: Organ: rotary AM + bandpass.
# a Rate: 0.6 to 7, default 1.2
# b Horn: 400 to 2000, default 1000
# c AM: 0.2 to 0.7, default 0.4

param a = Rate [0.6, 7]
param b = Horn [400, 2000]
param c = AM [0.2, 0.7]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1  # LFO
filter1: type = bandpass; center = 1000 + osc1 * b; width = 800; resonance = 0.55  # bandpass
stage1: y = x * (1 - c + c * (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1))  # waveshape / mix

name: Arp Sparkle Synth
description: Arp: HPF, delay 1/16, air.
script:
# Arp Sparkle Synth
# How it sounds: Arp: HPF, delay 1/16, air.
# a Cut: 80 to 300, default 140
# b Mix: 0.12 to 0.4, default 0.22
# c Air: 0 to 4, default 1.8

param a = Cut [80, 300]
param b = Mix [0.12, 0.4]
param c = Air [0, 4]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = a; resonance = 0.25  # highpass
delay1: time = 1/16; feedback = 0.18; mix = b; damp = 7000  # delay line
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 8000; q = 0.5; gain = c  # high shelf

name: Brass Stab Synth
description: Brass: fast env + clip + 800 Hz.
script:
# Brass Stab Synth
# How it sounds: Brass: fast env + clip + 800 Hz.
# a Drive: 1 to 5, default 2.2
# b Rel: 0.06 to 0.25, default 0.12
# c Honk: 1 to 5, default 2.4

param a = Drive [1, 5]
param b = Rel [0.06, 0.25]
param c = Honk [1, 5]
env1: attack = 0.004; release = b  # envelope follower
stage1: y = softclip(x * (0.4 + 0.6 * env1), a)  # soft clip
eq1: type = peak; freq = 800; q = 1.1; gain = c  # peak EQ

name: String Lush Synth
description: Strings: widen + long hall.
script:
# String Lush Synth
# How it sounds: Strings: widen + long hall.
# a Width: 0.25 to 0.85, default 0.5
# b Size: 0.35 to 0.75, default 0.52
# c Mix: 0.15 to 0.45, default 0.26

param a = Width [0.25, 0.85]
param b = Size [0.35, 0.75]
param c = Mix [0.15, 0.45]
widen1: width = a; delay = 13; bass = 150  # mono to stereo
reverb1: size = b; decay = 1.8; damp = 0.4; mix = c; width = 0.82  # reverb

name: FX Swoosh Synth
description: FX: LFO HPF + verb.
script:
# FX Swoosh Synth
# How it sounds: FX: LFO HPF + verb.
# a Rate: 0.05 to 0.4, default 0.12
# b Span: 300 to 3000, default 1400
# c Hall: 0.2 to 0.55, default 0.34

param a = Rate [0.05, 0.4]
param b = Span [300, 3000]
param c = Hall [0.2, 0.55]
osc1: shape = saw; freq = a; depth = 1  # LFO
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 200 + (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1) * b; resonance = 0.5  # highpass
reverb1: size = c; decay = 1.0; damp = 0.38; mix = 0.28; width = 0.75  # reverb

name: Poly Glue Synth
description: Poly stack glue: OTT light + clip.
script:
# Poly Glue Synth
# How it sounds: Poly stack glue: OTT light + clip.
# a Depth: 0.12 to 0.5, default 0.26
# b Drive: 0.7 to 2, default 1.1
# c Width: 0.2 to 0.7, default 0.4

param a = Depth [0.12, 0.5]
param b = Drive [0.7, 2]
param c = Width [0.2, 0.7]
ott1: depth = a; time = 0.025; in = 1  # OTT (3-band up+down)
stage1: y = softclip(x, b)  # soft clip
widen1: width = c; delay = 10; bass = 170  # mono to stereo

name: Mono Lead Dirt
description: Mono lead: tube + 1.5 kHz + no widen.
script:
# Mono Lead Dirt
# How it sounds: Mono lead: tube + 1.5 kHz + no widen.
# a Drive: 1 to 5, default 2.4
# b Cut: 1 to 5, default 2.6
# c Top: 3000 to 8000, default 5500

param a = Drive [1, 5]
param b = Cut [1, 5]
param c = Top [3000, 8000]
stage1: y = tube(x, a)  # tube saturation
eq1: type = peak; freq = 1500; q = 1.15; gain = b  # peak EQ
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.3  # lowpass

name: Bell Sparkle Synth
description: Bells: HPF, short delay, air.
script:
# Bell Sparkle Synth
# How it sounds: Bells: HPF, short delay, air.
# a Cut: 200 to 800, default 380
# b Mix: 0.1 to 0.4, default 0.2
# c Air: 1 to 5, default 2.4

param a = Cut [200, 800]
param b = Mix [0.1, 0.4]
param c = Air [1, 5]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = a; resonance = 0.25  # highpass
delay1: time = 1/8; feedback = 0.14; mix = b; damp = 7500  # delay line
eq1: type = highshelf; freq = 7000; q = 0.5; gain = c  # high shelf
